speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
The door section without a character line, and the
simple side proportions are very classic.
The covered headlights that were implemented from the DB5
were a popular trend at the time.
The tailfin design of the rear end
is a bit American in taste...
...but it was an era where Italian design was also
being influenced by American designs.
This �lassic aura and modern details form the character
of the DB5.
It's one of the most unique cars out of the DB series.
You probably know that it's the car of choice for James Bond,
appearing in numerous movies featuring the super spy.
zh:
车门的部分没有特征明显的分界线，简洁的侧面也十分
经典。
从DB5开始引入的包覆式头灯在当时蔚然成风，体现了当
时的潮流。
尾部的立鳍设计很有美式腔调……
那个时代的意大利也正受到美国车型设计的影响。
经典氛围和现代化细节造就了DB5的个性。
它是DB系列中最为独特的一款车，
虽说成为“邦德”车令它名声大噪，但它本身也不失为一
款经典车型。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.
Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!
I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.
Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.
A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.
You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.
The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.
On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.
Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。
为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！
它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。
而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。
我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。
只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。
964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，
而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料制造。
镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不菲！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.
The sparse interiors came in black as standard.
Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.
There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.
This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。
内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，
外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，
还分成了“M001”Carrera杯版本、“M002” RS Touring版本
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。
对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
There are some subtle visual differences between this car
and the R8 LMS: It's cleaner, with fewer graphics.
The aggressive look of the red taillights and flat red
bumper lines remain very much in place.
It's still a classically German look, in other words.
The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler
is now at a reverse angle.
Some ha�e also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.
This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the "Evo"
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!
Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!
zh:
与之前2015年的R8勒芒系列赛相比，这款R8只有一些外观
上细微差别。它的车身比较干净，没有那么多繁琐的图形，
但红色的尾灯和横向的红色保险杠线条让它保留了应有
的侵略性。
换句话说，这就是经典的日耳曼风格！
它的正面也变得更引人瞩目。还有扰流板被设置成了反角。
有人还开玩笑说，红色的侧翼就像两撇胡须一样。
名称中包含的“进化”一词代表它是R8勒芒系列赛的进
化版，整体视觉效果发生了天翻地覆的变化。
说句真心话，它离我�j目中的完美汽车越来越近了！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
This is such an exciting car!
From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a
tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.
The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension,
and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.
This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is
reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.
And, it's channeled�to propel the long nose forward!
The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations
such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.
You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness
with a devilish level of detail.
It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!
Incidentally, the fact that a race version was produced,
seemingly out of the blue...
...is probably related to the fact that the design boss
in Hiroshima is a race driver himse�f.
I really can't wait to hear that rotary engine roar!
zh:
这是一辆让人热血沸腾的车！
当你从某个特定角度看它的时候，它的线条以一颗轮胎
为始，以另一颗轮胎为终。它的座舱占据了大约车身的1/2。
车辆肩线的高度完全由悬挂的行程决定……座舱后半部
分的重量正落在驱动轮上，
产生大量的牵引力……这股动力沿着展现车辆亮点的侧
面弧线流动……
带着庞大的推力径直冲向长长的车头！
它有破竹的清澈，更有清溪的纯净，简洁的设计带有经
典的日本风韵。
仿佛结合了天使的大胆以及魔鬼的邪恶细节。
“魂动”设计的巅峰，就在此刻，此处！
像这样横空出世般的赛车版本……
可能与广岛工厂的设计总监本身就是一名赛车手有关。
噢，我已经迫不及待想听听它的转子引�(�轰鸣的声音了！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.
Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.
It was a time of ambition and decision.
There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.
Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the �orld.
When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,
it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
�saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.<next id=2000206 type=9�p
zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世
界上最大的汽车生产国。
在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，
希望决定汽车发展的方向……
你可以把它视作一种野心或反思。
在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。
撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受{��了全球车迷
的喜爱。
当我真正遇到白色流线造型的赛利卡，或是在欧洲古城的
鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，
那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新的感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的克莱斯勒时几乎一模一样。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
The A80 Supra...
...is a coupe with very traditional sports-car proportions
that's kind of rare in Japanese cars.
With a windshield that wraps all around the cabin,
it has a proper greenhouse.
And this car takes the classic, beautiful coupe and drops the
ride height further and widens the track...
...turning it into a race car that looks like it could really
deliver on the track!
The car's shape is simple, so the Castrol livery suits it well.
The lights, which look too close together in the original model,
are camouflaged and don't get in the way of the design.
The A80 Supra had lots of tuning parts available for it, so
it's no wonder it was so popular with the younger crowd.
zh:
该怎么描述A80 Supra呢……
这是一款采用传统跑车比例的双门跑车，在日本车当中
相当罕见。
环绕式的挡风玻璃仿若一个倒置的温室。
这辆经典、优美的双门跑车进一步降低了离地间隙，加
宽了胎面，
变成了一辆仿佛随时可以一飞冲天的赛车。
简洁的车型与嘉实多的涂装相得益彰。
原版车中看起来相距太近的头灯经过涂装的遮掩后也不
那么碍眼了。
再加上A80 Supra有很多可供选择的调校件，难怪它在年
轻人中有如此大的魅力了！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the
Japanese automotive industry.
But there may be no other car in Japan
where its history and tradition...
...weighs so heavily on a designer.
In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different
than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.
Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan
was the base.
So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.
Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...
...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy
as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing."
Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped
with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...
...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style
was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.
zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。
但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……
对设计师产生如此大的压力。
有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。
这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……
遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。
在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，
基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。
而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，
因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气度优雅，与当时的时代
背景相吻合。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
Look at this MR2, and you're likely to notice its modest, understated design.
In Italy, you'll find fierce beasts like the Urraco,
named after a fighting bull, and the Merak.
These are flashy cars that really stand out, but they're
not for the faint-hearted.
Let's just say that even when you handle them the
right way, they can still bite back.
This MR2 is pretty domesticated in that respect,
and does exactly wha� you tell it to do.
But that doesn't mean it's tame by any means. Put the pedal
to the metal and you won't know what hit you!
Still, for a carefree driving experience,
you can't go too wrong with this car.
It's one you'll want to make a place for
in your heart and in your home.
You can recognize some elements inspired by Ferrari here
and there, but all in all, it retains a certain modesty.
Perhaps this reflects �he belief of the Japanese designers
that they weren't quite ready for the world stage...
...just yet.
zh:
看看这辆MR2，它是如此地谦逊、低调。
在意大利，有着像Urraco这样的猛兽，以公牛的名字命
名，或是同样出名的Merak。
这些姿色出众的好车需要你拥有强大的气场才能驾驭。
这样说吧，就算你知道如何伺候好它们，还是会冷不防
地被它们回咬上一口。
这辆MR2相比之下就服帖多了。你说什么，它就做什么。
当��了，服帖不代表盲从，踩下油门的那一刻，你会瞬
间飞入云端！
拥有如此体贴入微的驾驶体验，怎么的驾驶方法都不会
出错。
这样的它，会让你想将之迎入家中，也迎入你的心里。
你可以在这里或那里瞥见一些与法拉利类似的元素
……但骨子里仍是日本人的谦逊有礼。
也许这反映出了当时的日本设计师的理解，认_��自己的
设计还没有达到世界级的水平
……但是只是暂时没有而已。,

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally
just mud flaps that attached to the tires.
Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be
integrated into the bodies.
And eventually the body sides came to be
cut out in the shape of the tires.
In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...
...is structured as a large volume that completely
integrates the fender and doors.
And �t shows the enormous traction to accommodate
the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.
It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was
moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.
The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these
glamorous fenders.
This is how an American Sports car should be!
zh:
在汽车设计的漫长历史中，
挡泥板最初只是用于阻挡掀起的泥土的轮胎挡板。
但到了二战前后，设计师开始将挡泥板与车身融为一体。
为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。
不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！
它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……
以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强�:�的牵引力。
这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。
Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂�e
这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
The 997 restores some of what was lost in the transition from
the 993 to the 996, while adding some subtle upgrades.
A few of these elements have become something that is
unique to Porsche.
A good example of this is where the turn signals are integrated
with the bumper's air intake opening.
Such refined details may be small by themselves, however they
increase the overall quality and uniformity of the design.
zh:
997这款车带回了保时捷从993过渡到996时失去的
一些东西，并对细节做了部分改进。
其中的一些升级最终成为了保时捷的标准元素。
这里有一个很好的例子，就是将转向灯与保险杠的进风
口融为一体。
这些改进本身可能很微小，但提高了设计的品质，还有助
于提升车辆的整体性。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster
a timeless design.
It’s full of that sentiment that compels owners
to wish their car a goodnight.
I've even heard of fans who chose to sleep in it
the very first day they had it in their garage.
Truly, it’s a car you’ll christen, throw birthday parties for
and one day lovingly restore.
zh:
你知道吗，从一开始我就想让这款敞篷跑车成为永不褪
色的设计。
我希望它能完整传递一种情绪，让车主们会在睡前对自
己的爱车道“晚安”……
而且我确实听说过有车迷在买完车的第一天，睡在了车
里。
我希望这是一辆你会特地为它取名、为它庆生的车，并
在某一天将它恢复到最佳状态……

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
There was this one time when I received a wedding invitation
from a total stranger living in Texas.
I thought, "Maybe it's an owner of a Roadster?"
So, I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas.
I found out that the happy couple owned a red car and a
white car, and met each other at that very club!
Unfortunately, I wasn't able to attend the wedding...
...but a year later, I received a note that they had a
baby tog�ther!
So I painted a miniature model of a Roadster in pink
and sent it to them.
Being able to connect with owners like this is really
gratifying as a designer.
It's the result of everyone who became involved with this car
being able to share their passion.
zh:
有一次，我收到一封喜帖，是住在德克萨斯的陌生人寄
来的。
我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了
德克萨斯的敞篷跑车俱乐部。
我发现这对夫妇就是通过俱乐部认识的，他们一个人开
红车，一个人开白车
很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，
然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个�
宝！
于是我涂了一个粉色的敞篷跑车模型送给他们。
可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。
如果没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这样的美事。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
The design is modified with larger grilles and sporty bumpers,
side skirts and 17-inch alloy wheels.
It also reflects the original vintage livery with red stripes and
other colored elements like the mirrors and brake calipers.
And the two large, enameled badges on the front and rear
show the original colors of the famous Scorpio logo.
But the most exciting thing...
...is the fantastic “sound design” coming from the
rear dual exhausts!
zh:
在升级方面，阿巴斯500的设计采用了更大的格栅、运动型保
险杠、侧裙和17英寸铝合金轮毂。
而且还引入了象征原版复古涂装的红色条纹以及应用于
后视镜和刹车卡钳的其他色彩元素。
车前和车后两个精美无比的大型珐琅徽章展示了品牌原
版配色的著名天蝎座标志。
但最激动人心的……
当属来自后段双出排气管的美妙的“声音设计”！?

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
The C4 Corvette had plenty of innovation, both on
the inside and outside.
Its design was a marked departure from the curvier C3,
being more angular and wedged-shaped.
This was evident in the clamshell hood
and in the headlamp construction.
Under the hood was a powerful 4-valve DOHC engine.
The ZR-1 also came equipped with wider rear tires and fenders.
The interior was inspired by aircraft design.
Some people say that the C4 lacked
the "soul" of a Corvette.
But I happen to like it plenty.
zh:
C4科尔维特在内部和外部加入了很多创新点。
它有着楔型的车身，更加有棱有角，与C3科尔维特的
波浪状线条相去甚远。
其掀盖式的引擎盖和头灯的结构就是最好的证明。
ZR-1配备了更宽的后胎和后挡泥板……
以便驯服动力强劲的双顶置凸轮轴 4气门引擎。
其内饰的灵感很大程度来源于飞机。
很多人评论说C4科尔维特缺少了一点科尔维特的魂。
但我恰好挺喜欢这款车的。

speaker: Chris
en:
The C4 Corvette ZR-1 is a famously speedy Corvette.
It set seven international and world records in the 1990s.
In fact, its speed record went unmatched for more than
two decades.
The V-8 engine developed in conjunction with Lotus
was truly impressive and high powered...
...producing over  more than the standard model.
All in all, it's a car that's even more valuable than
its price would suggest.
zh:
这辆C4科尔维特ZR-1快如闪电的名气谁人不知，谁人不晓。
它在二十世纪九十年代总计创下了7项世界纪录。
事实上，这个无人能及的速度纪录保持了超过20年。
这款车上装载了与莲花跑车公司一同研制的V8发动机，动力强
劲、令人惊艳，
比标准版的动力提高了不止。
我要说的是，它的售价远远不能代表其真正的价值。

speaker: Chris
en:
The first-generation Viper was initially offered as
an open-top model.
That was the RT/10.
This GTS was introduced later as the coupe version.
The coupe’s structure improved rigidity,
which in turn enhanced handling.
Lamborghini was also involved in the development
of the V10 engine.
Viewed in that context, it was a remarkably cost-effective
performance car.
zh:
上市的第一代Viper首先推出的是敞篷车。
型号是“RT/10”吧。
这个GTS版本是改良后的双座跑车版本。
车身更加坚固，操纵感也更强。
兰博基尼也参与了它的V10发动机的研发。
如果从这个角度去想，这可是一辆性价比非常高的车。

speaker: Chris
en:
Now, this is one of the true icons of the industry, one that
changed the history of sports cars in the world.It has attractive styling, a top that can
be folded down easily...
...and the cockpit space is just snug. Oh, and its price
at the time of release was very affordable.
But above all, the market for convertible lightweight
sports cars...
...was quickly decreasing at the time. It was a dark time
for enthusiasts.
This was the savior that revived this entire genre of cars.
zh:
这辆车是一面真正的旗帜，你甚至可以说它改变了赛车
的历史。
还是那家喻户晓的造型，加上方便折叠的顶篷和舒适无
比的座舱，
还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。
能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场
在当时已几近消亡。
这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。

speaker: Chris
en:
This car is based on the RX-VISION that was introduced at the
2015 Tokyo Motor Show.
It's powered by a 4-rotor engine, and you can immediately tell
from its shape that it's a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive car.
This was the future vision of the rotary sports car.
And now, this RX-VISION was made into a race car.
The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4-rotor
rotary called the SKYACTIV-R.
The weight of the car is , and it
produces .
It truly feels like the return of the legendary 787B
as a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive model!$
zh:
这辆车是基于2015年在东京车展上推出的一款名为
“RX-VISION”的汽车。
它由一部四转子引擎提供动力，而且你可以从车的外形
上看出来，这是一款前置引擎后轮驱动的汽车。
在当时，这是对转子发动机跑车的未来展望。
而如今，这款RX-VISION终于被改成了一辆赛车。
引擎是被命名为创驰蓝天-R的四转子自然进气引擎。
整车重量为，引擎功率为。
看到它，就让人觉得传奇的787B跑车以前置引擎、后轮
驱动的形式王者归来了！

speaker: Chris
en:
The Lancer Evo series really improved its handling performance
from this Evo V generation.
The body was made wider to incorporate the wider track.
The tires were wider wrapped around 17-inch wheels,
and Brembo brake calipers were standard.
It was one of the greatest 4WD sports cars of the world.
zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列是从翼豪陆神V这一代开始大幅改善它的转弯
性能的。
车身变得更宽，以便扩大胎距，
而且换上了17英寸轮毂，全系标配了布雷博刹车卡钳。
我概括一下，它是全世界开起来最棒的车之一。

speaker: Chris
en:
The "Romance of Minus 21 Seconds."
That was the slogan for the R33 Skyline GT-R.
In a time trial on the Nürburgring Nordschleife...
...it improved on the lap time of the previous GT-R,
the R32, by a full 21 seconds.
It was a phrase that reflected the development effort
that went into the R33 GT-R.
I think stories like that are part of the
magical nature of the R33 GT-R.
zh:
缩短了21秒的浪漫”。
这是R33 Skyline GT-R广告口号。
在纽博格林北侧赛道的一次计时赛中，
R33 Skyline GT-R将前辈车型R32 GT-R的单圈成绩消掉了
整整21秒。
这条口号也反映出了日产为研发R33 GT-R所做的所有
投入。
我认为正是这样的故事让R33 GT-R这款车更有价值。

speaker: Chris
en:
This is a truly historic car, and an extremely valuable one.
Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of
a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.
In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points
in every race that season...
...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.
It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine
to claim the title in the GT Championships.
zh:
这可是一台历史悠久的车了……而且极其珍贵。
埃里克·科马斯就是坐在这辆GT-R赛车里夺得1999年
全日本GT锦标赛车手总冠军的。
这辆Pennzoil赛车在那个赛季的每站比赛中都获得了积分，
并在当年的7场比赛中4次登上领奖台。
这也是最后一辆搭载RB26DETT引擎获得该项赛事冠军的GT-R。

speaker: Chris
en:
With a body as compact as the S13 two generations earlier...
...this car combined sharp styling with excellent balance.
Equipped with a turbocharged engine, it produced a respectable .
It also competed in Japan’s GT Championship series.
It proved to be an ideal base for drifting builds, offering
strong performance value for enthusiasts.
zh:
随着Silvia重新回归两代之前，S13时期的紧凑车身设计，
整体造型变得集造型优美和完美匀称于一身。
涡轮增压则使这款车能够输出令人惊叹的。
这辆车不仅作为赛车参加了全日本房车锦标赛，
同时也是漂移改装车的绝佳基础车型。可以这么说，
你付出的每一分价格都能带来无上的乐趣。

speaker: Chris
en:
This is a sports car that made no compromises.
It embodied the Porsche spirit.
The 997 GT3, after 2008, produced twice the downforce
than the previous car.
Also, the engines and brakes were even more powerful.
Not only that, it utlilized an engine crankcase that was
developed for racing since their air-cooled models.
It's definitely a precious car today.
zh:
这是一辆不折不扣，毫不妥协、绝对纯粹的保时捷跑车。
2008年之后的997 GT3的下压力提高了一倍，
引擎功率和刹车也更加强大。
不仅如此，它所使用的发动机曲轴箱是从风冷技术时代
就不断积累研发的赛车用版本。
毫无疑问，这既是一颗璀璨的宝石。:

speaker: Chris
en:
The only notable difference with the standard 964 Carrera
is the  lower ride height.
You may not notice that because it's very discreet.
At a glance you would think it was a standard 964.
But that's another element that woos the fans
of the 964 911 Carrera RS.
It's extremely pure to say the least. There are no comfort
items here at all.
As a result, it's  lighter, and its handling
is razor sharp.
I'm certain it will continue to rise in value over time.
It's definitely one of the best of the best.?
zh:
这款车与标准的964 Carrera唯一明显的视觉差异是
离地间隙又降低了。
如果没注意到这个差异，
你可能会错以为这是台标准版本的964。
但是，令964 911 Carrera RS的铁粉们
疯狂的要点在于
它的极致简化配置，完全摒弃了
装饰件和舒适性功能。
其结果便是高达的减重，以及如同手术刀般
犀利的操控。
这款车的价值无疑会持续攀高，
因为它绝对是一辆好车中的好车。

speaker: Chris
en:
It's fast, affordable, and manageable in size.
This is truly one of the great production sports cars ever.
The second-generation MR2 that made its debut in 1989
kept being improved over the years.
This is the final version, with its power boosted
to a mighty .
And thanks to the mid-engine layout, its handling is remarkably
straightforward.
This is a car that has more value than its price indicates.
zh:
价格在可承受的范围之内，尺寸可控且速度很快，
它确确实实是最好的量产跑车之一。
第二代MR2于1989年首次亮相，之后多年来一直在不断
改进。
这一台是系列的巅峰之作，功率提高到了令人心驰神往
的，
操控方面也是相当直截了当。
就这辆车而言，其价值远大于售价，太划算了。

speaker: Chris
en:
The most appealing aspect of the AE86 is the experience it
offered to spirited-driving enthusiasts.
It was a rear-wheel-drive coupe that offered excellent control
and a highly engaging drive.
In the well-known Japanese comic series “Initial D,”
the sister model, the Trueno, took center stage.
However, many enthusiasts favored the Levin.
One reason was weight.
The Levin, with its fixed headlights, was approximately
 lighter than the Trueno.
In a car this light, an extra  over the front axle could make
a noticeable difference in handling.
zh:
AE86最吸引人的要素朴实无华，就在于它的驾驶感。
这是一款操纵感极强的后驱双门轿车，给驾驶者带来非
常多的乐趣。
著名的日本漫画《头文字D》就将雷凌的姐妹车Trueno
作为了主角车。
但在现实里，大部分人会更青睐雷凌。
原因在于车重的差异。
配有固定头灯的雷凌要比Trueno轻。
在这么轻的车头上多出的，会带来天差地别的影响。

speaker: Chris
en:
This is the 1997 winner of the All Japan GT Championships.
It's a truly valuable race car indeed.
It's also famed for being the first car to take the title from the
Nissan teams, which were dominating the GT Championships.
The Tom's Supra first appeared in 1994, which means
it took four years for them to reach this point.
With a glorious race history and historical value,
this is a treasure for sure.
zh:
这款赛车是1997年全日本房车锦标赛的冠军车，是一辆
真正有价值的赛车。
它也是第一辆从一直统治该项锦标赛的
日产手中夺走冠军头衔的赛车。
这款TOM's Supra于1994年亮相，花费了整整四年时间
才取得了如此殊荣。
兼具辉煌的赛史和极高的历史价值，这辆车必定是一笔
珍贵财富。

speaker: Chris
resolved_car_en: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
resolved_car_zh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
en:
The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.
It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.
Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.
The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).
It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.
It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.
zh:
经过了很长一段时间的沉寂后，GR雅力士是丰田100%
自主研发的第一辆新跑车。
碳纤维车顶和坚固的车身都是专门为这款车设计的，
引擎和四驱系统也是如此。
这辆从头打造的赛车就是冲着世界拉力锦标赛去的。
驾驶它的感觉非常美妙，不是吗？我认为在比它贵上一
倍的车也不一定具备如此高的性能水准。
我相信这是一款会在车史上留下印记的车型。

speaker: Chris
en:
This car is the same. It has a powerful engine and is
extremely lightweight. It's also quick and agile.
It can go toe-to-toe with sports cars with twice
the price tag.
It's a true heir to the Abarth tradition.
zh:
这款车轻盈而敏捷，引擎动力充沛，
甚至能够和价格是自己两倍的跑车比拼速度。
它是阿巴斯传统的真正继承者。

speaker: Stella
en:
A viper is a type of poisonous snake, right?
It suits the image of the car.
Although I think the front end looks a bit cute in its own way.
But when you sit in the driver’s seat, it’s hard to judge
where the front of the car ends.
I suppose that’s because the engine is so large.-
zh:
知道吗，Viper这个词其实是一种毒蛇的名字？用来
形容这款车倒是很贴切。
尽管我觉得这款车的前脸看上去还挺可爱的。
可是当你坐进驾驶室里的时候绝对会大吃一惊，因为你
很难看到这辆车的车头究竟在哪里……
我猜这是因为它的引擎实在太大了！

speaker: Stella
en:
This car looks beautiful from every angle.
It's a real work of art.
I see, it’s a special Mazda concept car.
You can tell right away it’s a sports car,
but it’s so elegant and refined.
The engine sound is a real surprise!
I didn’t know an engine could sound so crisp and clear.
zh:
无论从哪个角度看，这辆车都是那么的漂亮迷人。
我知道了！所以这是一辆马自达的特别概念赛车！
我是说，你一眼就能看出这是一辆跑车，但它的外形是那么优雅，
那么让人目眩神迷。
可是发动机的声音真的是让人大吃一惊！
我从来不知道发动机也可以发出如此清脆的声音！%

speaker: Stella
en:
This car...it's named after a mounted knight with a lance.
And this is the fifth-generation version?
I can tell by its appearance that
it's not slow or modest.
It gained fame in the World Rally Championship
and enjoyed popularity across the globe? Impressive!
This is a really nice car, I hope you take good care of it!
zh:
所以说这款车是以一位手持长枪的骑士命名的……
而且这是第五代车款了？
一看外表就知道，它肯定不是一辆慢吞吞的老爷车。
哇哦，所以它在世界拉力锦标赛上一举成名，接着在
全世界都很受欢迎。
这真是一辆好车呀。希望你能好好照顾它哦。

speaker: Stella
en:
You know when you look at this car from an angle
it looks like an Italian car, it's so beautiful.
Huh, what's with this gauge that’s mounted in
this weird position?
Ohh, so they've already got a place for the boost gauge
for the turbo.
With the boost gauge in your face like that
It probably makes you wanna drive faster!
zh:
你从某个角度看这辆车的时候，它就像一台意大利车那
样美丽。
嗯？安装在这个奇怪位置的仪表是怎么回事？
哦哦，所以他们为涡轮增压表特意找了一个位置。
像这样把仪表装在你面前，大概会让你想要开得更快吧！

speaker: Stella
en:
A GT3 is basically like a race car, right?
Or at least just as fast? That's what I heard.
It looks like any other Porsche at first glance, but people
who know can tell the difference, right?
It’s not flashy, but it drives like a true race car.
That’s seriously cool.
zh:
GT3其实是一辆赛车，是不是？还是说和赛车一样快？
我好像听说过它的。
在我看来这就像别的保时捷一样……
懂车的人才能分辨出来，是不是？
没有那么拉风，但开起来像真的赛车一样，非常酷！

speaker: Stella
en:
It looks like a really compact supercar.
It’s sleek and looks really cool.
So, the engine is in the back? It’s a two-seater and
pretty tight inside.
Wow, but it has a decent-sized trunk—not bad!
zh:
这款车一眼看上去就是辆紧凑版超跑。
流线型的车身非常的酷。
所以发动机放在后面？这是部两座车，里面很紧凑。
哇喔，但是后备箱还是挺大的，不错！

speaker: Stella
resolved_car_en: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
resolved_car_zh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
en:
It's not big, but you just can ignore it.
Ah, I see. This GR Yaris was made for motorsports.
I guess it does look like a sports car,
and it's no slouch out on the track.
It's nice that it's also good for everyday use—I mean,
you can even sit in the back!
zh:
这辆车虽然小巧玲珑，但实力却不可小觑。
噢，原来是这样。这辆GR雅力士是专为赛车运动而生的。
它看上去确实就是一辆跑车，在赛道上表现得也不弱。
而且日常使用也非常好开，我说真的，后排也能坐人！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Three days after its introduction at the 2019 Paris Motor Show...
...this car competed in the eighth round of the
Nürburgring Endurance Series.
It qualified 2nd and finished 5th overall in the race—
an impressive result right out of the box.
As it had not yet been commercially released,
it entered the SPX class for test cars.
The R8 LMS Evo demonstrated its potential from
the very beginning.
It went on to compete successfully in GT racing series
around the world.'
zh:
在2019年巴黎车展上公布后仅3天，这辆车就出现在
纽博格林耐力系列赛的第8轮比赛中！
它在排位赛中获得总成绩第二名，在决赛中获得总成绩
第五名。作为初出茅庐的新车，这个成绩还不错吧？
因为这款车还没正式上市销售，所以它作为测试车参加
SPX级的比赛。
总而言之，R8 LMS Evo从一开始就完全展示了它的肌肉。
之后也继续在世界各地的超级跑车比赛中再创佳绩。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Have you ever heard of the German ADAC GT Masters?
It's a race where each car has a pair of drivers,
one amateur and one pro.
For the 2016 ADAC Masters, Chevrolet entered a
Corvette C7 FIA-GT3.
The following year, they claimed both driver and
team championships.
This is a car that an amateur can handle, but which can
also withstand any punishment a pro can throw at it.
Yep, in terms of performance, this Corvette C7 Gr.3
machine is quite something.
zh:
你听说过全德汽车协会超跑大师赛？
这是一场需要两位车手：一位新人车手、一位资深车手
交替参赛的比赛。
在2016年的全德汽车协会大师赛中，雪佛兰派出了科尔维特C7 国际汽联-GT3。
在之后一年，他们同时拿下了车手和车队总冠军。
这台车不仅操控平易近人，适合新手，又能经受住专业
选手的“折磨”。
可以肯定，科尔维特C7组别3在性能方面很有一套。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Lamborghini actually never really got into motorsports
as a manufacturer over the yearsBut when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the
Huracán in 2015... ...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit! It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.And it totally left the other cars in the dust,
finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.The car was actually disqualified at one point
because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.But the team appealed and won,
and so did the GT3's in its debut race.
zh:
你知道么？兰博基尼作为一家制造商，其实很多年
都没有真正参加过赛车运动了。
但他们积极做出了改变，在2015年基于Huracán打造了
这款国际汽联-GT3，
终于把它们的车送上了赛道！
它在2015年的宝珀耐力系列赛上首次亮相，
就让它的对手们完全望尘莫及，以比第二名快了30秒的
成绩夺� �了冠军。
实际上，他们在比赛中一度被取消了资格，因为赛会判
定他们的加油设备出现了违规。
但是他们的上诉成功了，最终在首秀中就赢得了冠军。@

speaker: Jeremy
en:
You know, the R33 GT-R always reminds me of Le Mans in 1995.
At the time, regulations prevented cars from entering if
a four-door version existed in the lineup.
So, Nissan developed a special 2-door “NISMO GT-R LM."
It was registered in the U.K. to meet homologation requirements.
And Nissan succeeded in entering the car at Le Mans.
It showed just how determined team manager, Kozo Watanabe was...
...to see the GT-R compete in the race.
zh:
说起R33 GT-R，总是让我想起
1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
因为当时的勒芒规则明确规定：
若某车系拥有四门版本，则其赛车不得参赛。
为此，日产特别打造了一辆双门版的日产赛车国际GT-R LM，
在英国注册并通过了赛事认证，
这才成功将这辆车送上了勒芒的起跑线。
由此可见，这辆GT-R的研发主管渡边衡三
让其参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的意愿是何等强烈！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Ah, Car No. 1, this one brings back memories.
It’s the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R that competed
in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship.
Érik Comas drove the No. 23 Pennzoil GT-R to victory...
...earning the No. 1 designation for the following season.
Oh, and here’s a bit of trivia,
if you’re interested.
Many Nissan GT race cars carry the number 23, right?
That number comes from the Japanese pronunciation of 2-3 (ni-san).
It’s a long-standing tradition for Nissan race cars to wear
this number, seen well before 1999.
zh:
哎，这不是冠军车吗？我知道这辆车！
这是参加过1999年全日本房车锦标赛的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R！
驾驶Pennzoil23号车的埃里克·科马斯拿到了最后比赛的胜利，
艰辛地为这辆车守住了宝贵的冠军。
对了，关于这辆车还有一件轶闻，
有兴趣听听吗？
有很多日产的超级跑车都是23号对不对？但第一辆使用
23作为号码的……
没错，就是1998年的这辆Pennzoil！.

speaker: Jeremy
en:
So, this is the GR Supra that entered the Nürburgring 24 Hour
race just a month after it went on sale?
Did you know that the President of Toyota Motor Company himself,
Akio "Morizo" Toyoda drove the first stint in the final race?
He was the guy who brought this GR Supra to life!
The car was basically stock, with just minimal
safety equipment necessary to race.
But it still managed to place 41st overall and 3rd in class.
It showcased the solid reliability and performance
of the GR Supra.
zh:
所以这就是刚刚上市一个月就去参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛
的GR Supra……
你知道在决赛中驾驶第一赛段的车手不是别人，
正是丰田的总裁丰田章男吗？
事实上，就是他让这辆GR Supra复活的！
这辆参赛的Supra基本上就是一台零售车型，只配备了
比赛所需的最低限度安全设备，
但它还是获得了第41名的总成绩，并在同级车中排名第3。
这样的成绩完全显示出了
GR Supra的卓越性能。

speaker: Jeremy
resolved_car_en: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
resolved_car_zh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
en:
The Yaris WRC totally dominated the World Rally Championships.
It won the Manufacturers Championship in 2018...
...and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well, with a
record six wins. The most for the series.
This GR Yaris was developed specifically to dominate
in the rally championship, which it did!
After developing this competition car to win at the WRC,
a production version was planned for homologation.
Whether you're a fan of racing or not, you'll find
that this car is one amazing machine!
zh:
雅力士世界拉力是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。
它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，
在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。
我们可以确定的是，这辆GR雅力士是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！
他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。
不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！

speaker: Chris
en:
The Volkswagen Type 1 is one little car that made
a big splash in automotive history.
Designed as a functional civilian car by none other than
Ferdinand Porsche…
...its distinctive rounded shape resulted in the nickname,
"Beetle."
Its production run spanned more than 60 years, producing
21,529,464 units from the 1940s to the early 2000s.
Thus, the Type 1 is considered one of the most historically
significant cars ever.
zh:
这是一款在汽车史上掀起巨大波澜的小型车。这款车正是由费迪南德·保时捷所设计的
实用型民用车……
由于其独特的造型，获得了“甲壳虫”的昵称。
Type 1是久盛不衰的经典车型，
在汽车产业热销超过60年……
从20世纪40年代到21世纪初，
总共卖出了21,529,464辆……

speaker: Chris
en:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's
most popular compact cars.
It was introduced in Britain in 1959.
Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged
over the course of its 40-year production history.
In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini
we see here.
Although double the size of its classic predecessor,
its handling and styling were pure Mini.
Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations
were actually developed by BMW.
The German manufacturer did a commendable job
maintaining the spirit of the original car.
zh:
迷你毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。
1959年在英国问世……
经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。
直到2001年才推出新一代迷你，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。
尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的迷你水准。
迷你本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自宝马之手。
制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。

speaker: Chris
en:
Combining a light, compact body with a responsive
rear-wheel-drive chassis...
...and a peppy 1.8-liter inline-4 engine is the S13 Silvia,
one of the most popular FR Japanese sports cars ever.
Not only was it elegantly styled, it was one of the best
handling machines around.
Today, the popularity of these cars has not waned.
In fact, some consider the S13 to be priceless!
zh:
这轻巧紧凑的车身与响应迅速的后轮驱动底盘相结合……
加上强劲的1.8升直列四缸引擎，这台S13 Silvia
简直是面面俱到的前置后驱跑车。
不仅停放时姿态优雅，转弯时同样美得让人窒息。
现如今，这款车确实非同寻常。
老实说，S13本身就是无价之宝！

speaker: Chris
en:
While the standard 208 GTi was undeniably small
and light, it did offer loads of fun to the driver.
This Peugeot Sport-engineered version takes the driving
experience to a whole other level.
Its exquisite chassis is stable and responsive.
On even extremely twisty mountain roads,
the car was an absolute pleasure to drive.
In fact, its amazing chassis is reason enough to add this car
in your collection.
zh:
虽然标准规格的208 GTi无疑是一款小而轻巧的车型，
驾驶起来却趣味无穷……
这款标致运动精心设计的款式，更将驾驶体验
带到了一个全新的高度。
精细的底盘设置给人以无与伦比的稳重感……
即便是行驶在最蜿蜒的山间道路上，
都能让人尽享驾驶妙趣。
老实说，仅凭其优秀的底盘，
就值得你去收藏这辆车了。

speaker: Chris
en:
The sixth-generation Camaro was a well-built machine,
especially the SS version.
It came equipped with the same 6.2-liter LT1 engine that was
introduced in the Corvette.
The handling was nothing short of exceptional, making it
feel at home on winding roads.
Honestly, for all it offers, it's really quite reasonably
priced.
zh:
第六代科迈罗工艺精湛，
特别是这款具备SS等级的制作。
这款车搭载了6.2升LT1引擎，
这款引擎曾首次亮相于科尔维特车型上。
其操控性堪称卓越，在蜿蜒起伏之间，
驾驶体验更加刺激。
坦白说，这款车提供的这一切，
确实对得起这个价。

speaker: Chris
en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"
They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.
The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.
Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.
Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
�engines, it offered plenty of top-end power.
With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.
Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
coveted�for generations.
zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？
这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。
第一代科迈罗Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……
但其专为泛美系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。
不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。
不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让科迈罗Z28
在特兰斯·艾姆竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。
这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。

speaker: Chris
en:
This sixth-generation ZL1 may be the most valuable Camaro
of all time.
Taking its engine from the Corvette Z06,
the ZL1 produced more than .
This "1LE Package" was designed and tuned
to shine on the race track.
And did it ever. It completed a lap of the Nürburgring
Nordschleife in 7:16:04!
That's a worthy time for a supercar, mind you.
And yet it's about a third of the price of your average super
car, so you'll be getting a lot for your money!
zh:
这款第六代ZL1可能有史以来最有价值的科迈罗车型了。
ZL1搭载的引擎来自科尔维特Z06，能产生超过的功率。
配备了专为赛道性能需求打造的
“1LE套件”。
令人难以置信的是，它以7:16:04的成绩跑完了
纽博格林北侧单圈赛道！
要知道，这可是超跑级别的成绩！
然而，其价格仅是寻常超跑的1/3，
绝对带给你极高的性价比！

speaker: Chris
en:
There's nothing like an M car from BMW. The first-generation M3
is mostly associated with racing.
The final model was this "Sport Evolution," which was quite
popular.
It is distinguished by its upgraded 2.5-liter engine
and rear spoilers.
At first glance, the mods may seem slight, but
those in the know will tell you otherwise.
Oh yeah, these cars were impressive indeed.
Not too many of the original M3s were produced, so you can
expect their prices will increase with time.
zh:
哦，一辆宝马M系列的车……
第一代M3最适合拿来竞赛了。
这款“运动进化”是最终型号，备受欢迎。
这款车的特点是升级过的2.5升引擎以及尾部扰流板。
乍一看，好像只是些细微改动，但实则不然。
呵呵！实际上这车型深藏不露……
这款车的产量不多，所以价格
只会不断往上涨。

speaker: Chris
en:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW
M3 series that began with the E30.
Its pride is in its engine.
It's the only M3 to come equipped with a menacing V-8 engine.
At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V-10s built for F1 racing...
But the speed and torque achieved by this high-precision V-8
was nothing to dismiss.
What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its inline-6 predecessor.
Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
the powerplant alone.
zh:
这款E92 M3是宝马M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。
这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……
是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。
在研发这款车型时，宝马仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……
但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。
更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。
确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！

speaker: Chris
en:
Ford's F-Series is the most popular line of pickup trucks
in North America.
And the Raptor is by far the highest performance model
of the bunch.
One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing,
therefore, the truck possesses sports-car-like handling.
The Raptor boasts a wide body, reinforced suspension and a
6.2-liter V-8 capable of producing more than .
Put this beast in its element, and it'll shatter your notion
of how fast a truck can go.
zh:
福特的“F系列”车型是北美最流行的皮卡。
猛禽是该系列中迄今性能最强大的一款车型。
它的设计理念之一便是强化在越野赛中的性能表现，
这使得它与其他贴地的跑车截然不同。
猛禽不仅有宽车体、强化的悬挂系统，
还有一台能输出以上的6.2升V8引擎。
只要将这头野兽的本领发挥出来，
您对于卡车能跑多快的认识一定会被击碎。

speaker: Chris
en:
Here we have a seventh-generation Corvette,
or "C7" for short.
If I'm not mistaken, the C7 made its debut in 2013,
at the North American International Auto Show.
And seeing as how the original Corvette was born in 1953…
...the timing of its release lined up nicely with the Corvette's
60th anniversary.
Even in its basic package, the C7 boasted a powerful
race car engine.
You won't find any European sports car that delivers
so much "bang" for the buck.
If you ask me, I'd say it's a real deal for a sports car!
zh:
这是一台第七代科尔维特——
简称“C7”。
如果我没记错的话，C7的首次露面是在2013年的底特律车展上。
1953年是初代科尔维特诞生的年份……
这辆车亮相的日子正好是那款车的60周年纪念日。
C7连基本版都搭载了一台强劲的赛车引擎。
用同样的价钱，你绝对找不到能出这么大力的欧洲产跑车。
要我说，对于一款跑车而言，这辆车绝对物超所值！

speaker: Chris
en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."
Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.
Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of .
Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires� giving it superior traction.
Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!
This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。
保时捷汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，
然后将其倾注到了这台930型911的涡轮上。
相比79年版，这款车的排气量提升到了3.3升，动力也增加至了。
由于911是一辆后置引擎的跑车，其后轮承受的重量更多，
产生的抓地力也更大。
在这些基础上，涡轮增压器更是大幅增加了这辆车的进气量！
这辆930在保时捷众多杰作中占有一席之地，非常有收藏价值。

speaker: Chris
en:
Now, there's a beauty! This isn’t just any Supra, you know.
It's known as a "homologation model," meaning
it was developed primarily as a race car.
Toyota's reason for creating it was to win the Group A
title in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.
To ensure it was battle-ready, the engineers performed
various mechanical upgrades.
These included a turbine and intercooler, as well as parts
�or naturally-aspirated and turbocharged engines.
As a result, the Turbo A produced  more
than the base model.
With production capped at 500 units, this homologation model
sold out in the blink of an eye.
Aside from the wheel color and bumper shape, it doesn’t
look too different from its forebear.
However, those in the know will instantly
recognize its worth.
zh:
天啊！这可不是一辆普通的Supra……
这是一辆为竞赛而生的“赛事认证”型。
丰田当时想用这辆车夺得日本房车锦标赛的A组别桂冠。
为了准备这项赛事，这辆车得到了多处机械升级。
这些升级包括一台涡轮机和中冷器，以及
自然吸气和涡轮增压发动机的部件。
这些升级使v��辆车的马力比基础车型提高了。
由于生产上限是500辆，“赛事认证”型转眼间就卖光了。
除了轮毂颜色和保险杠形状之外，
它的外形与基本型完全一样。
然而，有眼光的人
肯定一眼就能看出它的价值！

speaker: Chris
en:
The 300 SL, which was introduced in the 1950s, is considered
a masterpiece of Mercedes-Benz engineering to this day.
This SLS AMG brings that legendary vehicle to
the 21st century.
And, it revives the most iconic feature of the 300 SL, which
are those gullwing doors!
Under the sheet metal, the chassis is all modern, highlighted
by a highly-rigid and lightweight aluminum space frame..
It possesses an FR layout, complete with a transaxle,
meaning that the gearbox is located at the rear.
This allows for an ideal front/rear weight distribution that
makes this car extremely balanced through corners.
As the successor to the 300 SL, one can only imagine that
its value will continue to rise.
zh:
300 SL在上世纪五十年代亮相时
被认为是梅赛德斯-奔驰的工程杰作。
这辆SLS AMG将那辆口碑载道的传奇带回到了21世纪。
它甚至让300 SL最具标志性特色——鸥翼门复活了！
这辆车的底盘采用了现代的设计，
由高硬度和轻质的铝制空间框架构成。
它搭载了一台发动机自然吸气V8发动机，
能够输{��的强大动力。
尽管这辆车采用了前置后驱布局，但其变速箱
位于后部；这意味着它有跨轴传动。
这种设计让理想的重量分布成为了可能，
从而改善了这辆车在直线和弯道上性能！
作为300 SL的后继者，这辆车的价值
肯定会水涨船高吧。

speaker: Jeremy
resolved_car_en: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
resolved_car_zh: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
en:
The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.
The man responsible for its development was
Kozo Watanabe.
A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned
a degree in automotive engineering.
The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.
A longtime admirer of race car development...
Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.
But fate i�tervened and he began working for Nissan,
which was then racing the R380 and the R381.
When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33
Skyline GT-R...
...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed
of the R32.
It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33
set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!
This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap
set by the R32.
The R33 then led to the R34, �hich carried on the
spirit of its predecessor.
zh:
这辆R34是第五代的Skyline GT-R。
这辆车的设计者是渡边衡三。
他毕业于东大汽车工程系。
R34是R33的后继车型。
渡边早对赛车开发早就心痒不已……
他本想前往英国去设计F1赛车。
由于这个目标未能实现，他进入了
当时正在使用R380和R381竞赛的日产工作。
当渡边接到了设计Skyline GT-R R33的任务时……
他曾发誓要造一辆比R32更快的车。
您猜怎么着？在试跑时，R33在纽博格林赛道上
跑出了7:59的单圈时间！
比R32的记录快了21秒。
当然了，它的后继者R34身上也继承了这种精神。

speaker: Jeremy
resolved_car_en: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
resolved_car_zh: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
en:
The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race held in
Colorado, USA.
It is a race in which drivers compete for the fastest time
up a long and treacherous mountain road.
The course measures , climbing  to the finish
at —higher than Mount Fuji in Japan!
This Audi S1 shattered records with its victory at
the storied event.
Based on a WRC ma�hine, it featured large wings at the
front and rear, ensuring maximum downforce.
But who was the driver behind the wheel on that winding
“Race to the Clouds?"
Why, it was none other than WRC champion
Walter Röhrl!
zh:
派克峰爬坡赛是在美国科罗拉多州举办的比赛。
这是一场车手们需要在漫长而险峻的山路上
达成最快时间记录的赛事。
这条赛道长达，海拔始于，终于——比日本的富士山还要高！
这辆奥迪S1以破纪录的成绩在这场著名赛事中获得了胜利。
基于一辆世y��拉力锦标赛赛车，这辆车前后
都配备了巨大的定风翼，以获得最大的下压力。
那么驾驶这辆车，沿着蜿蜒的山路，
勇敢地“冲上云霄”的人是谁呢？
这个人正是�界拉力锦标赛的冠军沃尔特·罗尔！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.
Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class,
where it performed exceedingly well.
In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen
consecutive years!
But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place
for most of the race.
People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three,
breaking its long streak of po�ium finishes
But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota,
experienced a mechanical problem.
This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish
its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!
Ultimately, the streak came to an end when Audi announced
its withdrawal from Le Mans the following year.
zh:
奥迪在1999年首次亮相勒芒。
一直到2016年，奥迪在勒芒原型车1级级别的比赛中表现得非常出色。
事实上，奥迪已经连续18年登上领奖台了！
但就在去年，R18在比赛终段时仍然是第四名。
大家都觉得奥迪今年登台无望了。
然而，距离比赛结束还有10分钟时，领头的�.田出现了机械故障！
这让R18挤进了第三位，站上了领奖台，
并达成了连续18年登上领奖台的记录。
最终，由于奥迪宣布从那年的勒芒赛事中退出，
他们的连胜纪录�v就此终结。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
“Rotary engines are notorious for their poor fuel economy,
making them ill-suited for endurance races.”
At least, this is what people in the racing world had believed.
But the engineers at Mazda took a different view.
So, they got together and created the R26B engine,
which emphasized horsepower over torque.
This decision effectively made it a durable
and fuel-efficient engine.
The 4-�otor engine found a home in the now-legendary 787B.
It was the first Japanese car to claim the overall title
at Le Mans in 1991.
Jonny Herbert, the driver who drove
the final three stints...
...was so dehydrated after the race that he was unable
to make the podium.
As for the engine, when Mazda's engineers took it apart, they
apparently saw that it could have gone another 500 km!
zh:
转子引擎的油耗高得吓人，所以不适合耐力赛。”
赛车界曾是这样看待转子引擎的。
但是马自达的工程师们却不这么认为！
他们努力的结晶便是将重点放在马力上，
而不是扭矩上的R26B引擎。
这项明智的决定使这台引擎不仅可靠，而且省油。
这台传奇的发动机就装在了这台787B上。
于1991年q��它成为了第一台在勒芒夺冠的日本车。
不幸的是，约翰尼·赫伯特在开完最后三段后……
由于严重脱水，无法站上领奖台。
赛后，当马自达的工程师将引擎拆开时，
他们发现这台引擎还能再跑！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Porsche has contributed greatly to motorsport over the
years, as a manufacturer and seller to privateers.
Even in the world's fastest racing category, which is
the sports prototype class...
It entered races as a factory team while also
selling its race cars to privateers.
Indeed, Porsche's widespread support of race
culture is an integral part of its legacy.
This is evidenced by the history o� the 956 and 962,
two Group C models from the early 1980s.
Although the 962’s factory team withdrew from competition
in 1988...
...the cars continued racing for private teams.
It's said that Porsche manufactured 150 examples
of the 956 and 962 for competition.*
zh:
多年来，保时捷作为制造商和私人销售商，
对汽车运动做出了巨大贡献。
即使在参与世界上最快的赛事，运动原型赛事的同时……
他们在把赛车卖给私人的同时，还在运营着一支工厂队伍。
事实上，保时捷对赛车文化的广泛支持已经成了其遗产的一部。
这一点可以从956和962这两款
80年代初的C组别�#�型的历史中看出来。
虽然962的工厂队伍在1988年退出了竞技舞台……
私人车队却仍然在使用那些车竞赛。
据说，在保时捷的赛车生涯期间，�
他们一共生产了150辆956和962。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.
Does that sound odd to you?
It should, because the second-generation NSX production
car was released two years later in 2016.
There's simple explanation to this.
The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on
the NSX Concept...
...which was unveiled ahead of the production version
in 2014.
�And, it was this concept car that took
the GT name.
In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car
was officially released.
Because of this, the competition car was also called
the NSX-GT.
This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the
Super GT in Japan.
zh:
这台第二代NSX-GT于2014年首次亮相。
听起来不觉得有些奇怪吗？
毕竟，它的基本车型，第二代NSX，在2016年才开始销售。
实际上，这辆车既是NSX，也不是NSX。
这是因为，它的原型车是一辆叫做NSX Concept的车……
那辆车是在本田于2014年，在其生产型出现前公布的。
然而，继x��GT名号的依然是一辆赛车！
2016年中，第二代NSX正式发布。
因此，这款赛车也被称为NSX-GT。
作为概念时代的最后一款特规车型，
这款车在日本Super GT第五轮比赛中获得了第三名。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
When it comes to R35 GT-R race cars, the Nissan MOTUL
AUTECH GT-R is perhaps the best of them all!
It won two consecutive Super GT championships in the GT500
class, starting in 2014.
It also began the 2016 season in unbelievable
form.
It took the first two races, at Okayama and the
Fuji International Speedway, respectively.
These victories made it the odds-on favorite to win its
t�ird series champion in a row.
The car was atop the rankings going into the final race...
However, because of the ballast it was required to carry,
it could only manage a 7th-place finish in the race.
This meant that it ended the season in
3rd place for the series.
The MOTUL Autech team did give it all it had,
but just came up a little short.
The drivers were Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie �uintarelli.
They showed amazing speed all season long, and today,
they're still at it and still winning races!
zh:
说起R35 GT-R赛车的话，
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R绝对是其中的王者。
从2014年开始，这辆车已经在GT500级别的
Super GT锦标赛中连续获胜了两次。
它在2016赛季中的开局也是势不可挡……
在冈山的第一场和富士赛道的第二场中接连获胜！
在当时看来，这辆车拿下第三个锦标赛冠军已经是板上钉钉的事了��
在赛事进行到最后一场时，它在排名中依然名列前茅……
但是沉重的压舱物使它在这场比赛中惜败，只获得了第七名。
这意味着，这辆车在这个季度中仅以第三名完赛。
他们没能上演帽子戏法，真是太可惜了！
不过，松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利的老司机团队无疑是非常快的！
他们俩现在�8�已步入四十，但却依然没有一丝慢下来的迹象！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.
Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack
flags waving all around the track.
It was a sight I'll never forget.
This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.
It finally got the better of the Porsches that had
dominated Le Mans for so long.
It certainly put a smile on the legions of Brit�sh fans.
But they first had to endure a stressful race.
It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away
the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.
Just thinking of it now sends � chill down my spine.
zh:
1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛相当不平凡。
那年，大批来自英国的捷豹车迷涌入赛场，
赛道上的米字旗四处可见。
我永远也忘不了那番景象！
而那天为捷豹赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……
他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的保时捷。
这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。
萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！
那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的捷豹到最后
都一直面临着身后保时捷的压力！
光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...
...was created to accomplish just one goal.
And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.
Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.
In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.
One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.
He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.
His view on the matter was:
"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……
他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。
那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。
传说这辆车非常难驾驭……
实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。
传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。
对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！
他对此的看法是：
“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”i

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This is a race car version of Mercedes-Benz's luxury sedan,
the 300 SEL.
The 300 SEL caught the eye of Mercedes-Benz tuner, AMG...
Who tweaked it to racing spec by increasing the engine
displacement to 6.8L.
It made its race debut in July 1971...
...in a European Touring Car Championship race at Spa-
Francorchamps in Belgium.
It won its class there, and finished in a�very impressive
2nd place overall.
Pretty amazing for a large, 4-door sedan!
This result put AMG on the map, and gave it worldwide
prominence.
AMG would go on to play a key role in Me�cedes-Benz's
race teams at the DTM and elsewhere.
zh:
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰的豪华轿车300 SEL的赛车版本。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的改装商AMG慧眼发掘了300 SEL。
AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。
它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……
在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，
它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总��绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。
对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。
这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。
在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中、
在包括德国房车大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Renault is a company that loves to compete.
It has been involved in many forms of motorsport,
including Formula 1.
It was also formidable in the rallying world, alongside
cars such as the Gordini and the Alpine from the 70s.
The 1980s, though, the company was all about this R5 Turbo.
One of its early drivers, Jean Ragnotti, mentioned that the
car suffered from terrible handling.
He also confessed that misjudgments on narrow roads would
always cause the rear of the car to hit objects.
This is because the rear of the R5 Turbo was wider than the
front.
It's amusing to hear seasoned pros complain about aspects
of a car they don't like.
zh:
雷诺是一家热爱竞技的公司。
他们会参与各项赛车运动，F1自然也在其列。
他们的拉力赛血统包括Gordini，以及1970年代的阿尔派。
而到了20世纪80年代，主角就成了R5 Turbo。
作为早期驾驶者之一的让·拉格诺蒂提到过，车辆原本的
操控性非常糟糕。
他还坦言，在狭窄的道路上，车尾常常会因为车手的错
误判断而导致碰撞。
这是因为R5 Turbo的车尾比车头宽。
听到经验丰富的专业人员也会遇到这类问题，真是很有
意思！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about Nissan's entry
in the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2015.
It was this GT-R LM NISMO.
The designer, Ben Bowlby, insisted on an FF layout and
focused on the car's aerodynamics.
Unfortunately, these innovations didn't pay off.
In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.
Then, in the race itself, two of three cars retired, meaning
only one was able to make it to the finish line.
But this car didn't complete enough laps, so in the end
it was DNFed (Did Not Finish)!$
zh:
听说日产要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！
在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，
设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。
不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。
在排位赛中，该车比第一名慢了足有20秒。
雪上加霜的是，参加正赛的三辆车中有两辆不得不退赛，
这意味着只有一辆车最终到达了终点。
而且，就连这位通过终点线的车手也因为没有完成足够
的圈数而被判定为未完成比赛！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
What happened in June 1972 was pretty unusual by anyone's
standards.
It was the second race of the popular Fuji Grand Champion
Series, which took place on the Fuji International Speedway.
And, despite being up against Gr.6 and Gr.7 race cars...
...a lower-level machine based on a production model managed
to emerge victorious!
The car was a Fairlady 240ZG, and its driver
was Japan's Ha�uhito Yanagida.
The race took place in heavy rain, and the 240ZG performed
exceptionally against its higher-ranked rivals.
And yes indeed, it beat all of the other entries.
The event became known in Japan as the "Z in the Rain" race, and
remains one of the most legendary moments in motorsports.
zh:
在任何人看来，1972年6月发生的事情都是非比寻常的
奇迹。
当时，人气十足的富士大冠军赛的第二场比赛正在富士
高速赛道上如火如荼地举行。
面对组别6和组别7类别的对手……
一辆基于零售车型改装的低级别汽车却杀出重围、斩获
了胜利！
这辆车是一辆Fairlady 240ZG，车手是日本的柳田春人}��
在大雨滂沱的赛场上，240ZG在与高等级对手的较量中
表现得异常出色……
最终以第一名的成绩冲过终点线！
这场比赛在日本被称为“雨中的Z”，是赛车运动中最具
传奇色彩的时刻之一。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The Tour de Corse?
It's a famous rally event that takes place on the
French island of Corsica.
The 1964 Tour de Corse was particularly a classic.
Only eight cars out of 79 managed to complete the race!
What's more, Renault's R8 Gordini claimed 1st, 3rd,
4th and 5th place!
It was quite the remarkable achievement.
Gordini was an engine manufacturer, originally established
by the Italian driver and engineer Amedeo Gordini.
The R8 Gordini came about through a collaboration with
Renault.
zh:
科西嘉岛拉力赛？
嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。
1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。
79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！
而雷诺的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！
这是相当了不起的成就。
戈迪尼是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈迪尼一手创办。
R8 Gordini就是其与雷诺合作的产物。;

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...
...with its first victory coming in 2018.
While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.
There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!
The victorious Porsche team�couldn't believe its luck.
In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!
What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!
zh:
自2012年以来，丰田一直致力于将混合动力赛车投入
到勒芒的比赛当中……
他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。
在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。
不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的丰田却在离终点只剩z��一圈时抛锚了！
就连捡漏的保时捷车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。
不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！
更激动人心的是，丰田在之后的五年里连战连捷，
其中也包括2022年新鲜出炉的一胜！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese
motorsports.
I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly
built Suzuka Circuit.
If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed
"Yota-Hachi" was the finest...
...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi
Circuit in July 1965.
The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the
driver was Tojiro Ukiya.
After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback,
moving up through the field to win the race!
There was something almos� divine about the performance he
displayed that day.
zh:
这是一辆来自日本赛车运动早期的传奇汽车。
我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！
如果你要问我“丰田八”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……
那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。
这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。
在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏z��他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。
然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩
他在那天表现出的速度简直如有神助！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck,
capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.
Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.
It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.
It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.
Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundra�tuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.
And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?
In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars fi�ished.
zh:
这不是一辆普通的皮卡车。这是一辆真正的超级卡车，
在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！
一提到坦途，我就会想到巴哈1000沙漠越野赛。
这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达的比赛
全部在夜晚举行。
这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车
辆会因为各种原因退赛。
�丰田公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，
并在本级别中揽获冠军。
此外，你知道坦途丰田赛车开发中心也曾在椭圆赛道上比试过吗？
2019年，它参加了在戴通纳举行的生存赛，在一场32辆
汽车中只有9辆完赛的比赛中取得最终的胜利。

speaker: Stella
en:
This Demio is Mazda’s entry in the compact
car marketplace.
It was sold outside of Japan as the "Mazda2"
and it proved to be a big hit.
So the car was reintroduced to the Japanese market in 2019
with that very name.
Mazda is famous for its beautiful rear-wheel sports cars...
...and its legendary race cars that have won titles
the world over.
I'm sure that you'll run into one eventually!
zh:
这款Demio是马自达对紧凑型汽车市场的贡献。
实际上它在日本以外被称为“马自达2”......
以至于它在2019年重新进入日本市场时，也叫回了这个名字！
马自达旗下的名车既有优雅的后轮驱动跑车......
也有在全世界范围包揽冠军头衔的传奇赛车。
我相信你以后会遇到一辆这样的车！

speaker: Stella
en:
When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.
Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...
...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.
This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.
The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.
The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.
And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.
zh:
当MINI于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。
此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……
它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，
最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。
因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。
MINI的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。
这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Porsche is a mainstay of the WEC, which is short for the
World Endurance Championship.
Currently, Porsche's entry in this series is the 911 RSR.
The car competes in both the LMP1 and LM-GTE classes.
As you can imagine, the 911 is a force to be reckoned with
because of its speed and reliability.
While contesting for overall victories in the LMP1 class,
it also looked to grab the top spot in the GT class.
This particular 911 RSR competed in the WEC and IMSA
in 2017.
It received a bit of backlash from Porsche
enthusiasts, however.
That’s because its engine is mounted amidships,
and not at the rear.
Therefore, many hardcore enthusiasts cried foul,
saying that it wasn't a real 911.
Still, the new engine location did improve
the car’s stability at high speed.
And the resulting change in weight distribution is said to
have dramatically reduc�d tire friction.
Seen in this light, the alterations make sense.
Porsche is there to win, after all.]
zh:
一贯以来，保时捷都是世界耐力锦标赛，即“世界耐力锦标赛”的冠军有
力争夺者之一。
其发布的911 RSR同时参加了
勒芒原型车1级和LM-GTE两个级别的比赛。
如您预想得到的，作为保时捷毋庸置疑的旗舰，
911在追求勒芒原型车1级级别的全面胜利的同时，也向GT级别的头名
发起了挑战。
这辆911 RSR��2017年参加了世界耐力锦标赛和国际汽车运动协会的一系列比赛，
但也受到了保时捷车迷群体的一些质疑。
这是因为它的引擎被安装在车体中部，而不是后部。
很多硬核车迷们会说，“真正的”911必须是后置引擎。
但不得不说，中置布局确实改善了赛车的高速稳定性……
而且，据说这样的重量分配调整极大地减少了轮胎摩损。
从这个角度来看，这些改变是可以理解的。毕竟，
保时捷就是为了赢得比赛而生的。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The V12 Vantage GT3 made its first appearance
in 2012 at the British GT Championships.
The car was totally at home running races in its native
country, leaving the competition behind.
In more than 67 races in seven seasons,
the V12 Vantage found the podium nearly every time!
What’s more, in more than 30 percent of its races,
it took the checkered flag.
Needless to say, it will be�remembered as a legendary
race car in the annals of GT3 history.
Up until 2019, when it passed the baton
to its V-8-powered successor...
...this incredible car consistently enjoyed life at the
forefront of GT racing.
zh:
V12 Vantage GT3在2012年的
英国GT锦标赛上初露峥嵘。
你来猜猜它的主场表现如何？
在七个赛季的67场比赛中，它几乎每次都能登上领奖台。
更夸张的是，它在超过三成的比赛中
站上了最高领奖台！
毋庸置疑，这是一台
值得被铭记在GT3历史中的传奇赛车。
事实上，直到2019年，它才把接力棒
传给它的V8车型继任者……
这辆了不起的赛车将其漫长的职业生涯都献给了GT赛事
的最前线。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse
is to build something small and light.
But this M6 GT3 breaks the mold, with a total length that is
 longer than that of the production model.
The wheelbase has also been extended.
Many wondered if the extra length of the car would
diminish its handling ability.
That concern was wiped clean when racers first
drove the car.
They praised it for its precise balance and
sm�oth turning feel.
And their findings were soon backed up by results.
The M6 GT3 drove to a magnificent win on
the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018.
At the wheel then was Japanese touring-car
ace Seiji Ara.
It was a truly incredible race to behold.
zh:
说到赛车设计，人们很自然地会想到小而轻的竞速机器。
但是这辆M6 GT3却反其道而行之——
它的车身长度比量产车型还要长出！
它的轴距嘛，当然也很长！
这样的设计让人不由地担心起它的过弯能力来。
然而，开过它的车手却不是这么说的……
他们对车辆的精确操控和平顺过弯能力赞不绝口。
你还是不相信？
那我告诉你一个事实，日本房车赛传奇车手荒圣治驾驶着它
于2018年在狭窄的澳门大奖赛赛道上
取得了一场辉煌的胜利……
这是一场令人难以置信的比赛，精彩程度令人叹为观止！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The one thing race enthusiasts love about BMW...
...is their long-standing commitment to developing
customer race cars like this one here.
When a new production car is released, you can
expect a race-ready version to offered pretty quickly.
This Z4 GT3 made its biggest impression...
...at endurance races like the Nürburgring 24 Hours.
There, it was driven by BMW works drivers
Bruno Spengler and Timo Glock.
Part of what makes BMW so cool is that it can be
assertive without coming off as arrogant.
The company exudes confidence because it lets
its results speak for themselves.
zh:
赛车迷对宝马最津津乐道的就是……
他们长期以来致力于开发客制赛车，就比如我们眼前的
这台。
每当宝马有新款量产车发布时，你可以期待赛事规格的
车型很快会接踵而至。
这辆Z4 GT3在纽博格林24小时耐力赛等多项耐力赛事中……
给人留下了深刻的印象……
在纽博格林，宝马派出的是冠军车手布鲁诺·斯宾格勒和
蒂姆·格洛克。
在比赛方面，宝马从来只用事实说话，
那自然流露的自信而不自负的气质显得尤为卓尔不群。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?
It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.
It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.
It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.
But I digress.
The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Jap�nese GT races from 2004 to 2009.
At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.
The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in �ound 8 race.
zh:
你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。
这是真的，是Epson委托日本纸模艺术家筱崎仁帮他们打造的。
这个纸模全部由硬纸板做成，甚至连轮胎和其他的圆形
部件也不例外。
这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！
……咳咳，不好意思跑题了。
Epson涂装的NSX真车�加了2004年到2009年期间的
全日本GT赛事。
当时正是全日本GT锦标赛向国际Super GT系列赛转型的阶段。
这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出了第二名的好成绩。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
What, you don’t think that I know this car?
It’s the SLS AMG GT3!
The first customer race car in Mercedes-Benz’s
long and storied history.
It was produced in an era when Mercedes race cars were out
of reach for most privateers.
But the SLS AMG GT3 changed all that.
And its speed and reliability made it a formidable
weapon for privateers the world over.
The SLS AMG GT 3 has really competed in
many, many GT races over the years.
zh:
什么？你以为我不认识这辆车？
开什么玩笑，这可是SLS AMG GT3啊！
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰那漫长而传奇的历史当中的首款客制赛车！
在那之前，大部分的私人车队都没机会入手
这样一辆梅赛德斯赛车。
不过，SLS AMG GT3的出现改变了历史。
凭借可靠且强劲的速度，它成为了全球各地私人车手手
中最强力的武器。
这款SLS AMG GT3参加过的超跑比赛数不胜数！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
It all goes back some 90 years,
to the Eifel race of 1934.
Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed
 too heavy for competition.
To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's
paint, exposing its aluminum body.
It was this silver-colored car
that ended up winning the race.
This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming
a symbol for racing excellence.
Sinc� then, silver has been Germany’s national
racing color.
Of course, sponsorship liveries are much
more common today.
And race cars painted in their national colors
are very much a thing of the past.
But if you’re interested in racing history, you should
look into the national race colors of other countries.
zh:
这个故事要说回到90多年前，那是1934年的埃菲尔比赛……
当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重，无法参加比赛。
为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。
最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！
于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！
�4那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！
当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。
采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。
不过，如果你对F1的历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.
Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.
Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.
That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.
We needed to retain the essence and spirit
of notab�e Nissans of the past...
...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.
The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.
And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints
of the SP Fairlady in the body section.
All of this made the Z33 more modern
and possess different proportions than the S30...
...but I feel it's still instantly
recognizable as a Z from any angle.
zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。
因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。
作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……
但又不能太“复古”。
因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……
再以完善的现代特征进行展现。
它的设计v��言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。
而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。
这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。
但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
In some ways, the Z34 is more classic in overall styling
than the Z33.
The wheelbase has been shortened by ...
...giving it long-nose proportions.
The shape of the roof,
and the window graphics with the peak at the very front...
...also adopt the S30's design basic theme.
In contrast, the massive rear fender that squeezes the shape
of the body from front to rear...
...aims to g�ve this car a level of aggressiveness never
before seen on a Z.
There were challenges on how to evolve the Z33's styling.
If the Z33 represented a modern and more
elegant design theme...
...then the Z34's look is one that's a more authentic of an
FR sports car with added aggressiveness.
zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。
首先，轴距缩短了……
显得车头相对更长。
其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……
则特意延续了S30的设计风格。
相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……
令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。
当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。
简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……
Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.
From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?
I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...
...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.
In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one pers�n.
The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.
In those terms...
...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."
I would seriously love to add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。
你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？
我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。
虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。
事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。
它需要工程技师和模{��师之间的通力合作。
因此……
我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。
我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负担不起的天价了。<

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
Ah, this is the 2017 model, after the second minor change.
This front design was actually...
...a reproduction of the GT-R Proto that we displayed
at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show.
We felt that the graphic theme of the GT-R Proto might be a bit
too aggressive for a car making its first ever appearance...
This design was born from us saying, "Let's try one
more time to express the design in a different way."
The 2017 car has a very complete look to it, and
I do like it myself.
Also, regarding the interior,
it has a modern design with depth and good textures.
zh:
哦，这是2017年的车型，经历了第二次“小”改款。
前部车身的设计其实取自……
我们在2005年东京车展上展出的GT-R 原型概念赛车。
当时，我们觉得作为一款首次亮相的车型，
设计有些过于激进……
于是搁置了这个设计方案，等待时机成熟。
正如你现在所看到的，时机到了。
2017年车型的外观设计完成度很高，我自己也很满意。
我也非常喜欢现代感十足的新内饰，
我们对材质的应用很到位。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
Look at the tight cabin and the position of the rear engine.
It's stunning.
The front fascia is particularly eye-catching.
The ridge that runs down the hood...
...really provides the vehicle with a unique feel.
It's so very French.
But then, it has large fog lamps for rallying...
...and air scoops at the rear have been flawlessly incorporated.
These details that sugges� it's a competition vehicle
give it its exquisite character.
In terms of design, there are places where the balance is not
good, but when seeing the car up close, you don't mind at all.
In fact, it's those things that give this car visual impact.
This type of visual allure,
you can't achieve in today's cars.
This car is a true masterpiece, one that I would love to
add to my collection.
zh:
这辆车确实令人叹为观止，请关注紧凑的车厢和
后置引擎的位置。
从正前方看时尤其如此，
因为沿着引擎盖向下延伸的中脊线很有时尚感。
我觉得它非常有“法式风情”。
不过，它同时还配备了用于拉力赛的大雾灯……
以及精心布置的进气口。
这些赛车的美学设计都为它赋予了精��的特征。
从设计角度来看，有些部件似乎不那么平衡，
但凑近看时不仅不会让人这么觉得，
甚至是为这辆车带来了某种视觉冲击感。
它的许多设计在现今的汽车中确实已经不多见了。
这是一项真正的大师之作，我很想把它纳入我的收藏。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
This is a masterpiece of Japanese car design.
To be honest, the S30 was developed as a hatchback coupe,
rather than a sports car.
There's plenty of cabin space.
Overall headroom is generous for a pure sports car.
Still, it looks very sporty,
meaning it is a very special design.
Take the proportion, line, and surface...
...in many ways, the design of this car says
"it can only be done this way.�
But what is most impressive is...
...is its purity.
It exudes a high sense of Japanese beauty.
The look of the nose is modern.
It's a design that's distinctly Japanese,
unlike any other car from the U.S. or Europe.
The S30 is unmistakably a design that represents Japan.
From the latter half of the 1960s and on,
more than a few amazing sports-car designs were created in Japan.
In that day, there were man� motivated
and talented young designers inside Japanese car companies.
They borrowed the best parts of Western design elements,
while keeping their own unique character.
I pay respect to the achievements of all of them, especially
Yoshihiko Matsuo-san, who recently passed away.
zh:
这辆车可是日本汽车设计的杰作之一！
严格来讲，S30是作为一款掀背式双门轿跑车开发的，
而不是一款跑车。
如你所见，这辆车的车厢空间很大……
而且与纯粹的跑车相比，头顶空间更富裕。
不过，得益于其卓越的设计，它看起来还是动力十足。
此车的一切——车身比例、线条和外观表面……
无不{��显着“纯正”二字。
但最为出众的……
还是其体现着日式设计美学的优雅和精致。
以其现代化的车头设计为例。
与美式或欧洲的设计都不相同，极具日本车特色。
S30就是一台纯粹的日系车。
从六十年代晚期开始，日本设计出了无数台跑车杰作。
当时的日本汽车公司汇聚了许多位
热忱且有才华的年轻设计�3。
他们从西方设计中汲取精华，
但又保留了自己独特的感受力。
这些设计师都值得我们尊敬。
尤其值得一提的一位，便是最近去世的松尾良彦。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
Whoa, now this is most impressive!　
The GT1 Turbo specs, brought on by some powerful tuning,
has separated this automobile from the base model.
Because of that, the design of the original automobile...
...has been engulfed by the almost violent nature of the
added-on parts...
...greatly changing its essence.
The S2000 was originally designed to make the front
overhangs appear short...
...but the contrasting proportion of the nose,
with its wedged shape design on this car...
...was only possible because of the front mid-engine layout
of the S2000.
There's a lot of room for the intervention of design,
especially in the details.
And, one can say that its taste comes from a perceived
absence of design, making this car a lovable monster.\
zh:
这辆车令人非常印象深刻！
在接受了大量强化调校后，这辆GT1 Turbo spec已经变得
与基础车型截然不同。
你可以明显看出，几乎称得上是“暴力”的改装件
彻底颠覆了原车的模样，
可以说已经是台完全不同的车了！
虽说S2000的设计初衷是缩短前悬距……
但Amuse的最终成果却有悖常理地造就了GT1的长车头比例！
不得不说，它在细节和其他设计元素方面都有
长足的改进空间……
但这些“简陋”的呈现反而成了萌点，
使它成为了一头可爱的怪兽。<next id=2001006 type

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
About Pagani's design...
...its approach is quite different
from other traditional car makers from Modena.
Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati...
...most of their designs are born from
historic cars that were on sale in the 1960s and 1970s...
...with body styles that were designed by a carrozzeria in Turin.
When the Zonda was introduced, at the end of the 1990s, the era
of designs that shined�30 years before in Turin had concluded...
...thus, Pagani adopted its own unique design language.
It wasn't as if it was leaving all of its rivals in the
past at once...
...but it sought to wrap sophisticated mechanisms
with an attractive body, without being too flamboyant.
That kind of balance is what defines Pagani, I feel.
zh:
帕加尼的设计方法……
和来自摩德纳的其他传统汽车制造商大相径庭。
以法拉利、兰博基尼、玛莎拉蒂等为例，
他们的大部分设计都来自于在20世纪60年代和70年代
亮相的历史名车……
这些车的车身大多是交给都灵的车身制造商设计的。
当Zonda于20世纪90年代末期发布时，
持续30余年的都灵设计�(代已经告一段落……
所以帕加尼首次采用了自己的设计语言。
倒不是说它将过去的对手彻底甩在了身后，
但它确实做出了创新尝试，将复杂的机械构造
装入具有吸引力、同时又不会过于喧宾夺主的车身当中。
这也造就了帕加尼设计特有的平衡感。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
Oh boy, this is just crazy!
That "5" I loved so much, what happened?
Just because it wanted to go fast in rallies,
it didn't have to sell its soul to the devil!
It has become  wider, and if you look at it from the
rear, it looks like a laughing Cheshire Cat.
And because the engine is mounted at the rear,
it only seats two now.
But wait...
...upon closer examination, aside from th� bulging fenders and
bumpers, oh my, much of the original 5 is still there, as is.
Aside from the cheeks, the car has a gentle face,
which means, it's more Clark Kent than the Hulk.
I mean, what kind of magic is this?
The interior of the Turbo 1
features a super modern Mario Bellini design.
This thing would be stylish, even in Paris!
Oh my! I think I've fallen in love with this crazy 5�
Somebody, anybody, gimme some of this magic on my own 5.
zh:
这真是太疯狂了！
他们对我熟悉的那台可爱的小“5”做了什么？
为了让它在拉力赛中有所建树，就非得
把它的灵魂出卖给魔鬼吗？
你看，它的车身整整变宽了。
从背后看过去，就像一只咧嘴笑的柴郡猫。
由于搭载了一台后置引擎，它现在只剩下两个座位了。
等一下……
细看下来，除了�起的挡泥板和保险杠以外——
哦，原版小“5”的大部分特征基本还是保留了！
不看侧面的话，它的前脸还是和原来一样，
所以还是更像肌肉分明的超人，而不是大块头绿巨人。
他们这是施展了什么样的巫术啊？
Turbo 1的内饰采用了马里奥·贝里尼设计的超现代风格。
就算走上巴黎的T台都不会显得格格不入！
哦，天呐！我想我已经爱上了这辆疯狂的小“5”。
事实上，我愿意接受它的一切！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
Usually, when using the elements of
an existing car to create a variant...
...you usually hit it with a completely design to differentiate
it from the original, so they don't occupy the same market.
This is done to avoid cannibalism.
That's why, from the designer's point of view, although in
theory it may be possible, you dare not just carry over a design.
It's like you're not doing your job.
But considering the playful spirit and freedom of will of
car guys, this act can't be ignored.
Nope. These days, just about anything goes!
In North America, when the merging of auto makers and their
brands happened early on, this sort of thing was very common.
Things like customization and the diversification
and maturity of the autotmotive culture...
...it all comes down to the passion of the customers.
zh:
通常情况下，在设计一款当前车款的衍生车型时……
你会想应用一些新的设计，使其与基础车型作出区分。
换句话说，你会希望避免与原车型发生直接竞争。
所以对于设计师而言，借鉴设计元素通常是业界大忌，
会让人觉得设计师根本没有尽职尽责地去设计。
但是对于追求玩趣、想象力z��富的怪咖设计师来说，
这种手法却是不可或缺的。
事实上，现在的汽车设计已经是百无禁忌！
在北美，随着汽车厂商及其品牌的并购，
这种做法已经变得司空见惯。
这种风潮代表了定制和汽车文化的多样性和成熟化……
它是以消费者的热情为第一驱动力的。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
You know, I used to drive my friend's
PGC10 GT-R a lot.
That’s what got me into sports sedans, which I consider to be
a "wolf in sheep’s clothing".
Now, this here is the model that set the basic formula
for the modern GT-R.
At first glance, it evokes a clear sense of volume.
And by weighing down the rear fender, the designers
made the car look like it was in motion even when st�nding still.
This allowed the GT-R to strike a more aggressive stance
than the base GT model.
Also...
...it marked the beginning of the era of sensor-controlled
vehicle dynamics and other high-performance technologies.
All of this makes the current GT-R the rightful heir
to this R32 GTR.
zh:
我过去常常开我朋友的PGC10 GT-R，所以对它非常熟悉。
运动型轿车给人一种“披着羊皮的狼”的感觉，
这正是这种车型最吸引我的地方。
我现在要介绍的这款车为现代GT-R确立了基本范式。
首先，它表现出一种清晰的体积感。
然后，设计师通过压低后挡板的重心，
让此车有一种蹲伏起跑、跃v��欲试的感觉。
从而赋予了GT-R超越GT的定位。
此外……
从这个型号开始，由传感器来控制车辆动力
和其他高性能附加套件的时代揭开了序幕。
这一切都足以证明这台R32 GT-R正是当代GT-R系列的鼻祖。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
I got a call one day from my protégé at Mazda Design asking
for my thoughts on the design of the fourth-gen Miata.
I told him that I wrote a scenario for the first three
generations at the beginning of the NA project.
I normally look forward 20-25 years ahead
from the start of a project.
Therefore, I had no ideas for the fourth-gen car,
except the following:
 If it was to be mec�anically similar,
then the design should...
...differ more from the NA to NB, and NB to NC.
If the car was to be mechanically new...
...with an innovative layout or different type of
powertrain, then it should be evolutionary.
 I never got to see the design of the
fourth-gen development at any stage.
When I asked the designers how things were going?
Their answer was always...
“Don’t worry, you guided us
to do the right thing.”
 They actually didn't want to show me the car...
...even on the night before
the world premiere event.
Enough was enough, so I made my stand.
 I told them that
“You know that I can't keep a poker face.”
"Whatever I see or feel shows on my face.
I can't help it."
"Can you risk that happening tomorrow?”
They thought about that for a moment,
and they came to the correct conclusion.
They finally showed me the car, and do you know
what I th�ught?
The fourth-generation car was designed in the right
direction, indeed.
zh:
有一天，我接到来自在马自达设计工作的一位弟子的电话。
他询问我是否为第四代Miata Roadster做过类似的设计规划。
我有个习惯，每当我开启一个项目时，
我都会尝试想象它在之后20年里的演变。
所以我是这样告诉他的。
我说，我在NA项目启动的时候，就已经
为前三代都写好了方案……
但对于第四代而言……
我暂时没有什么具体的想法。
不过我又补充了一句，
如果机械结构上没有太大变化的话，那么设计方面……
相较于从NA到NB以及从NB到NC的演化，
应该体现出更大的变化。
此外……
如果这辆车在机械结构上是全新的，
应用了创新的布局或不同的传动系统……
那么在外观方面也应该体现出充分的演化。
在此之后，我��直没机会参与到第四代Roadster的开发当中。
每当我询问设计师们事情进展如何时，他们都会叫我放心。
“不用担心，”他们总是这样说。
“您给我们指出了一条正确的道路。”
事实上，直到新车全球首发的前一天晚上，
他们都还在想方设法对我保密。
我后来忍不住了。
我对他们说：“我是个藏不住事的人。
万一明天我一不小心当众露�7�失望表情，你们打算怎么办？”
他们这才让我看到了新车，你猜怎么着？
第四代的设计方向走得很踏实。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
I have a soft spot for the M3.
I was involved on the first E30 M3...
...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.
Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,
and the M3 became M4.
I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.
This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...
...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package.
It has the right amount of details like front air intakes
that cool the brakes...
...to side air-outlets with the M accent.
It has an extremely athletic look
that exemplifies sporty and elegant design.
zh:
我对M3情有独钟。
当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……
我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。
现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被宝马改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。
但我仍然喜欢M3。
它是目的性最明确的宝马……
其设计主旨与M性能套件的运动精神完全契合。
细节�&�的配置也相当到位，例如冷却刹车的前进气口……
以及带有“M”系凌厉风格的侧面进气风道。
仿佛一位穿上设计师品牌运动外套的运动员，
集运动和时尚优雅于一身。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
My buddy had bought one when it came out.
I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.
It possessed all the right components that make a sports car.
But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...
...just like the original FIAT 500.
I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter.
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.
However, it became notchy often.
That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...
...without the notchiness, of course.
zh:
我正好有位朋友在这部车发售时买过一辆。
我记得当时我就被这台漂亮的引擎给打动了。
它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，
只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。
就像原版的菲亚特500一样！
我真的太喜欢它这台短行程的5速手动变速器了。
它可以为你提供扎实、机械的手感……
虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。
是它帮助我下定决心为Miata配备了短行程变速箱……
当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
I was also involved with the design of the “FD."
I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above
the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it.
If Mazda were to develop a next-generation
RX model...
...I expected that it would have to have a mid-engine layout
at a much higher price point.
Then, when the FD replacement project started.
 I was torn because we were going to replace the
timeless design of the FD...
...with a completely new one.
Luckily, it became 4-seater and a totally different concept.
zh:
我确实参与了“FD”的一部分工作。
当时，我们都以为它会是我们挚爱的RX-7系车型
的最后一款……
而且，如果要开发下一代的话……
应该会采用中置引擎布局，还要调高售价。
再后来，FD的替换项目启动了。
一开始我有点纠结，因为我们不得不把我心目中
永不过时的设计……
替换成一个全新的设计。
幸好，最终的4座车车型
成功展现出了完全不同的概念。'

speaker: Sarah
en:
Yes! It's a design where the rear of the body appears to
abruptly cut off.
Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.
Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.
Therein lies the reason why this particular design is called
the "Kamm Tail."
We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.?
zh:
没错！采用这种设计的汽车后部就像
被整齐地切掉一块。
卡姆式与流线型车身设计很接近，而且都以
优秀的空气动力学效应闻名。
这一设计是由斯图加特大学的乌尼巴尔·卡姆博士
于上世纪30年代提出的，
随即以设计者的名字冠名。
在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“断尾”。
