speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
The plexiglass headlights on the early models and...
...design elements such as the orange indicator lights that
extend on the side...
...are defining symbols of this car.
Also, the grooves that flow in a straight line on the side
of the car are...
...implemented on most Ferraris that followed this car.
The star-shaped 5-spoke aluminum wheels are also important
symbols of Ferrari's design.
Yes, yes. This wheel originated from a sports prototype car
from the 1960s...
...and was first used on the Daytona.
zh:
早期车型上的有机玻璃大灯和……
侧面的橙色指示灯
之类的设计元素……
都是这款车的主要特征之一。
此外，请注意那些直线形的凹槽……
在此之后被应用到了大多数法拉利上。
星形的五辐铝制车轮也是法拉利设计的重要标志。
事实上，这种轮毂样式源于20世纪60年代设计……
并在戴通纳比赛中投入使用的一台原型跑车。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
This is a car that I had a hand in
styling when I was with Renault Design!
When I designed
the Mégane III series with my team...
...we decided right from the start to make
the coupe version with the RS variant in mind.
Thus, the original design is already very compact...
...and extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with a sloping rear
window and a bold and dynamic rear pillar.
Obviously, the large alloy wheels, mod�fied bumpers...
...and the big rear central exhaust
contribute to making it even more aggressive.
But the most successful detail is...
...undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the
front grille, which integ�ates the daytime running lights.*
zh:
这辆车的造型还是我在雷诺设计工作时经手设计的！
当我和我的团队一起设计梅甘娜III系列时……
从一开始就决定追加设计一个RS版本。
这是一辆紧凑到极致的三门小钢炮，有着大坡度后窗
和动态十足的C柱，
以及显著改造过的后保险杠……
还有汇集到尾部正中的大号排气管，让它更显侵略性。
但最成功的细节……
无疑是前格栅里受F1赛车启发的悬浮翼片，
我们将它直接与日间行车灯整合到了一起。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern
8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.
And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.
 Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989,
including the derivative version, the 328.
Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came
from an extremely balanced and pure design.
It's almost timeless.
It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design
philosophy applied to�the cars of the Cavallino.
In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino
246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...
...and the iconic side air intake,
but also the dynamic rear pillars.
And, of course, the truncated tail with
four round taillights.
However, all of it was transformed into a very essential
and modern shaping for the time.
zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。
它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。
如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。
这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。
在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……
还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。
它甚至复兴了Dino 246的经典元素，如外扩的轮拱……
标志性的侧面进气口，动态的C柱……
还包括带有四个圆形尾灯的截断式尾部。
当然，所有这些元素都经过改良，
以适应更加现代化的设计理念。*

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
This is my car!
Seriously, it’s actually in my garage right now.
The 1969 Camaro is a true classic
American muscle car.
The unique grille shape gives the design a wide stance...
... and the character lines on the side of the car gives
this Camaro a feeling of speed.
The most dated area of the design are the wheels.
On my '69 Camaro, I ditched the 14-inch Rally wheels
and installed 17-inch wheels.
It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.'
zh:
它就是我的梦中情车！
不开玩笑，我的车库里现在就停着一辆。
这么说吧，1969科迈罗是纯正血统的美式肌肉车。
其独特的进气格栅设计赋予了它宽阔的车身姿态……
艺术化的腰线设计带来了速度感。
如果说它的设计有什么过时的地方，那就是车轮了。
比如我个人就放弃了14英寸的拉力轮毂，
换成了17英寸的。
这是一辆改装潜力巨大，甚至能
提升到赛车水准的好车。
相信我，我知道自己在说什么。

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history
of Stingray designs.
That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution
of those designs.
The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its
undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.
And don't forget that piercing front end.
Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped
around a powerful V-8.
Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of
air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
zh:
C7科尔维特的设计从Stingray过往车型的丰富历史中
获取了灵感，
并且在运动感方面取得了突破。
整台车的造型好像一条魔鬼鱼，
有着棱角分明的前脸设计……
以及起伏的车身表面和令人过目不忘的倾斜线条。
在隆起的引擎盖下包裹着一台强大的V8引擎，
而无处不在的进气口和风道则巧妙地将气流
导向纤细流畅的车身四周。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The original 2001 996 based GT3 is
one of the best kept "insider" Porsche secrets!
Technically and mechanically,
it's the most raw of all the GT3s!
It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.
The success of the GT3 was unexpected with
demand exceeding the limited production runs!
Pure magic!;
zh:
2001款996 GT3是保时捷最大的秘密武器之一！
无论是技术方面，还是机械方面，
这款车型的凶悍程度都冠绝保时捷所推出的所有GT3！
它搭载了来自GT1/梅茨格的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。
GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！
这辆车简直像有魔力一般！>

speaker: Sarah
en:
That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!
He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.
Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...
...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
zh:
没错！这款引擎由保时捷的传奇工程师汉斯·梅茨格打造！
他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，
以及F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。
尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……
但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。

en:

zh:
汉斯·梅茨格是保时捷的传奇工程师！
他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
It's hard to believe the car is nearly two decades old!
Stylistically, the Carrera GT was ahead of its time.
It became the future DNA for Porsche...
...especially for the Boxster and Cayman,
and I would say, influenced the 918.
It has a lot of innovative details,
such as the double hump mesh rear screen...
...with the stylized aero roll bars hovering above.
I also love the r�ar diffuser
with the integrated exhausts.
Also inspiring was the interior
with the center console bridge.
 If I were to make one criticism...
...then it would have be
the visually long bodyside.
The front fender outlet and rear fender inlet...
...connected by the horizontal lines accentuate this.
The clever details continue
with the center-lock wheels.
...and the aero supported mirrors.
 I would sa� the styling of the Carrera GT
is truly timeless...
...and a masterpiece of modern Porsche design!
zh:
Carrera GT是永不过时的艺术品。
我认为它是保时捷现代设计中的杰作！
你甚至很难想象这辆车已经问世这么多个年头了！
从造型上，Carrera GT完全领先了它的时代……
它的设计元素影响到了后续几乎所有保时捷车型……
比如Boxster和Cayman，甚至还包括918。
它蕴含了大量的创新细节……
x��如双峰式的后置透明引擎罩，
以及悬在引擎上、造型独具的空力防倾杆。
集成在保险杠上的排气管
和后扩散器也是我喜欢的设计。
同样令人耳目一新的还有内饰的中控台。
不过呢，如果要我提意见的话……
我觉得长度有些太长了。
尤其是侧面的水平线条，显得拖沓……
因为它把前挡泥板的出风口
和后挡泥板进风口连起来了……
保时捷在这台车上还加入了很多巧思……
例如中央锁止轮毂和空气动力学后视镜等等。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger
than the original but scaled up perfectly!
 If you put an original next to it, you won't
believe the difference in size.
The original car was really quite small.
The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role
in modernizing the GT40.
The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit
comfortably and allows them get in and out easily.
This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car
with Ford reliability and parts access.
The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless.
A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.
zh:
他们采取了非常巧妙的设计手法：
扩大车身尺寸，然后完美复刻原车比例！
将两辆车停在一起时，你甚至很难发现它们的差别。
而实际上，GT40要小上一号。
在打造现代版GT40时，
精准化镶板的工艺发挥了重要的作用。
“大号”的新福特GT为身材更高大的驾驶者带来了便利。
这是一款真正能满足日常驾驶的经典超级跑车，
并拥有福特的可靠品质和零部件供应支持。
无论是内饰还是外观，
这辆车的设计都经受得起时间的考验。
这是一辆真正的车迷会选择收藏的好车。<next id=2400808 typ�=9�A

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
One of the roles design plays in industrial products is...
...to instantly convey information and the underlying message
in a visual way that may not be noticed at first glance.
It is to project the functional excellence of the product, its
philosophy, tradition and the creator's intent, instantly.
It's also supposed to draw the customer in
by eliciting a "love at first sight" appeal.
Therefore, the look of products at time� tries to appeal to
many people at once, making many of them looking similar.
Bluntly put, design is usually dictated by the market.
But in the case of the Radical, this is not the case.
Whether it's a mountain road or the race track,
all it needs to do is to go fast.
The headlight, for example, is simply required
to shine a light forward.
Although seemingly unapproachable, this car kno�s its role.
It’s a one-of-a-kind sidekick that requires a special love.
These types of cars make life entertaining, don't you think?
zh:
设计在工业产品制造中扮演的一个重要角色就是……
……要通过视觉手段即时地传递
第一眼可能看不出来的信息和潜台词。
要立刻呈现产品的功能优点、理念、传统和
创造者的想法。
还要通过营造出“一见钟情”的感受
来吸引到消费者。
因此，产品的外观设计有时会试图同时吸引和取悦不同类型的受众，
导致产品外观��趋同性。
说白了，设计大部分时候都受到市场的主导。
不过Radical却是个例外。
不论是山路还是赛道，它唯一的目的就是跑得更快。
比如说它的车头灯就只需要直直地照亮前方。
尽管这台车的声浪不够大、操控性不够友好，
但它很清楚自己的定位。
那就是成为独一无二、让你爱不释手的一_��老朋友。
这类车可以让你的人生充满乐趣，你觉得呢？

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
In the 1980s, there was a very unique phenomenon in the history
of automotive design. It was a time when the "boxy" style...
...was surely at its peak.
Blister fenders were the result of an attempt to marry
round tires to a square body design.
This style is one of the defining symbols of this era.
The polyhedron body of the car here is minimalistic.
But despite its abstract form, its intonation is limited,
and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.
And because the car is seemingly pressed into an inorganic shape,
the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.<next id=2001706 type
zh:
在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。
“四四方方”的设计理念在当时大行其道。
这部分微微鼓起的挡泥板就是这种思路的产物
——设计师们试图将轮胎的圆形和车身的方形轮廓融合起来。
这样的造型代表了那个年代的显著象征之一。
多边形车身非常抽象、简约。
虽然发出的音浪不大，
但成功通过外立面表达出了强烈的热情和兴奋感。
粗看下，这台车像是一团被捏合而成的无机物，
呈现出相对抢眼的最终效果。~

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
I think that the Fugu Z is a very appealing car.
The interior is especially cool because it's so carefully
stripped down.
Only the bare minimum parts have been added,
which match the car's power output that has nearly doubled.
The original 240Z was straightforward and had
beautiful proportions...
...and this car is respectful of that with its
minimal customization.
Look at t�e original fender mirrors, they're in the
original Kilimanjaro White color.
It was as if a young person from California came upon
a Z that was a bit rough around the edges...
...and polished it with the admiration he had of the car
in the past.
And now...
...the raw pureness of the spirit of the
1973 Z shines brightly in the Fugu Z.
Thank you, Sung Kang!
zh:
我觉得Fugu Z是一辆充满魅力的车。
内饰经过了非常细致的精简，显得尤其炫酷。
这款车只最低限度地安装了必要的改装件，
与之相对的是几乎翻倍的动力输出。
原始车型240Z的设计本身就很简约，
但有着优美的车身比例……
……这台车很好地延续了这一风格，只进行了极少量的改装。
你��瞧这原版的挡泥板上装后视镜，
连油漆都是原版的乞力马扎罗白。
就好像是有个加州的年轻人遇上了一辆老爷车Z，
感怀它的破旧不堪……
……就抱着自己对这辆车的情怀对它进行了打磨。
而现在……
……1973 Z那最纯粹、最原始的精神
在Fugu Z的身上得到了灿烂重现。
姜成镐，谢谢你的付出！)

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
Now, this is what I call a British sports car!
The hardcore radical quality here is expressed throughout,
from the interior to its exterior appearance.
The car's spirit is hardly diplomatic.
It's as if this vehicle is saying,
"I have no desire to be a star to the public."
And, at the same time, it exemplifies the pure and naive love
that we feel for sports cars.
On the sexy body, which �its extremely low for a front-engine
car, there's a cold round detail that totally lacks emotion.
The hood, sculpted and low other than around the engine,
and the corresponding trunk lid...
...express a powerful driving force.
In this regard, the styling goes well beyond what
many would accept, for love sees no fault.
This design generates indifferent feelings,
captivating only those who understand it.
zh:
看啊，这才是我眼中真正的英国跑车！
从内饰到外观，这辆车浑身都散发着不羁和激进。
摒弃圆滑和世故，展现永不妥协的精神。
实际上，它似乎完全无意迎合大众口味。
与此同时，它也向我们表达了对一款纯血、直击本质的
跑车的热爱。
对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
��弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。
引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……
……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。
其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。
这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
There is simply no pure racecar
more stylish and appealing than the 250 P.
There hasn't been one before it or after it.
Even if this car was designed strictly for racing,
it doesn't feel that the priority was placed on winning races.
You can say that the 250 P is the ultimate expression of
Ferrari's 1960s-era mid-engine racecar styling.
In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces
�nflect strong emotional expressions...
... and that's what gives this car its Italian flavor.
After this car, even Ferrari's racecars became a bit visually dry,
with the priorities placed on performance and function.
This masterpiece symbolizes an era when racecars were beautiful.
zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，
前无古人，后无来者。
尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。
可以说330 P4就是法拉利在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。
从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅�"�又充满力量感……
……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。
在它之后，就连法拉利的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。
这款杰作代表了那个赛车也可以很美的时代。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
This car really shows off its proportional balance.
Aside from the retrofitted detail parts,
I feel that it is an elegant looking car.
Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...
...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the
B-pillar...
...they seem to be a response to cars in the American market
at the time.
Looking at it now, it lacks boldness,
but it's a look that exudes positive emotions.
zh:
这辆车淋漓尽致地展现了设计师对车身比例均衡的把握。
这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。
其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……
……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……
……似乎都是为了响应当时美国市场的需求。
现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe
Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.
It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature,
but the other parts are also well executed.
Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather
sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.
It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from
the solid door sections to the overa�l sense of volume.
But it does lack the four round taillights.
When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course,
inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.
In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they
aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.
At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...
...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC,
the window line of the C-�illar is set at the same angle.
zh:
这辆初代GT-R是日本在1960年代
呈现给全世界的骄傲——一台双门跑车。
久负盛名的“冲浪线条”是它的专属特色。
当然，其他部位的设计也同样可圈可点。
首先，原车型的定位是轿车，但GT-R将车身比例改得更偏向运动。
其主要的设计主旨就是“简单但性能强大”。
从方正、结实的车门到整车的廓形，
这款杰出的设计�多少带着一些美国车的影子。
唯一缺少的，是后续车型中加入的四盏标志性圆形车尾灯。
我们在设计R35 GT-R的时候，从Hakosuka的
整体氛围和细节上汲取了不少灵感。
事实上，有个重要设计点值得一提——GT-R并没有采用溜背设计，
溜背的视觉效果来自于直接与下部车身相接的C柱。
粗看之下，R35很像是一台溜背车……
�;�…但与KPGC进行比较之后你就会发现
两者C柱窗户的线条呈现的角度其实是一模一样的。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
At the risk of sounding crass by compliment our own designs...
...I always felt that the GT-R in the Super GT Series was
"oh so cool" when watching it in races.
The racecar is modified by NISMO every year...
...and the original image of the GT-R is carefully retained in
the grille and the shape of the lights.
When watching a race, it's important to be able to
recognize a car when seeing it from a distance.
For that to happen, the front and rear of
the base production car must be distinctive.
Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics,
GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.
In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...
...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their
sponsor colors all look the same."　
That's when I decided that the shape of
the R35 GT-R's cabin must ab�olutely remain distinctive!
zh:
虽然这样说感觉像是在自卖自夸……
……不过我坚信当你在Super GT系列赛中
看到这辆GT-R时，你一定会觉得“哇，太酷了”。
每年，我们都会将赛车交由NISMO进行改装……
……而GT-R原本的外观，如格栅和车灯形状等
都精心地保留了下来。
我认为在观看比赛时，能让观众远远地
就把赛车辨认出来很有必要。
要达到这个目标，
基础量产车的前后外观必须要有独到之处。
为了增强空气动力学性能，赛车的车身通常会接受
大量的改装，但GT系列赛又规定
驾驶舱必须与原版量产车保持一致。
我过去在铃鹿赛道观看超跑比赛的时候……
……就觉得“除了赞助商的涂装，这些赛车
看上去都一个样。”
所以，我才会在S��计R35 GT-R的时候赋予驾驶舱独特的风格！

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.
The 3-box hatchback theme with a great performance package
was firmly established with the first GTI.
It has seen evolutional changes through the generations.
Yet, there were a few hits and misses over the years.
This one was one of the successes.
The size of the car has been gradually
growing with each evolutionary model.
This one got all the components, and they
were treated correctly.
They combine to establish a great stance, presence
and agility, exuding not only harmony, but also strength.+
zh:
这是一辆七代高尔夫GTI。
它采用三厢掀背设计，并搭载动力强劲的性能套件。
这也是从初代起就确定的设计思路。
每一代高尔夫GTI的推出，都会经历一些演化和改变。
多年以来，有些改变成功了，而另一些则不尽如人意。
这一台，是成功的幸运儿之一。
历代的车身尺寸在演化中逐步扩大，
这一代的高尔夫GTI就做到了将所有的要素搭配地恰到好处。
它们的结合形成了运动的姿态，强大的气势和灵活性，
同时还散发出一种和谐感与力量感。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
This is the original model where the Jeep culture started.
It was purely a functional design to meet military needs.
The form-follows-function process doesn’t always
guarantee esthetic success.
Only on very rare occasions does it work like
magic and, in this case, it did, and the vehicle became an icon.
 Engineers who worked on this program...
...must have had a good sense of proportion
and high design q�ality standards.
They knew where the right amounts of radii needed to be applied.
In some cases, that extra depth of the flanges helped add
rigidity to the panel so they could use a thinner piece�
My hats off to the original creators.
zh:
这辆原版车款就是整个Jeep文化的起点。
作为服役车辆，它的设计完全强调功能性。
这种外形为功能服务的设计出发点
显然无法保证美学上的成功。
或者我应该说，成功的几率绝无仅有。
而这样的成功就落在了Jeep身上，缔造出了汽车史上的经典符号。
参与这项开发计划的工程师们……
……很好地掌握了比例的x��念，
并且对设计品质有极高的标准。
他们将外观的弧度与半径计算得分毫不差。
例如，他们会通过采用凹陷度更深的轮缘来强化板件的刚度，
以削减板材厚度，达到减重的效果。
光凭这一点，就值得我们向那些早期设计者们脱帽致敬。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
Both Ferrari and Pininfarina have a certain philosophy.
And that philosophy is that a Ferrari "must
be beautiful and distinctive."
The La Ferrari was introduced as the pinnacle of
technology, aerodynamics and styling.
Like its predecessors, it stood as an expression of
pure functional beauty.
There are no gimmicky surfaces or details in its design.
It stood apart from the more aggressive-looking supercars of its time.
zh:
法拉利和宾尼法利纳都秉承了同一设计理念：
每一辆法拉利都必须“美观而独特”。
这台LaFerrari就代表了技术、空气动力学和美学风格上的极致。
和其前辈们一样，它同样遵循“性能高于造型”的设计思路，
摒弃一切花哨的装饰曲面或细节，
在众多外观更加“唬人”的超级跑车中显得鹤立鸡群。

speaker: Ed Welburn
resolved_car_en: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
resolved_car_zh: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette
Sting Ray “Split Window” coupe.
Split Window comes from the
very cool division post in the rear window.
This post is not only distinct...
...it allows the profile of the car
to remain uninterrupted in its flow.
I also love the fender shapes,
which were inspired by Italian streamliner cars of the 1950s.
This car is so well balanced from top to�bottom,
and from end to end.
It is indeed a timeless design.
When I look at the sleek undulating shapes of
the 1963 Sting Ray...
...it really does remind me of a sleek creature
that lives underwater.
Yes, that's right. I'm referring to the
the car's namesake, the stingray.
zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。
“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。
这根独树一帜的立柱……
……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。
我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。
这辆车z��头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，
堪称永恒的经典设计。
每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……
……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。
没错，那就是这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
The Mercedes A45 AMG is so well thought out,
so tough and so cool.
The body shape is muscular and has great proportions.
The surfaces are well sculpted
and are rich in shape.
Even the wheels are designed to maximize their size,
 and help to plant this Mercedes firmly to the ground.
What makes this car so very cool is that it is authentic
and does not depend on gimmicks.
I want one of these in my garage!
zh:
这辆梅赛德斯A45 AMG的设计十分成熟，
性能强悍而且外形帅气。
其车身轮廓充满肌肉感，而且保持了合理的比例。
车身表面经过精心塑形，弧形线条丰富而流畅。
设计师甚至考虑到了轮胎的问题，
最宽尺寸的车胎可以让这辆梅赛德斯牢牢扒住地面。
这辆车的优势在于不忘初心，
绝无任何花哨的设计，只用实力说话。
这样的车，连我也想买一辆！

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence
on every Corvette that came after it.
It was not designed as a production or concept car,
but as a very serious racecar.
Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.
Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.
The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.
zh:
科尔维特Stingray Racer的诞生对后世每一台科尔维特
都带来了重大影响。
自设计伊始，它的定位就不是一台量产车或概念赛车，
而是彻彻底底的赛车。
大刀阔斧的设计改动使其与
之前的科尔维特大相径庭。
车身多处的造型设计都明显受到早期意大利流线型车身
的启发，尤其是那堪称精雕细琢的前后挡泥板。
另外，得益于围绕车身一周的“折缝线”设计，
令它多出了几分速度感。.

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini
Countach on the street.
The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.
It is a modern classic and the very definition
of a supercar.
One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors
to feel its striking presence.
It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile
with a steep windscreen and high tail.
And the bold crease that runs the length of the car
is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
zh:
我永远忘不了第一次在街上看到兰博基尼Countach
的情景。
LP400确实是一辆非常出色的车。
它是一款现代经典车，也是超级跑车的绝佳代表。
即使不打开它的剪刀式车门，
也能感受到它令人惊叹的存在感。
它的车身像是一个压到极致的倒梯形，
挡风玻璃斜度很大，尾翼则高高耸起。
一条让人无法忽视的折痕线贯穿整个
侧面车身，夺人眼球。
这条折痕线来自于车身表面的高差——
每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
This is the car that made Henrik Fisker famous!
It’s truly a modern 507!
There's a lot I like about it.
First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.
It almost has a handmade look...
It reflects a more human approach to design.
It’s really quite wonderful!
It’s a more emotional, artistic approach that
embraces imperfections as character!
And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.
zh:
这辆车让亨里克·菲斯克声名鹊起！
你可以说，它就是现代版的507了！
我喜欢它的地方有很多。
首先，我喜欢它把宝马感性的一面发挥到了极致。
它的外观给人一种手工打造的质感……
反映出一种更有人情味的设计方法。
它有着极强的表现力！
这是一种更感性、更艺术的设计方法，
接纳不完美，并把它转化为车的个性！
倒不如说，这台Z8全身上下都散发着强烈的个性！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The Raptor is an aggressive and capable beast.
I love this truck!
It has a solid overall design and possesses plenty of Ford’s
unique DNA.
The wide stance and large tires result in great
handling character and tremendous height.
Its capable 4WD system allows it to excel
on rough off-road terrain.
This first-generation Raptor had a V-8 that matched
its aggressive character.=
zh:
猛禽的外形充盈着侵略性和力量感！
这就是我爱这辆卡车的原因！
它不仅拥有福特血统的优点，还有许多独到之处！
形成了一套性能全面的设计方案。
它拥有宽大的车架和大外径尺寸的轮胎，
因此获得了出色的操控性和充分的离地间隙。
极大的上坡角增大了车架前后部分与地面的空间，
使其能够轻松搞定起伏坎坷的地形。
另外，这辆初代猛禽搭载的可是一台V8引擎，
无论是个性还是侵略性，都更上一层楼！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport
was built with racing as its sole purpose.
It featured a distinctive rear wing with integrated air inlets.
The downforce generated at the rear was balanced
by an extended front spoiler.
The wheels were a three-piece design,
with staggered offsets front and rear.
A single glance at the exterior details made it clear
this was the work of Styl� Porsche...
...the in-house design studio at Porsche Weissach.
Inside, the cabin was defined by a spartan layout
and a reinforced roll cage.
Like other 911-based race cars of its era,
the Clubsport channeled its forebears.
I almost feel for the owner attempting to persuade
the authorities to license it for road use!
A formidable challenge, though not an impossible one![
zh:
基于993打造的RS Clubsport版本
是比993 Carrera RS更加纯粹的赛道机器。
尾翼产生的巨大下压力需要通过狭长的前端扰流板来平衡。
轮毂采用3片式锻造设计，而且前后采用不同的偏距值。
从外观细节中不难看出，它的设计来自品牌自有的
保时捷-魏斯萨赫设计工作室——“保时捷设计”。
内饰采用赛车专用的朴素黑色，并安装了全面焊接加固的防滚架。
在这一代基于保时捷911打造的赛车上，
你仍然可以看到一些原版911的元素。
我可以想象，某些有追求的车主可能会尝试
为这辆车注册登记，获得上路许可……
……想必这位车主需要和车管部门费好大一番口舌了。
不过我“听说”还真的有人成功了！

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
If there is a car that perfectly
represents Ferrari’s spirit...
...it is the F40.
The progenitor of all Hypercars,
an absolute myth for enthusiasts.
It follows typical Pininfarina design continuity.
It incorporates the cabin volume of the usual 308
with a body inspired by competition.
Low, profiled, with retractable headlights...
... and indicators that sit behind
smoked Plexigl�s.
With the two NACAs
on the hood...
...as well as the four lateral "gills" in GTO-style
behind the rear wheel...
..it integrates many functional air intakes.
Other characterstic elements are...
...the horizontal black groove...
...as well as the three round central exhausts and...
...the huge rear wing with the initials F40
in bas-relief on the right side.
zh:
如果说有哪辆车能完美代表法拉利的精神……
……那么非F40莫属。
它是所有终极跑车的始祖，是车迷心目中的绝对神话。
它在设计方面延续了宾尼法利纳的经典风格，
并继承了普通版本308的驾驶舱，
但车身造型设计明显是为竞速而生的：
无论是低矮的轮廓，翻转式大灯……
……及雾面有机y��璃后的转向指示灯；
还是引擎盖上的两个NACA进气口……
……或是后轮之后的四道GTO风格竖向“鳃”状风口……
……功能性进气口的数量多得让人瞠目结舌。
当然，它的个性还不止于此：
……纯黑色水平蜂窝格栅、
三联装的中置圆形排气管以及……
……大到夸张的尾翼。
在尾翼的右侧面还有一个大大的“F40”]��雕标志。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
The 458 Italia is one of Pininfarina's
recent masterpieces for the Cavallino.
It is probably the most beautiful mid-engine
Ferrari since the 308...
Inheriting the sportiness, purity and elegance
of the 308...
It would influence the design language and proportions
of all subsequent models.
Its style is characterized by...
...sinuous yet extremely pure and fluid lines,
with no visible air inlets on the sides.
The front is sharp, with the new "scimitar" headlights.
The rear can be recognized by single round lights...
...embedded in the bodywork...
...and by the three round central exhausts inspired by the F40.
 If perfection in design is achieved when nothing
can be removed from a shape without ruining it...
...then the 458 it comes really close.&
zh:
458 Italia是宾尼法利纳最近为跃马品牌设计的杰作之一。
它可能是自308以来外型最优美的中置引擎法拉利……
……同时也继承了308的运动性、纯粹性和优雅……
……并影响到了后续多款车型的设计语言和比例。
其风格特点可以用几点归纳：
极致纯粹、流动的连续车身线条，侧面没有任何明显的进气口。
犀利的前脸采用了新的“弯刀”头灯。显得杀气腾腾。
车尾的辨识度也很高……
……嵌入车身框架的单个圆形后灯……
……以及与F40师出同门的三联中置圆形排气管。
如果完美的设计是增之则长，减之则短……
……那么458已经非常接近于这个境界了。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.
It's been over a decade since this car
hit the streets.
Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.
The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag
coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.
From the significantly canted windscreen...
...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses
a bold, clear vision.!
zh:
这辆车是丰田近些年来最好的设计之一。
其实它也已经出现在街头十多年了……
但今天看到它，
还是有种新鲜感。
丰田通过压低车身高度和采用双气泡型车顶
成功将阻力系数降低至0.28。这样的车开起来肯定很舒服。
无论是明显下探的挡风玻璃……
还是向后延、并在车尾收束下坠的利落侧面轮廓线，
都让人有耳目一新的良好感受。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.
In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.
No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.
Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...
...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.
He then took on the challenge of...
...creating an even better minimally-packaged�car.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.
Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.
The yawning hood lid is also q�ite appealing,
not to mention functional.
zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，
甚至堪称永恒经典。
难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。
菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……
在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。
然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……
开始打造一款x��加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。
在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。
它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
At first glance, it appears to be a normal sedan, but look
inside, and you'll realize that this car was created for speed.
This is the category that's referred to as "muscle cars."
This Challenger R/T is like the Barracuda
because it's smaller in size.
However, the large front opening
and the kicked-up rear quarter...
...are aggressive design cues that match the car's character.
Power is provided by a HEMI engin�.
On the hood is a protruding air scoop
called the "Shaker."
When it shakes, it declares the enormous power it possesses.
If you include the optional rear spoiler, the Challenger R/T
is a muscle car that's sure to catch anyone's eye.
zh:
如果不仔细看，你会以为它是一辆普通的轿车。
但坐进驾驶舱之后，你就会明白这是一台速度机器。
这个类别的车通常归类为“肌肉车”。
这辆Challenger R/T很像梭鱼，只是尺寸小一号。
不过它那宽大的前脸开口和
拱起的后侧围板……
无不在体现该车极富侵略性的特征。
此车的动力来自一台HEMI引擎。
引擎盖上的进气口又被车迷们戏称为“抖动器”
这个称号来源于它工作时的抖动噪声，
就像在宣告自己的澎湃动力。
如果再装配上车尾扰流板，
Chal�enger R/T必定会吸引所有人的目光。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
Very Italian in improvisation,
I'm quite taken by...
....the high degree of precision displayed here.
One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati
and started OSCA, left behind was...
...the sohc 6-cylinder engine.
The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine.
With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born.
The car's four driven wheels and various other mecha�ical parts
are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.
The volume here is minimal.
This body was the work of the famous
Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.
You can feel the presence of the design language
of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.
It really excites the soul, this design.
zh:
这是非常有意大利风格的即兴演绎，
尤其令我着迷的是……
整台车体现出的高精细度。
当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，
他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。
使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。
宛若薄绸v��轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……
同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。
这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。
你可以明显看到它的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。
看到这样的设计，让人从内心深处受到震撼！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
When you mention the 917, I'm reminded by a particular episode.
Allow me to talk about something that happened in 1968.
At the Eiffel wind tunnel, which opened in Paris in the
19th century, we were in the midst of a project...
...while in the adjacent room,
another car was being tested. That was the 917.
A state-of-the-art advanced racing machine tested at a
turn-of-the-century lab! It was amusingly ironic.
The 917 made its debut at the 1969 Geneva Show.
It was the successor to the 908, and instead of an 8-cylinder
engine, this monster had an air-cooled flat-12.
Depending on the race, the 917 came in different forms.
On high-speed circuits, it wore a long-tail body,
and on tricky courses like the Targa Florio, it had a short tail.
zh:
提到917，我正好想起了一个故事。
请容我讲讲1968年发生的一件轶事。
当时我们在十九世纪就设立的巴黎埃菲尔风洞实验室里
，我们的新项目正进行到一半……
这时正好有另一辆车在隔壁接受测试，就是这款917。
一辆采用当时最顶尖科技打造
的比赛机器停放在一座修建于前一个世纪的实验室里！
有一种恍若隔世的反{��感。
后来，这款917在1969年的日内瓦车展上首次亮相。
虽然这台动力猛兽是908的继任者，但却没有采用水平对置
八缸引擎，而是换上了一台水平对置十二缸风冷引擎。
此外，这台917还可以根据不同类型的赛事调校为不同形式……
例如在高速赛道上采用长车尾，
在塔格·佛罗热耐力赛这样的蜿蜒赛道上则换上短车尾。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
What's interesting about this car is that the bodywork was penned
by a young Giugiaro, who was then the chief designer at Ghia.
It seems so simple, it looks to drawn by a single brush stroke,
thus the shape consists of simple lines and surfaces.
A half century later,
the car still looks fresh and alluring.
It shares the same backbone chassis technology as
the original Vallelunga, with a Ford V-8 housed within.
Access to the mid-mounted engine comes
via a butterfly-type rear hatch.
This detail is also particularly interesting and fun. I like it.
zh:
这辆车最令人着迷之处全在于它的车身，
这是由车身制造公司吉亚后来的首席设计师，
当时才初出茅庐的乔盖托·乔治亚罗执笔设计的。
它的外形如此简洁、仿佛是一笔而就，
因此其形状都为简单的线、面所构成。
在半个世纪后的今天，依然有新鲜感和吸引力。
它采用了与其原型瓦莱伦加相同的脊骨式车架技术，
搭载福特V8引擎。
掀开鸥翼式的后备箱盖，就可以看到这台中置引擎。
这个细节特别有趣味。我很喜欢。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
And the high-performance version of that Golf I is the GTI.
Considered wide at the time, its 175/70R13 tires were covered
 by a special black plastic lip.
Red molding inside the front grille, the GTI had subtle hints
identifying its true nature...
...which made it all the more stylish.
When it comes to hot hatches,
this is a car that I still would like to own.
zh:
而高尔夫I的高性能版本就是这款GTi，
高尔夫I GTi采用的175/70 R13轮胎在当时被视作宽胎。
设计师特意在轮胎上方增加了一道别致的黑色塑料轮眉，
配合环绕前格栅一周的红色条纹设计，
隐约透露着GTi的本质……
令其更显风采卓然。
在高性能掀背车中，
这是我一直想要收藏的一辆车。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
There seems to be a reason behind every detail of this design,
a design with the spirit of rationality.
Yet it possesses irresistible charm.
This is the W194, also known as the 300SL.
It won the Mille Miglia, Grand Prix of Bern,
and the Carrera Panamericana in 1952.
On top of that, it placed 1-2 at Le Mans.
The doors of this car swing upward in
what is known as "gullwing" types.
That term also serves as the nickname for this car.
This design is the result of avoiding the bottom portion
 of the structure of the space frame./
zh:
这款车的每一处设计细节似乎皆有所本，既具有理性精神，
又有令人无法抵挡的魅力。
它就是W194，也被称为300SL。
它不仅于1952年的意大利一千英里耐力赛、伯尔尼大奖赛和
Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上豪迈地拿下了冠军头衔，
还在勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽了前二。
此车的上翻式车门被称作“鸥翼”车门，
由此，“鸥翼”也成为了本车的绰号。
其实，如此设计是为了避免车门与空间车架结构的底部发生冲突。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
For a car that came two generations
after the S30, this one has rediscovered its "Z-ness."
Three-dimensional undulations of the body are restrained,
and the design theme is simple yet bold.
The flush surface of the side glass and body around
the door section was an American design trend at the time.
You coud say that the Z32
is more of a coupe in design than a sport car,
but �he super wide-and-low body proportion
makes the overall look amazingly sporty.
If you look at the design flow it does deviate
from the "Z story",
but the level of refinement of its design
is truly outstanding.
That's why the car is still so popular.
And here's an interesting fact:
The area around the opening line of the rear hatch,
 was carried over to the Z33.
zh:
自S30推出又过了两代之后，
这款新车终于重新找回了“Z”系列的特色。
车身的起伏曲线十分克制，
用于展现简洁而又大胆的设计主旨。
侧面车窗底部与车门周围的车身齐平于同一平面……
体现了当时美国汽车设计领域的主流趋势。
与其说Z32是跑车，它更像是一台双门轿跑……
但那宽体低趴的姿态像是匍匐在地，
使整体外观充满了动感。
如果从设计流线上看，确实有些偏离Z系列的传统要素，
但其设计的精致程度无疑令人赞许。
这也解释了它为何至今仍然受到车迷们的追捧。
另外，后备箱盖开合线附近区域的设计在
后续车型Z33中也得到了沿用。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...
...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance,
 and a "coda tronca" rear.
Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.
The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense
of energy and vigor.
The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.
The car's distinguishing features include...
...t�e three air intakes on the hood and air outlets
on the fenders.
In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language,
while adapting to the rigors of racing...
...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.
It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of
the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.
zh:
与之前的经典短轴距车型相比……
250 GTO不仅采用了更长的车鼻，压低了车身高度，还引入了
被称为断尾的后部设计。
在设计时，空气动力学性能也是其重点考量。
宽大的前后挡泥板营造出了
无与伦比的动感氛围。
从侧后方角度看过去，特别华贵高雅。
无论是引擎盖正前方的三个进气口�"�
还是后保险杠上突出的排气管，
都让人记忆犹新。
可以说，250 GTO的设计既保留了法拉利的底蕴，
又满足了赛车运动的需求……
实现了难能可贵的平衡。
也正是这份平衡感让这款经典法拉利车型充满魅力，
人气爆棚。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The 918 was designed as the flagship...
...to showcase Porsche's
latest styling DNA and advanced technology for the future.
The styling forecasted Porsche's next generation of vehicles.
The dual rear exhausts exiting through...
...the rear upper cooling grille
looks like a jet pack...
...and is really exciting!
You can also see the production version of
the four element �ED headlights and the rear taillamp LED frame.
Along with the form vocabulary, you can also see
these elements showing up into the next generation of Porsches
Another favorite area of mine was...
...the interior design with the high bridge center console.
This was first seen in the 2003 Carrera GT but newly imagined.
The design language and style
has worn well over the years.
A bit quiet and �estrained to the eyes
compared to other competitors.
But still well received and
a popular edition to a super car collection!
zh:
918是作为保时捷的旗舰型号来设计的……
是为了充分展现
这家公司最新的设计基因和未来将采用的先进科技。
其设计风格预示了保时捷之后几代车型的设计路线。
穿过车尾上部冷却格栅的……
两根排气管，
整体看起来就像背着一个喷气背包……
令人感觉很酷！
此车还采用了量产��的四点式LED大灯和LED框架式尾灯。
这些元素和形状设计语汇，都在下一代保时捷车型中得到了沿袭。
918还有一点是我非常钟爱的……
就是内饰设计中如引桥般高高矗立的中控台。
这项设计早在2003年的Carrera GT上就出现过，
但这次经过了重新构思。
这些设计语言和风格随着时间的打磨已经变得圆熟，
尽管和竞品相比可能显得有一些平静内敛。
但爱好者们对918的接受度从未减少分毫。它永远是
所有超级跑车收藏者心目中的人气之选。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!
It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."
It was visually simple but complex in its execution.
Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!
It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,
that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.
The shape tapers in every view.
 The stance is set up
 �ith just the right amount of rake.
The back tires taller than the fronts.
The '32 also signals the beginning of
the iconic Ford V-8!
In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes
an emotional part of the whole.]
zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！
玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。
看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。
仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！
它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……
这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。
前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，
后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。
此外，这辆'32还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！
对于'32 而言，
这台引擎是其浑然天成的整体中的神来之笔。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This Audi takes me back to the 2011 Le Mans 24-hour race.
Incredibly, it crossed the finish line and won
the competition...
A nail-biting 13.845 seconds before
the second-place Peugeot.
Rarely has Le Mans had such a close race!
Although Audi bested Peugeot in terms of speed,
the same couldn't be said about fuel efficiency.
Peugeot tried to use this to their advantage
by taking as few pitstops as possible.
So while Audi was making excellent time,
it couldn’t quite shake Peugeot.
But in the end, Audi’s speed won out, eking out
a victory against its competitor.
zh:
看着这辆奥迪，我仿佛回到了2011年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
它以非同凡俗的姿态越过终点线并赢得了冠军……
只领先了第二名的标致13.845秒，令人捏了一把汗。
在勒芒，很少能见到这样针尖对麦芒的比赛！
虽然奥迪在速度上胜过了标致一筹，但是在
燃油效率方面就一言难尽了。
标致充分利用这一优势，尽量减少了进站加油的次数。
所以，单圈时间极其优秀的奥迪始终没能将标致甩开。
但最终，还是奥迪的速度胜出，惊险击败了对手。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The AMG GT3 is renowned for its reliable strength
at FIA GT3 races around the world.
It is doubtless the star player among GT3 machines.
In 2016, when the second-generation AMG GT3 was
handed over to private teams...
It showed off its strength and speed, dominating the top
positions at the 24 Hours Nürburgring in its debut year.
Also, while road-going AMG GTs
were powered by a 4L twin-turbo V8...
This was not always the case with
their racing counterparts.
For the SLS AMG GT3 was the first to be equipped
with a race-tested 6.3L naturally-aspirated model.
zh:
AMG GT3以其在世界各地的国际汽联GT3比赛中表现出的
可靠性而在业界闻名。
在GT3组别的参赛车辆当中，它无疑是一位明星选手。
2016年，是第二代AMG GT3交付给私人车队使用的第一年……
在出道当年，它就表现出无与伦比的实力和速度，
成为纽博格林24小时耐力赛的顶流。
AMG GT的公路版本通常配备4升的双涡轮V8引擎……
但该引擎并未被应用到赛车版本上。
SLS AMG GT3是首款配备了一台经过比赛考验的
6.3升自然吸气引擎的车型。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
In touring car races and rallies...
Renault has long been represented by the compact R5
and its successor, the Clio.
Ah, the WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo and the F2-class Clio Williams!
Those were some great cars!
But what about the somewhat larger Mégane?
Well...
They certainly pulled out all the stops for
this Mégane Trophy!
Despite the outward resemblance to its road-going
variant...
It is in fact a one-make racer, powered by
a midship 3.8L V6 courtesy of Nissan!
It was originally built to compete in the popular Renault
Sport Series, which takes place in Europe.
zh:
在房车赛和拉力赛方面……
一直以来代表雷诺出战的都是紧凑型的R5及其继任者Clio。
像是世界拉力锦标赛组别B R5 Turbo和F2级别的Clio Williams！
都是数一数二的好车！
再往上一个级别，就轮到梅甘娜了？
好吧……雷诺为了推动自家举办的梅甘娜杯，
确实是使出了浑身解数！
虽然外表与其公路版本极其相似……
但实际上这是一辆单一车种专用赛车，
搭载与日产联合开发的中置3.8升V6引擎！
另外，这台车原本打算参加的是在欧洲举办的高人气比赛
——雷诺运�A�S�|赛。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This SF19 was built for Japan’s top formula racing series,
the Super Formula Championship.
The Super Formula is the preeminent formula racing event
in all of Asia…
And is considered the quickest motorsport after F1.
In Super Formula races, drivers tend to show their skill
through overtaking manoeuvres.
By the way, are you familiar with overtaking systems?
It is a system that allows a driver momentarily increas�s
the flow of fuel to the engine for increased speed!
It requires plenty of control and the utmost technique!
This Honda-powered SF19 conjures up memories
of Alex Palou’s record victory.
Palou later went on to compete in the IndyCar series,
a formula racing series held in the USA.
zh:
这辆SF19是为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛
——超级方程式锦标赛而开发的。
放眼整个亚洲，超级方程式都是最卓越的方程式比赛……
也被视为是仅次于F1的最快汽车赛事。
在超级方程式比赛中，车手们倾向于
通过超车来展现个人技巧。
顺带问一句，你对超级方程式的超车系统有了解吗？
它可以通过短暂提高注入引擎y��燃料量，以提升车速！
同时也需要车手大量的操控和纯熟的技巧才能驾驭！
这辆本田出品的SF19见证了亚历克斯·帕卢
创下纪录的胜利。
在那之后，帕卢又转战印地系列赛，
那是在美国举办的另一项方程式赛车系列赛。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula
race series, the Super Formula Championship.
Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's
engines?
The answer is: Toyota and Honda.
This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was
raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.
That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained
for the F1 Grand Prix!
Although it produces abo�t half the power of an F1 car,
it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.
Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able
to push the car to its limits.
Nick Cassidy was the series champion when t�is machine
made its debut in 2019.
zh:
哎呀，这不是SF19，专门为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛，
超级方程式锦标赛而打造的赛车吗！
突击小测验！你知道为SF19提供引擎的是哪个厂家吗？
答案就是……丰田和本田！
这一台车里用的是丰田的引擎，
而驾驶它参加比赛的分别是中岛一贵和小林可梦伟。
没错，这两位可都是丰田旗下参加过F1大奖赛的车手！
虽然SF19的动力只有F1赛车的一半，但它也更小巧而轻量，
并且空气动力学性能相当不赖。
得益于两位车手的F1经验，能将此车的潜能发挥到极限。
在SF19亮相的2019年，尼克·卡西迪赢得了当年的系列赛冠军。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
A second-generation Swift Sport!
Thanks to its high base specs, this car can compete
without much modification.
In fact, it was even entered as a junior rally car
at the World Rally Championship!
Having taken the title twice, Suzuki has proved...
The great potential of this machine.
Manufacturing credit goes to Monster Sport, a Japanese
company headed by Nobuhiro Tajima.
Spe�king of Tajima-san...
His impressive career includes six consecutive wins
at the Pikes Peak International Hillclimb.
Monster Sport has also built legendary hill climbers
based on the Suzuki Cultus and Escudo.
zh:
这是第二代的速翼特运动版啊！
因为基础规格够高，所以无需过多改装，
就能直接参加比赛。
事实上，它甚至作为青年拉力赛赛车参加了
世界拉力锦标赛！
铃木用两个冠军头衔证明了……
这辆车的巨大潜能。
这辆车的制造者是Monster Sport，一家田岛伸博创办的日本公司。
说起田岛先生……
他拥有傲人的职业生涯战绩，曾在派克峰国际爬坡赛中获得六连胜。
在他的带领下，Monster Sport也基于铃木Cultus和Escudo
生产传奇的山地爬坡赛车。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The GR Supra Racing Concept was revealed at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2018.
When I saw it, I immediately thought to myself,
"The Supra is back at the track!"
Truly, Toyota is an incredible company!
Prior to the GR Supra’s release in 2019...
They had developed models built to LMGTE and
FIA GT-4 specifications.
Its debut race on Japanese soil was the first round
of the 2020 Super GT, at Fuji Speedway.
And of the six Supras that apparently competed,
five swept the top finishing positions!
zh:
GR Supra Racing Concept是于2018年3月在日内瓦车展上亮相的。
当我看到它的时候，
我就在心里对自己说，“Supra又回来比赛了！”
丰田真的是一家让人惊艳的公司！
在2019年，GR Supra还没推出之前……
他们就开发过LMGTE和国际汽联GT-4级别规格的Supra。
此车在日本本土的出道首战是在富士赛车场
举行的2020 Super GT第一轮。
六辆参赛的Supra中，就有五辆车包揽了完赛前五名的名次！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
The soul of a creator reaches out to unknown horizons.
At the point of arrival, new footprints
erase what was there before.
This creative passion will forever be engraved into
people's hearts and never disappear.
These extraordinary creators...their visions have
profoundly shaped the automotive world.
They grab hold of the distant future and pull it in.
They fly in the skies where technology and design are�free,
then safely land where their completed car becomes legend.
And the creator becomes a hero.
The designer of the 1955 DS was the Italian,
 Flaminio Bertoni.
Unfortunately, his existence �ecame
widely known only after his passing.]
zh:
这是创作者的灵魂在向着未知的边界进行探索。
在抵达之时，新的足迹便抹去了原先的痕迹。
然而，这份创作的激情将永远铭刻在人们心中，
永远不会消失。
这些非凡的创作者，他们的愿景深刻地塑造了汽车世界。
他们抓住遥远的未来，将其带到人们的眼前。
他们自由飞翔在技术和设计的天空中，随着他们安��落下，
因之而生的汽车便成为了传奇。
而创作者则成为了英雄。
1955 DS的设计师是一位意大利人，弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼。
令人扼腕的是，他的声名在故去之后才广泛地为人所知。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
The classical proportions and simple shape without needless
frills make this car essentially a sculpture.
Until then, carrozzerias such as Vignale, Ghia
and Zagato produced Ferrari bodies.
In the mid-1950s, the association with Pininfarina deepened,
and their work together increased.
This is a product from that time period.
It's powered by a 4-cylinder engine,
which is mounted backwards,
allowing for a long hood and the cabin's placement right
in front of the rear wheels.
zh:
经典的比例和简单的形状，无需多余的装饰，
这辆车简直就像是一座雕塑。
在此之前，法拉利的车身交由维格耐、吉亚
和扎加托等车身制造商打造。
从1950年代中期起，法拉利与宾尼法利纳深化了合作，
二者联合打造的作品也越来越多。
这辆车就是来自那个时代的产品。
它由一部后置安装的4缸引擎提供动力……
因此可以采用更长的引擎罩，
座舱则恰到好处地位于后轮的前方。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i."
The company offered two products, an urban commuter,
the i3, and the super high-performance i8.
Both models utilized different power sources, and
each expressed itself with its own form language.
They're quite alluring, no?
Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions
defined by packaging necessities...
The car is eye-catching, even when�it's driving
around town.
The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials.
Everything about the car is thorough.
This kind of approach serves the role of making the user
highly conscious of the environment.
That's why this design is so important. A gold star!
zh:
宝马的电动车都以“i”字母起头。
其电动车品牌主打两款产品：作为都市通勤车的i3，
和拥有超强性能的i8。
这两个型号采用了不同的动力源，
而且都以独特的外形设计语言表达出自己的定位。
两辆车是不是都非常诱人？
尤其是这辆i3，在内饰布局和配置上下了不少功夫，
留足了空间……
即便是在城市里驾驶，它也能非常吸睛。
它的内饰采用了可持续环保材料。
此车的一切都透露着缜密、周全。
这样的做法有助于令用户对环保产生深刻的认识。
正因如此，这份独到的设计才显得至关重要。
值得给它颁发一颗金星勋章！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
In the Japanese automobile world, executing a model change
without dramatically altering the car's design is rare.
But it is carried out quite well here.
The way the windshield blends into the side glass
gives the impression of a full-face helmet.
This car possesses the same basic design theme
as its predecessor.
What has noticeably changed is...
...a more powerful looking one-frame front end
and air intakes on either side.
However, these aren't exaggerated changes,
just effective._
zh:
在日本汽车界，在车辆改款时不对原设计进行大幅更新
是非常少见的情况。
不过这款新车的整体感觉非常不错。
它的挡风玻璃与侧面车窗融为一体，
给人一种全罩式头盔的感觉。
新车采用了与前代车型相同的基础设计主题。
最明显的改变在于……
更凸显力量感的单条前格栅
以及车头两侧的进气口。
这些改动不追求夸张的造型变化，只追求效率。.

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
This is a car that tried to break away from
the previous design language of BMW.
The shapes created by my former classmate
Chris Bangle when he was at BMW...
...were interesting and exciting in the eyes of a designer.
This M3 also began moving away from the authentic
proportions of an FR vehicle.
However, the surface treatment is fresh and interesting.
Even seeing it now, it's not bad at all.
This is one of the cars that represented
the change in flow of BMW design.
zh:
这辆车的设计在尝试摆脱宝马之前的设计语言，带来革新。
它是由我从前的同学
克里斯·班戈在宝马工作时所设计的……
在设计师眼中，这些设计元素非常有趣，非常激动人心。
此外，这辆M3开始从车身配比上与传统前置后驱车分道扬镳。
其车身外观的处理也非常新颖有趣。
即便从现在的眼光来看也丝毫不过时。
可以说，这是一台反映了宝马设计思路演变的车。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
From its GP machines to the Royales, Bugatti pushed the
automobile horizon in many directions in the pre-war era.
Especially in regard to design, Jean Bugatti
of the Bugatti family...
Ensured that the company's cars were dynamic in nature and
possessed originality that was recognizable at a glance.
However, at the same time, the cars also combined a certain
sublimeness and acceptance of classic aesthetics.
Even t�e Veyron's styling suggested that it was one
level apart from its rivals from Modena, Italy.
The traditional wedge-shaped formula was
completely discarded...
While the roofline and fenders were presented in natural
harmony, flowing down to the rear of the car.
The car's elegant lines are uninterrupted, running smoothly
around its body—a joy to trace with your eyes.
The styling expresses a euphoric art nouveau expression�
It makes me respect Jean Bugatti all the more.
zh:
从GP赛车再到皇家，布加迪在二战前
就将汽车的边界向各个方向大幅扩展。
特别是在设计上，布加迪家族的让·布加迪……
负责确保这家公司的所有汽车都拥有动感的本质和
一目了然的原创性。
与此同时，布加迪推出的车也结合了威严感
以及对传统美学的接纳。
这辆布加迪Veryron的风格设计就表现出了它与
来自�大利摩德纳的竞争对手的截然不同。
它彻底地弃用了传统的楔形车身设计……
从车顶到挡泥板的线条自然而和谐，
流泻到车尾。
从一而终的优雅线条沿车身顺滑地向后延伸，
带动你的眼神去追寻，赏心悦目。
这种造型风格表达了一种幸福、陶醉感的新艺术派理念。
也让我对让·布加迪更加肃然起敬。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are
reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.
However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the
wild example of the coda tronca body style.
In the Veyron, the intakes are placed there
to improve aerodynamics.
They make the sides look a bit like a French carrosserie
or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.
This is a beautiful�flamboyant French design, one where
the function-defining form to travel at ...
Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?
It's my fondest hope that they always remain
sublime and pure.
zh:
位于车身两侧的大号进气口令人回忆起1930年代
的那些优雅法国车造型。
不过我总感觉这种风格和断尾
的设计有些不搭。
在布加迪Veryron上，在这里设计进气口是为了提升空气动力学性能。
这样的设计让侧面的外观向法式车身靠拢，
又有点类似亨利·拉布戴特的德拉奇D6。
美观到有些浮夸的法系�0�计，
外加能够达到极速的超跑定位……
让现代版本的布加迪充满了魅力，对吧？
在此致以我最美好的愿望，希望他们可以
永远保持卓越和纯粹。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
This 300 SEL may have been big for a sedan, but
I consider it a sports sedan all the same.
The best image of this car that I can recall is a head-on
shot of it coming out of a corner at speed.
It must have been intimidating for other drivers
to see this machine in their rear-view mirrors.
This car is a great example of good visual weight balance.
It also showcases great dynamic weight distribution
in full racing trim.
zh:
作为一辆轿车，这辆300 SEL也许有点尺寸过大，
不过我依然认为它是一辆很棒的运动型轿车。
我印象中这辆车最美的姿态就是
站在正前方看着它以高速驶出弯道。
其他车手从后视镜里看着这辆猛兽步步逼近时
心里一定非常紧张。
它拥有恰到好处的车身比例。
全套赛车饰条与配件加身后，更显动态十足。:

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.
However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.
In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.
Or perhaps it even surpassed it.
It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.
And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
兰博基尼推出过若干款后续车型。
但没有哪一款能像它那样定义兰博基尼的风格。
在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，
甚至可以说全面超越了前者。
它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……
将鲜明的兰博基尼风格带入了全新的时代。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
I love compact sports models from Germany.
They all have wide tires, twice as wide as
Japanese compact cars.
Those wide tires are among the most significant
components of this car.
They give the car its personality.
And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable,
as well as possessing performance.
They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version
for those who have keen eyes.
zh:
我非常喜爱德国产的紧凑型跑车。
这些车型都采用了宽胎，
其宽度足有日本紧凑型车的两倍。
宽胎正是这辆车最重要的组成部分之一。
赋予了这辆车鲜明的个性。
而这种设计让车身显得又宽又低，看上去非常稳定，
性能也同样卓越。
在懂行的人眼里，这些特点让AMG版本与
基础的C级双门跑车有了明显的区分。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
What a cute little car. It looks like a miniature
supercar.
There are no gimmicky surfaces or details.
It makes me want to get in and attack a twisty road.
zh:
真是一辆可爱的小车啊。它看上去就像是一辆微缩版超跑。
没有任何花哨的表面或细节。
它只会让我想要钻进车里，
在崎岖的道路上风驰电掣。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way
it sits slightly inclined towards the front.
It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical
commuter econobox.
Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini
and FIAT 500...
...this car is a modern interpretation of the original
FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
zh:
这辆车的车头弧度略微下滑，看上去
就像是一只快乐的小兔子。
与其说它是一款典型的经济型通勤车，
不如说更像一辆提供愉悦驾乘体验的轻便汽车。
和其他的复古现代风格汽车，
例如当前版本的MINI和菲亚特500不同……
这辆车就好比是以“米老鼠”角色特点对
初代菲亚特500的现代化演绎。`

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
The 2016 Camaro was inspired by the original Camaro
of the 1960s.
But in a very fresh, contemporary way.
This iteration of the Camaro placed a greater emphasis on its
wheels, with a wide stance and muscular fender forms.
Many of its shapes, in particular the hood, front end,
and rear were inspired by Corvette design.
zh:
这辆2016款科迈罗设计灵感来源于1960年代的初代科迈罗……
但进行了大刀阔斧的现代化改动，令人耳目一新。
这个版本的科迈罗设计重点强调轮毂和
肌肉感十足的挡泥板，展现类似宽体低趴的形态。
车身部位的许多形状，尤其是引擎盖、车头和车尾，
灵感其实都来源于科尔维特。

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
The Camaro ZL1 is a weapon on wheels.
Everything about its design says speed and power.
From its overall stance to its many functional splitters,
wings, and air intakes, this car is track ready!
And, the ZL1 Camaro has a wider track
than other Camaros.
Its dark hood, grille, headlamps, and full-width splitter
give this car a wide, sinister appearance.
With two-tone colors, it's all business. Period!
zh:
这辆科迈罗ZL1的一切设计目的都是为了速度和力量，
它简直就是一件安上了轮子的武器！
从它的整体姿态到各种功能性的定风翼、尾翼和进气口，
都在告诉你——这辆车完全是为赛道打造的！
这辆科迈罗ZL1拥有比其他的科迈罗型号更宽的轮距。
涂黑的引擎盖、格栅、车头灯和车身等宽定风翼，
让它显得更狰狞、更具威胁性。
它还通过这种撞色设计表明了态度——不废话，只为胜利！

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
The C7 ZR1 Corvette is the ultimate expression of a
front-engine Corvette's power and bold design.
The ZR1 is sometimes known as “The Widebody."
It's significantly wider than a standard Corvette Stingray
in order to accommodate its massive tires.
The ZR1 has very significant air intakes and air exits.
These manage the flow of air and feed the many coolers
in the nose and tail of the car.
Most people love the rear wing.
But I prefer the smaller rear spoiler that was also
available.
zh:
这辆C7 ZR1科尔维特是前置引擎科尔维特那强大性能
和粗犷设计的终极例证。
这辆ZR1有时也被爱称为“宽车身”。
为了容纳那套巨大的轮胎，它比
标准款科尔维特Stingray要宽出许多。
ZR1同样还配备了巨大的进气口和出气口……
用于引导气流，为车头和车尾的散热器提供风冷降温。
许多人都很喜欢它的尾翼。
不过我个人更喜欢配备尺寸更小的后扰流板。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.
There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.
To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.
Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...�
...until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
It was a dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.
To this day, I haven't forgotten the green and red
Renown livery of that race machine.
zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的标致905也在其列。
此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如梅赛德斯-奔驰、捷豹和保时捷等等。
马自达派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。
在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……�
……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。
时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
en:
The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...
...was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.
The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...
...so you know it had plenty of fighting power.
The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and that
year, this car took the title, winning five of nine races�
Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say
that the series imposed a weight-handicap system.
The next year, in 2008, the NSX's main highlight was a 2nd-place
finish in the eighth race of the season at Autop�lis.
zh:
这辆初代NSX的原型和最终量产型……
……都由我的朋友、前本田首席设计师中野正人所设计的。
NSX的性能目标是要超越法拉利328和348，
所以可想而知，它的战斗力极其惊人。
GT500组别的赛事在2007年采用了阶梯式淘汰规则，
在这一年里，这辆NSX不仅赢得了冠军，还拿下了
九场比赛中的五场胜�7。
因为它所向无敌的速度，甚至会让人们怀疑这项系列赛
是不是采用了一套非常不利于大重量赛车的制度。
在接下来的2008年，NSX最亮眼的表现则出现在
奥托波里斯赛道，它在赛季的第八场比赛中以第二名完赛。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This is the car that kick-started Honda’s near 60 years
of Formula 1 Grand Prix history.
After a rough start in 1964, Honda was back in 1965,
with this RA272.
It took the checkered flag at the Mexican Grand Prix
in the final round of the season.
That year happened to be the last one in which F1 machines
were powered by 1.5-liter naturally-aspirated engines.
And let me tell you, the engine that powered this RA272
wa� something special!
It was a V-12 with  of displacement and capable of
a whopping 230 horsepower!
Surprisingly, the displacement per cylinder was a mere
, something that reflected Honda's motorcycle engines.
What’s more, weighing in at , this super compact
engine was mounted horizontally amidships!
Have you ever heard of such a thing being done
on a Formula 1 car?
But if you give it some thou�ht, you’ll see that
it actually made a lot of sense.
By mounting an engine on its side, you can shorten
the wheelbase and put less stress on the gearbox.
Compact and easy to handle, Honda’s early attempt
at an F1 machine was an amazing display of engineering.
The track on which the Mexico Grand Prix takes place
is  above sea level.
The low air pressure typically gives engines some
trouble generating power.
In designing the RA272’s powerplant,�former aircraft engineer
and Honda’s F1 team leader Yoshio Nakamura...
...made sure it would function at high altitudes,
giving the RA272 an edge over its rivals.
The driver of the winning car was Richie Ginther,
one of the most skilled drivers of his day.
All these ingredients came together in Honda’s first F1 win.
And with that, a glorious history was in the making!
zh:
这款车是本田近60年的F1大奖赛历史的先行者。
在经历了1964年的艰难起步之后，本田在1965年
携这款RA272卷土重来……
它在本赛季的最后一站，即墨西哥大奖赛上取得了冠军。
1965年也是赛会允许F1赛车使用
1.5升自然吸气引擎的最后一个赛季。
事实上，为这台RA272提供动力的引擎有点本事！
�台排量为的V12引擎能够产生惊人的230马力！
更令人惊讶的是，单个汽缸的排量仅有，
让人不禁联想到本田摩托车引擎的传承。
除此之外，这台超级紧凑的引擎重量仅为，
而且横向安置在车体的中部！
你可曾听说过这样的事情发生在一台F1赛车上？
但是细细思量，你就会发现这样的设计实际上颇为合理。
通过将引擎横向放置T��可以缩短轴距，
减轻变速箱所承受的压力。
本田的初次试水获得了立竿见影的成效，
他们的F1赛车因尺寸紧凑而易于操控。
由于墨西哥大奖赛所处的赛道高于海平面，
低气压通常会给引擎的动力输出带来一些影响。
在设计RA272的引擎时，前飞机工程师
兼本田的F1车队负责人中村良夫……
就确保了它能在高海拔地区正常运转，
使RA272在竞�9对手前抢占了先机。
而坐在获胜赛车中的车手里奇·金瑟尔，
也是一位真正专业的赛车大师！
所有的致胜因素在本田的第一个F1冠军头衔中
汇集到了一起。就这样，一段光辉的历史诞生了！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The Honda S series will always be remembered for the bold
way it tore up the race track!
It was Honda’s first mass-produced car and a true racer
that was active before its official release.
In 1963, a year before its debut, it took part in
a famous European rally called the Marathon de la Route.
A year later, the Honda S600 pulled off a
stunning GT1-class victory at the Japanese Grand Prix.
In the same year, it also competed in world endurance races,
such as the Nürburgring 500 km, where it won best-in-class.
Around this time, Honda was also performing well in Formula 1 and
had established itself as a major player in motorsports.
The year 1966 saw this S800, powered by a -engine.
This car became the vanguard of Japanese racing
well into the 1970s.
At the time, Honda had plans to establish a motorsports
support department for S seri�s competition racers.
This initiative would later result in the creation of the
Racing Service Center (RSC).
Today, RSC is known as Honda Racing Corporation (HRC), a
division of Honda overseeing motorsports activities.
Indeed, the S series is an indispensable part of Honda
and Japan’s racing history!
zh:
本田S系列将永远被人们铭记，因为它曾经以不羁
的风格征服了赛道！
它是本田的第一辆量产车，也是一款真正的
赛道机器，在其正式发售之前就活跃在赛场上。
1963年，在其正式发布的前一年，它就参加了
鼎鼎大名的欧洲拉力赛——84小时马拉松汽车耐力赛。
一年之后的1964年，在首次亮相后，本田S600
又在日本大奖�+�的GT1级别中取得了惊人的胜利。
同年，它还参加了世界耐力赛，
在纽博格林赛事上战胜了同级别最强大的对手！
在本田S系列大放异彩期间，本田在F1锦标赛中也屡有出色表现，
从而在赛车运动领域确立了自己的重要地位。
1966年，这款由引擎驱动的S800发布。
并且一直到1970年代都处于日本赛车的先锋地位。
当时�7本田就计划为参加S系列比赛的赛车手们
建立一个赛车运动支持部门。
这一提案在后来推动了赛车服务中心的创建……
也就是今天的本田赛车公司——专门统管其赛车活动的部门。
可以这么说，S系列是本田和日本赛车历史中
不可缺少的一部分！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The Type 930 911 Turbo was Porsche's first
true super car.
It appealed to a new kind of Porsche customer.
Indeed, the "Turbo" added another element.
Somewhere inside those Superman fender flares
and that big rear wing was...
...the humbleness of Clark Kent.
It was a success story from the time it made its debut
at the 1973 Frankfurt Motor Show.
The 911 truly presented the 19�0s for Porsche.
But did you know it was scheduled to be replaced?
That was before the Type 930 911 Turbo breathed new life
into the model.
Of course, we know this now in hindsight.
The original 930 had a long and strong production run
from 1975 to 1989...
...with an update to the new 964/965 platform in 1990.
Also of note was the "Turbo" script that became iconic
unto itself.
In fact, this script is still being used by�Porsche today
on all subsequent Turbos.
zh:
这辆Type 930 911 Turbo是保时捷第一款
真正意义上的超级跑车！
它还吸引来一批性格张扬的保时捷新车迷。
毫无疑问，这台“Turbo”树立起了一代传奇的形象！
这辆谦逊、简约的911就好比汽车领域的“克拉克·肯特”——
它的挡泥板和巨大的尾翼闪耀着如同超人般充满力量感的光泽。
自从在197�法兰克福车展上惊艳亮相的那一刻起，
这款车就迎来了巨大成功。
911成为了保时捷在70年代最闪耀的代言人。
不过你知道吗？如果不是Type 930 911 Turbo又为911系列
注入了全新的生命力。
这个系列原本将迎来被替换的命运。
当然，我们现在这么说也是事后诸葛亮罢了。
初代930在1975年到1989年之间持续生产了
很长的时间，产量也很庞大……
然后�3在1990年升级到了964/965平台。
另外值得一提的是，“Turbo”名称本身也成为了一代传奇。
事实上，保时捷直到今天还在沿用，
并推出了许多款后续的“Turbo”车型！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning
in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...
...Porsche needed to do something.
Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...
...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.
Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar,
getting Tony Hatter to design...
...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.
The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...
...its mid-engine architecture, making it look
like a rear-engine 991.
That said, it is wider and more aggressive.
As the saying goes in the automobile industry...
..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"
zh:
当越来越多的中置引擎福特和法拉利赛车在勒芒房车耐力赛、
世界耐力锦标赛和美国国际赛车运动协会等赛事中取得成功……
保时捷也必须要设法迎头赶上！
这辆中置引擎的911 RSR由格兰·拉尔森在2017设计……
算是保时捷相当激进的一步！
早在1996年，保时捷就已经进行过类似的尝试，
让托尼·哈特尔设计出……
一款基�$�933的中置引擎911 GT1。
这辆2017 RSR的外形轮廓巧妙掩饰了……
它的中置引擎架构，让它看上去像一辆引擎后置的991。
尽管如此，它的车身相对更宽，整体外形也更具侵略性！
就像是汽车行业内一句俗话说的那样……
“周日一胜，周一大卖！”

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
Imagine transforming a little French city car
into a mid-engine racer!
Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.
Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through
widened flanks and central dual exhausts.
Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced
with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.
This is most evident in the way the side edge line
"rolls" around the rear wheel...
...and in the use of a geometric design
for the front and rear grilles.
zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？
这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。
它的运动形态通过加宽的侧面裙边
和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。
有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典雷诺风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。
后轮的“管装”风道线条……
和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
For many fans who still adore its essential and compact
shape designed by Pininfarina...
...the 512 BB has achieved near-mythical status.
Its design was inspired by...
...the 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.
This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.
Although few people are aware of this...
...you may also notice details derived from the Modulo,
the 1970s Ferrari concept c�r.
The extruding wheel arches are one such detail.
But what everyone certainly remembers
about the 512 BB are...
...the large acrylic indicator covers in the front, the louvered
hood grille, the small NACA side air vents...
...and the lower bodywork painted matte black.
zh:
由宾尼法利纳所设计的精简和紧凑的外形
为512 BB赢得了大量的忠实粉丝……
他们也将这款车几乎捧上了神坛。
这辆车的设计灵感来源于……
1968年推出的P6双座特别版原型车。
这一点在其车头和座舱的设计上一览无余。
另外，你还可以从中看到
1970年代推出的法拉利概念赛车摩多罗的部分细节：�
例如其向外凸出的车轮拱罩就是其中之一。
不过，发现这些关联的人并不多。
不过，512 BB最让人印象深刻的记忆还是来源于……
车头几何形状的大尺寸亚克力转向灯罩、百叶窗式引擎罩格栅、
小型NACA侧面进气口……
以及哑光黑色的下部车身。

speaker: Stella
en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.
The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.
That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.
Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a fastback.
What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
"burgundy selection" grade!
From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
package is expressed in a most distinctive shade of red.
zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选马自达3准没错！
马自达3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。
尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。
以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而马自达
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。
另外，这款马自达3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！
从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This is the SF23, a car developed for the Super Formula series,
Japan's top-level formula race competition.
All teams participating in Super Formula must use
a race car with the same chassis.
Teams are also restricted to a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine
built by either Toyota or Honda.
That effectively makes Super Formula
a one-make race series.
In such a contest, victory is largel� decided by a combination
of individual skill and team strategy.
This is one of the major draws of Japanese
Super Formula races.
Super Formula machines are distinguished by their
aerodynamic design...
...which is meant to limit air resistance at the rear
and sides of the body.
Because these machines are so similar in capability,
the race becomes a test of a driver’s skill.
The SF23 pushes this concept to new heights,�
promising more dramatic wheel-to-wheel action!
zh:
这辆SF23是专为日本的顶级方程式系列赛事
——超级方程式所打造的赛车。
所有参与超级方程式的车队都必须
使用同一款底盘开发的赛车。
并且，所有车队也只允许采用由丰田或本田所开发的
两款规格一致的2升4缸涡轮增压引擎之一。
因此超级方程式本质上也是一项单一车种方程式赛事。
在这样�比赛中，胜利在很大程度上是由
车手个人和车队策略所共同决定的。
这也是日本超级方程式系列赛的主要魅力之一。
超级方程式赛车拥有非常独特的空气动力学设计……
致力于尽量降低车身两侧和后部的空气阻力。
由于赛车的性能旗鼓相当，因此这项赛事
也成为了车手操控技术的比拼。
到了今年，这款SF23又将这一理^��拔高到了全新高度，
保证可以为车迷们带来更激动人心的白刃战场面！"

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Ever since it was introduced, the Mercedes AMG GT3
has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.
The original AMG GT3 made its debut in 2016.
At its first Nürburgring 24 Hours race, it did the
unthinkable, achieving an amazing 1-2-3 finish!
This machine is the updated AMG GT3,
which was introduced in 2019.
It featured aerodynamic improvements that generated
greater downfo�ce than before.
Also, an all-new braking system placed less stress
on the tires.
While these performance upgrades resulted in
faster lap times...
...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability.
And, a vastly improved parts management system...
...as well as several other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanics.
zh:
自初代型号发布以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT3一直被誉为
最强最速GT3赛车。
初代AMG GT3在2016年首次登上赛车舞台。
在参加的第一场纽博格林24小时耐力赛里，
它令人震惊地包揽了前三名，创下了永垂史册的壮举！
我们面前的这款赛车是升级后的AMG GT3，
于2019年首次亮相。
经过全面强化的空气动力性能
确�可以提供超强的下压力！
而全新的刹车技术则有效降低了轮胎磨损的压力。
除了这些性能升级带来的更出色的单圈时间外……
这辆AMG GT3还配备了更耐用的引擎、
一套大幅升级的零部件管理系统……
以及多项精细调整，从而帮助车队在赛道上更加风驰电掣。

speaker: Stella
en:
The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous
Japanese formula race series.
The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said
to date back to the 1960s.
The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963.
Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars,
or "touring cars" to be precise.
Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own
formula race scene.
For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers
had to study abroad...
...at famous race schools in England, where they learned
the ins and outs of formula racing.
After that, they teamed up with Japanese automotive
engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.
zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。
据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。
第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。
在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。
自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式�车领域。
为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……
在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。
学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出了日本的第一款方程式赛车。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The R32 Skyline GT-R is popular the world over, but this NISMO
version is really something else.
NISMO, or "Nissan Motorsport International," is the company's
motorsports division.
It was established in 1984.
Back then, Japan was totally into international touring car races
starring the Super Silhouette and other Nissan greats.
Actually, ever since the 1960s, Nissan’s works team has won
many of Japan’s top grand prix races.
This wealth of experience is what made NISMO possible.
And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,
you know it was destined to be a legend!
zh:
R32 Skyline GT-R在全世界都非常有人气，但这台NISMO
却有其独特之处。
NISMO即“Nissan Motorsport International”的简写，负责管理日产的赛车部门。
它成立于1984年。
当时，以“Super Silhouette”和其他日产大赛为代表的
国际房车赛令整个日本都为之痴狂。
事实上，自1960年代以来，日产官方车队就登顶了
许多场日本顶级的大奖赛。
这些在比赛中积累的宝贵经验成为了NISMO设计的基石。
只要了解NISMO在这台GT-R中倾注的努力，你就知道
它是一台不折不扣的传奇！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
Aspiring to tone down the D-Type racer somewhat,
car designer Malcolm Sayer...
...gave Jaguar something that was aerodynamic, modern,
and dynamic.
That was this E-Type.
Although its engine was from a XK150 of the previous decade,
this monocoque racer was thoroughly modern.
It’s truly a thing of beauty!
zh:
为了推出一辆能与D-Type赛车争辉的新赛车，
汽车设计师马尔科姆·塞尔……
为捷豹带来了极其富有空气动力学、现代感
和动态感的设计理念。
促成了E-type的诞生。
虽然搭载了一台十多年前的XK150的引擎，这台单体车壳赛车
仍然是一台彻头彻尾的现代赛车。
它真是一件无与伦比美丽的造物！`

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
No doubt about it, the S30 has a sports-car design
that is quintessentially Japanese.
I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and
lines are just about perfect.
The over-fenders and long nose, which were added
to the ZG variant...
...actually balance the car quite nicely, giving it a more
"aggressive" charm, so to speak.
Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
zh:
毫无疑问，日产S30的跑车设计带有典型的日本风格。
我甚至可以毫不夸张地说，它的比例和线条都堪称完美。
它在ZG车型的基础上增加了宽挡泥板和长车头……
在外形上实现了平衡的观感，更为它赋予了
一种更具“攻击性”的魅力，
同时也没有忘记为它配上一套更宽的车轮！

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
en:
The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.
The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.
You see them quite often in the U.S.
The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.
However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.
A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...
...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.
zh:
雷克萨斯SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。
其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。
在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。
该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
丰田设计工作室Calty所设计。
然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。
作为日本超跑比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……
也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。|

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
There are a variety of ways to express your passion for cars.
This machine is a 1951 Ford.
Not only has it been lowered, the roof has been left intact,
and the body itself has been made thinner.
The engine is from a Lincoln of the same era.
The car creators pulled off in real life what designers
today would only attempt on a computer screen.
Cars from this era were simple to tune, having the p�tential
for customization unlike those of today.
Find a basic design that you fancy, and then inject your
own sense of beauty and experience into it...
...and you have your own one-of-a-kind masterpiece.
Every detail of this car is a 100-percent reflection of the
tastes and experiences of the car owner and creator.
Compare it with today’s exotic cars that await customers in the
showrooms, which one do you think stands ou� more?
zh:
表达对爱车的热情的方式可谓五花八门。
这是一辆1951年的福特。
它的全车车身经过了降低，没有锯掉车顶，
但整车外壳接受了打薄处理。
它的引擎来自于一辆同时期的林肯。
这辆车的创造者赤手空拳就做到了如今的汽车设计师们
只敢借助电脑才能完成的事。
与今天的车不同，来自那个时代的车� �易于调校，
也有很大的改装潜力。
找一辆你中意的基础车型，然后将你的美学与经验
倾注其中……
就能拥有一辆独一无二的杰作。
这辆车上的每个细节都100%体现了它的所有者
与创造者的品味与经验。
与如今静静地在展厅中等待着买家的豪车相比，
你更喜欢哪一辆呢？"

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
en:
Today, the WRX STI has grown into a model
with its own distinct identity...
...representing Subaru’s engineering capability, technical
efficiency and focus on high performance.
But the second-generation WRX STI remained closely
tied to the Impreza.
And that connection gave its character a unique appeal.
It effectively reflected the idea of an everyday sedan
transformed into a serious performance machine.
With the newer WRX, however, the base model already carried a more
aggressive character, making the contrast less pronounced.
If you’re drawn to that sense of transformation—like
Peter Parker becoming Spider-Man...
...then this second-generation model, with its clean, understated
cabin and simpler window design, may be just right for you.~
zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……
拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。
有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……
使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……
“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”
相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具�攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。
因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……
那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备�`角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
The Lexus LC 500 has absolutely incredible proportions.
With a long, low hood, a long wheelbase...
...a tight cabin, large wheels placed
at the corners...
...and an absolutely juicy body shape,
which is well-sculpted.
It has very technical headlamps and taillamps,
and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.
This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced
engine is under the hood. I absolutely love this car!
zh:
雷克萨斯LC500的车身比例十分惊人。
它具有修长而低矮的引擎盖，相对较长的轴距
和紧凑的驾驶舱，硕大的车轮更是占据了四角……
外加夺人眼球、线条精雕细刻的抢眼车身造型。
它的大灯和尾灯科技含量很高，前格栅
则是对雷克萨斯经典款式的重新演绎。
整体的造型都在告诉你——我的引擎盖下面安装了一颗
非常先进的引擎。这是我非常非常喜欢的一台车！"

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes
offers products that really take you by surprise.
The Wagon R was one such example. And so
 was this Swift Sport.
The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively
large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.
A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs
and nothing else.
If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d
think the car was designed by Italians.
zh:
铃木是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。
比如瓦罐R轻型车，又比如这款速翼特运动版。
这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。
这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。
如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。\

speaker: Freeman Thomas
resolved_car_en: Porsche 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster '56
resolved_car_zh: Porsche 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster '56
en:
The 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster takes the most
spartan model in the Porsche lineup...
...and pushes it into the level of "unobtanium."
The Speedster shape and form are an extension
of the other 356A models, but more extreme.
With its low wrap-around windshield, tall shoulder...
...and longer rear deck...
...the Speedster has attitude.
Both James Dean and Steve McQueen had Speedsters.
Unique to the Carrera GT are the deletion of
the side spears and sill deco.
The bumpers do away with the bumper horns and the deco
is replaced with aluminum trim.
You can also see the front leather tie-down straps
and GT roll bar.
The GT eventually received aluminum opening panels.
And even the normal-looking wheels are specially
constructed of steel and aluminum.
As with all Por�ches, you really need to take a close look at
each model to know all the variations.
zh:
356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster是基于保时捷产品线中
最简约的车型开发的……
又将其推向了“无法企及”的境界！
Speedster的外形沿袭了其他356A车型的设计，
但更加的极致……
低矮的环绕式挡风玻璃、高耸的轮眉……
还有更长的后部，
无不彰显其自成一派的风范！
詹姆斯·迪恩和史蒂夫·麦奎因都曾
将Speedster作为他们的�$�驾。
这个Carrera GT版本的独特之处在于
取消了侧面装饰条和侧裙装饰。
前保险杠取消了撞角，用铝制饰条取代了装饰件。
你还可以看到前盖的皮革固定带和后座的GT防护杆。
GT车型最终采用了铝制板材……
甚至看起来平平无奇的轮圈也是
钢铝混合材质的特殊结构。
保]��捷的车总是需要你仔细观察才能分辨出它与
普通“推杆”车型的各种差异！这一台也不例外。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The 1956 GS Carrera Coupe was the most powerful
and most luxurious Porsche available in its day.
This year marked the first time we saw the improved "A" model.
It was visually similar to the "pre-A,"
except it had the 15-inch wheels...
...with larger rear-wheel openings and non-rolled rocker sills.
The GS had the same sill and bumper trim as the lower
line models, but there really wasn't a visual �ifference...
...except for the fact that the rear sat a bit lower due to
the heavier 4-cam Carrera engine.
The interior was the same as well, except there were two
push-pull switches above the instrumentation.
This was to control the dual coils specific
to the Carrera engine.
When you opened up the rear lid, you saw the real difference between the A and pre-A.
The 4-cam Carrera engine was an artistic masterpiece!
The fan shroud and assembly were go�geous too!=
zh:
‘56 ‘GS’ Carrera Coupe是保时捷史上最强劲、最豪华的一款。
名称中的56代表经过大刀阔斧改进的365A新款
问世的首个年份。
在外观上，它与之前的“pre-A”车型非常相似，
唯一不同之处在于采用了新款15英寸车轮……
后轮轮拱更大，侧裙没有滚边。
由于GS车型与低端车型都采用同款侧裙和保险杠装饰，
�所以外观上并无差异……
只是因为搭载了更重的四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎，
车尾被压得更低。
内饰也几乎一模一样，只在
仪表板上方多了两个推拉按钮，
那是用来控制“Carrera”引擎独有的两个点火线圈的。
只有当你打开后引擎盖时，才能发现真正的差别所在！
你会发现，四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎简直是一件美妙的艺术品！
连风扇罩和总成��打造得异常精美！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The goal of J Mays and his team...
...was to make this car more of a European sports car
while not losing its American pony-car heritage.
It was truly a tough undertaking!
The resulting car is the quintessential Mustang...
...which looked like it went to finishing school in Europe.
The new side DLO with rear quarter window
was initially controversial...
...because the previous Mus�angs had a B-pillar separating
a scoop, window, or a clean panel.
The new DLO made the Mustang visually more sophisticated
and provided better visibility.
The front-end looked aggressive, with its thin, angled eyes
and aggressive grille!
The rear-end took the three-bar iconic taillights
to a new level.
It had a sequential blinker inspired by the '67/'68 Shelby.
And, did it ever look �ean, especially with optional big
wheels spaced-out to the edges!
zh:
梅斯及其团队的目标……
是使这款车更贴近一辆欧洲跑车，同时不失
其美式小马车的传统。
这确实是一个艰巨的任务！
他们最终的成果是一款典型的Mustang……
但跑去欧洲的商场采购装扮了一番。
新的后侧窗设计起初引发了不少争议……
前款Mustang的B柱非常宽厚，在后侧只隔出了一个�气口、
以及一扇小窗，或者叫它一块平整的玻璃更合适。
相比之下，新侧窗使这款Mustang在视觉上更加精致，
并提供了更好的侧后方视野。
前脸部分的设计更为激进
——细长而倾斜的大灯和狰狞的进气口极具攻击性！
经典的三道杠式尾灯设计被提升到了一个新的高度……
并采用了受到'67/'68 Shel�y启发的顺序闪灯效果。
在选配了几乎占满全部轮拱的大尺寸轮圈之后，
整车的姿态近乎完美，更显卓尔不凡！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The Genesis Coupé was a true sports car with RWD
and a  3.8-liter V-6.
The exterior styling was inspired by its RWD proportions.
This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with
a short front-overhang...
...and a cabin set rearward.
The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired
by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.
This proces� started with abstract black ink-brush strokes
to find the right facial and styling expressions.
The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique
character and interest.
In a way, this was an extension of the classical theme
of sketching...
...with the added bonus of allowing the brush strokes
to create unexpected graphics.
zh:
捷尼赛思Coupe是一款真正的后驱跑车，搭载一台
输出的3.8升V6引擎。
外观设计为了着重凸显后驱车的比例，
带来长轴距的前舱（从仪表盘到车头）、修长的引擎盖
和较短的前悬挂……
以及向后移置的车厢。
其造型的线条和样式均十分独特，是从东亚水墨画的
绘制过程中汲取了灵感。
在水墨绘画中，往往会用毛笔以抽象的墨色笔触
勾勒出准确的面部和造型表达。
其内核是追求独特的个性和审美趣味。
在某种程度上，它是素描这一经典画技的延伸……
并加入了以毛笔笔触带来的、意想不到的视觉效果。

speaker: Ed Welburn
en:
This car probably has the most dramatic profile
of a modern front-engine sports car.
The hood is long and low, and the cabin is placed well back
on the chassis, right over the rear wheels.
One of my favorite design features is how the front fender
vents are linked to the shape of the door opening.
Overall, the SLR McLaren has the look of speed,
grace, and elegance.
zh:
在现代前置引擎跑车中，这款车可能是车身比例
最吸睛的车型之一。
它的引擎盖修长而低矮，车厢后移置于底盘后部，
正好位于后轮上方。
前挡泥板通风口与车门门缝衔接的神来之笔
绝对是我最喜欢的特色设计之一。
总体而言，SLR迈凯伦展现出了速度、优雅
和风度兼具的外观。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s—
teen posters and American TV.
In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious,
totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.
First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.
Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail
and huge, iconic air inlets.
This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over
and was refl�cted in modified, banal city cars.
That’s how innovative it was!
Of particular note was the black grille, which hid
the rectangular rear lights...
...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round
taillights of previous Ferraris.
Another memorable oddity...
...was the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the
pillar, which was present in the very first versions.
zh:
Testarossa令人回想起80年代的狂热——
就好像当时的青少年海报和美国电视剧的张扬风格。
它的设计与前辈512 BB迥然不同，抢眼而张扬。
首先，Testarossa以其庞大的尺寸给人留下深刻的印象。
其巨大的楔形车尾和侧面巨大的标志性进气口也同样令人瞩目。
这一设计引得世界各地的改装者和车身制w��商纷纷效仿
——许多普通的城市车辆都被改装成这个样子，
成为了开创一代潮流的鼻祖！
特别值得一提的是，黑色的进气格栅内其实
隐藏了矩形尾灯……
这是法拉利首次摒弃之前车型经典的圆形尾灯。
另一个令人过目不忘的奇特设计……
是最早期版本中悬挂在A柱中央的单个侧后视镜。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked
a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.
It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.
Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes
of contemporary Formula 1 machines...
...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.
Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance,
its intersecting blocks�created space for its air intakes.
The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.
At the rear, there appeared, for the first time,
dual circular taillights...
...which would later be found on the F43�
and other subsequent Ferraris.*
zh:
以法拉利的创始人命名的法拉利Enzo标志着
法拉利史上的一次激进的设计变革。
它无疑是2000年代最具标志性的跑车之一。
此车的设计直接受到了当代F1赛车的
空气动力学造型启发……
以其尖锐的车鼻给人留下了“凶猛”的印象。
它就像一架喷气式战斗机，注重功能和性能，
互相交错的矩形表面为进气口创造了空间。
车厢设计也明显受到航空器的启发。
在车尾，两侧的双圆形尾灯首次亮相……
这种设计后来也出现在F430及其他后续车型上。<next id=2202009 type=9׾

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car
belonging to the GT category.
Designed for the track, it sat low, wide, and it was functional.
Thanks to its dynamic and muscular form, it was also
extremely aggressive.
The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with
the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.
That said, Renault desired to maintain a "family feeling"
in the front and rear...
...so it adopted the style of the lights and grille
of the production Mégane.
zh:
R.S. 01是一款真正的中置引擎赛车，隶属于GT类别。
它专为赛道设计——底盘低、车身宽且功能强大。
充满动感和肌肉感的外形也令它显得攻击性十足。
硕大的碳纤维尾翼给人留下深刻的印象，前扰流器
和后扩散器也同样引人注目。
尽管如此，雷诺还是希望在车头和车尾的设计上
保持“家族传承”……
因此借鉴了量产版梅甘娜的车灯和进气格栅的设计风格。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued
to work on a successor to the D-Type.
This was during the transition from a front-engine
layout to a mid-engine one.
While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT,
the base model for the GT40...
...and Ferrari gave us the LM...
...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same
design language as the D-Type.
