The result? A r�fined and aerodynamic prototype
with a V-12 mounted amidships.
The XJ13.
Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...
...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as
inspiration for the n�w legendary E-Type.
zh:
在1956年短暂退出赛车运动后，捷豹继续投入D-Type
后续型号的研发。
这款车诞生于从前置引擎向中置引擎布局过渡的过程中。
在福特推出GT40的基础车型，
即埃里克·布拉德利设计的罗拉 GT……
以及法拉利推出了LM的同时……
捷豹依然致力于沿袭D-Type的设计语言。
其最终成果是一款精致纯粹、拥��优秀
空气动力学性能、采用中置V12引擎的原型车——
XJ13。
XJ13由著名的马尔科姆·塞尔所设计……
尽管从未参加过任何比赛，但它无疑
�SE-Type的开发提供了大量的思路。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
If I’m not mistaken, this car was preceded by
the more radical Gallardo.
And yet the Huracán represented an evolution
in Lamborghini’s identity and design language.
Its use of hexagonal forms continues to be seen
in today’s Lamborghinis.
zh:
如果我没记错的话，这辆车的前款应该是
更加激进的“Gallard”。
然而，Huracán很好地展现了兰博基尼在品牌认同
和设计语言上的革命。
它采用的六角形元素至今可以在现款兰博基尼上看到。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
This 400R is the complete car, not the GT-R that was based
on the R33.
It’s a car for connoisseurs.
With new bumpers, air outlets,
and overfenders...
...it’s practically a different car, and yet it’s
incredibly sleek all the same.
zh:
这辆400R是一辆“完全体”的车，而不仅仅是脱胎于R33的GT-R。
这是一辆为鉴赏家们设计的车。
它采用了新的保险杠、出气口和轮眉……
实际上可以算成一辆完全不同的车了。
尽管如此，它的外观依然是那么的流畅和优美。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design,
the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.
As you can see, it represents a huge change in
design from the previous 599.
Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."
The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille
and two active air intakes for brake cooling...
...while the back is recog�ized by the "T" theme, visually
separating the extractor into two parts.
But the most characteristic elements
are the Aero Bridges...
Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks,
improving the overall aerody�amic efficiency.
zh:
这辆F12是由宾尼法利纳和法拉利设计合作设计的，
荣获了2014年度的金圆规工业设计奖。
如你所见，相比之前的599，它的设计发生了巨大的变化。
它那雕塑般的形状非常的紧凑和“凝实”。
前脸配备了庞大的中央格栅和两侧冷却刹车用的主动进风口……
攻击性十足，
而后部则v��清晰辨认出“T”型元素，在视觉上将排气管
分为左右两组。
但最具特征的元素还是“气动桥”……
它将引擎盖上的空气引导到车身侧面，从而提高了
整体的空气动力学效率。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena,
albeit with important technical changes...
...starting with the new V-8 engine.
It is also an evolution from a "style" perspective.
While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360,
it has a more aggressive and technical expression.
The large double-oval front air intakes...
...are inspired by the "shark nose" front
of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.
And the four Enzo-inspired circular taillights
add to its aggressive look.
zh:
这辆F430在设计上受到了360 Modena的强烈影响，
但也引入了一些重要的技术革新……
首先是一台全新的V8引擎。
从“风格”的角度上来看，你可以将F430视作是一种进化。
虽然采用了与360相同的车身板件和玻璃部件，
却给人以更具进攻性、更有科技感的印象。
它的大型双椭圆形前进气口……
灵感来源于1961年的法拉利156 F1上的“鲨鱼鼻”。
四个Enzo风格的环形尾灯则进一步地强化了它的进攻性。$

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The VW Sambabus is truly a design icon, with a design
language that’s whimsical and endearing.
It literally makes you smile.
It’s basically a functional box with rounded
corners full of character.
This "23" Window Sambabus has a fully-opening
pull-back cloth sunroof...
...windows that go round to the back corners,
and "panorama" windows on top.
Its color palette greatly adds to its visual charm.
zh:
大众的“Sambabus”是一款真正的设计代表作，它的设计语言
充满奇思妙想，同时又惹人喜爱！
不夸张地说，看到它你就会不由自主地露出微笑！
它的车身可以用长方体盒子来概括，再加上特征鲜明
的圆润边角。
这款“23”窗的Sambabus拥有可完全打开的
后拉式布制天窗……
以及从前一直环绕延伸到后方边角的大量侧窗，
顶上还有“全景式”的一圈边窗。
而丰富的车漆色系也为它的视觉魅力增色不少！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.
This version has enlarged front and rear windows.
The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window
changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.
In 1958, the rear window changed again
and became even larger.
With this model...
...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and
safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evo�ve again.
But the original character and charm remained.
The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.
Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite
a run, an� it’s still popular!<
zh:
1966大众1200甲壳虫延续了甲壳虫的可爱风格！
这个车型加大了前后车窗。
第一代“椒盐卷饼”的分块式后窗于1953款更换为了
更大片的椭圆形后窗。
在1958款中，后窗又经历了改进，尺寸进一步增大。
而到了这个车型中……
出于更好的可视性、轻盈感、动力和安全的需求，
引擎盖3个拱的形状�#�廓又一次发生了进化，
但原先的特色和魅力得到了保留。
最后一款风冷引擎的甲壳虫一直生产到2003年。
你想象一下，从1945年起到现在，这款车一共造了21529464辆！
这是多么漫长的生命周期啊。而且直到现在，
甲壳虫都还很有人气！%

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.
The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.
The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...
...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.
However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...
...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
zh:
这款车是对保时捷设计的全新“电气化”表达。
这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。
Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……
还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。
不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……
此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
resolved_car_en: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '99
resolved_car_zh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '99
en:
The Lancer Evo is a mundane Japanese family
sedan that's been transformed into a racing beast.
...a mild-mannered nobody transformed into a superhero...
...the kind typically found in comic books and action flicks.
So, what might the superpowers of this car be
from a design perspective?
Why, they are expressed by its sharp spoilers, bumpers
and grille!
All of this brings to mind the imposing image
of a samurai’s suit of armor.,
zh:
Lancer Evo是由日本最平淡的轿车产品
族系之一改造而来的比赛野兽。
它就像是漫画或者动作电影中常见的那种……
不显山露水的平凡人变成的超级英雄。
那么从设计角度来说，这款车的“超能力”是什么呢？
还用问吗，它那犀利的扰流板、保险杠和
前格栅就能充分回答这个问题了！
所有这一切都让人不由得联想到日本武士的盔甲。\

speaker: Fabio Filippini
resolved_car_en: Renault Sport Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy '16
resolved_car_zh: Renault Sport Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy '16
en:
The Renault Clio RS is an icon of Europe’s
"Supermini" segment.
The Williams version of the original series is remembered
with particular fondness.
Like its forebears, this RS version of the fourth-series model
combined extreme sportiness with quiet urbanity.
In terms of design, this car has sportiness in its DNA.
Its muscular shapes, aggressive front, and the concealed
rear-door ha�dles in its C-pillars...
...give one the impression of a two-door coupe.
Thanks to this, the sportier bumpers, aero details, and low
stance with 18-inch wheels and red calipers...
...are sufficient to visually transform it into a little
racing "weapon."
zh:
雷诺Clio RS是欧洲“超迷你”类型
中的标志性车型。
第1代中的Williams版本尤其受到
广大车迷们的喜爱和铭记。
和前代车型一样，这款第4代的RS版本也完美综合了
极致的运动性能和安静的都市驾乘体验。
从设计上讲，这款车的确具备运动的基因。
它采用了充满肌肉感的外形、极富侵略性的前�&，
并将后门的把手隐藏在C柱之中……
给人以双门跑车的观感。
基于这种设计，再加上运动感十足的保险杠、空气动力学细节
以及应用了18寸轮毂和红色卡钳的超低姿态车身……
足以在视觉上将它充分改造成一款赛道小钢炮！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
This is the car every car designer dreams of doing!
It’s gorgeous!
Its influence is, of course, the 917!
The cabin is low and sleek, with extreme cab-forward
architecture, like that of the original 917.
The windshield shape is like a visor wrapping
around the sides...
...while the front has a bit of 918 DNA.
A slightly restrained low, narrow mouth...
.�.and four headlamps seem to forecast the new Porsche
headlight DNA of the 919, raced at Le Mans.
The wheels are similar to the 918.
The rear spoiler is interesting, as it connects the fender
forms and has the taillamp integrated flush below.
The paint scheme is inspired by the Le-Mans-winning
"Porsche-Salzburg" 917K...
...run by the Porsche-Piech family team in Austria.
zh:
这是一款所有汽车设计师都梦寐以求想要打造的车型！
它简直太漂亮了！
这也是理所当然的，毕竟参照的基础车型可是917！
和原版917一样，它的驾驶舱高度较低，呈流线型设计，
并采用了驾驶舱极度前置的结构。
挡风玻璃的形状更像是一副包裹住侧面的面罩……
前脸略微透露出918的血统。
其略显克制且低窄的进气口……
和四盏大灯则预言了随后在勒芒参赛的919
所引领的保时捷大灯设计理念。
它的轮毂与918类似。
其后扰流板与挡泥板直接相连，从而将尾灯顺畅地
整合在下方，显得趣味十足。
它的涂装方案灵感来源于由奥地利的保时捷·皮耶希家族
车队经营，并在勒芒取得胜利的……
“保时捷·萨尔茨堡�&917K。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.
But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?
The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear.
This became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.
zh:
作为全球首款混动汽车，普锐斯曾引发轰动性的风潮。
不过你知道吗？它的第一代设计被普遍认为有所欠缺，
不够完美。
从第二代车型开始，普锐斯采用了从车头到
“断尾”车尾的一体成形轮廓……
这随后就成为了普锐斯产品系列的标准设计，
你在这款外形美观的第三代车型中也能看到。[

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
This rare S model was built by British coachbuilder Barker,
best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.
In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles
that of a Rolls-Royce.
Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as
chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...
...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race
at the Nürburgring in 1927.
Powered by an inline-6 mounted �id-wheelbase,
it is distinguished by its massive hood.
This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.
In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies
by French and Italian coachbuilders.
zh:
这款极其罕见的S系列是由因为与劳斯莱斯合作而闻名的
英国车身制造厂巴克所打造的。
其实你可以看出，它的车身与劳斯莱斯非常相似。

这辆S型的设计者是当时仍在戴姆勒-奔驰担任
首席工程师的斐迪南·保时捷博士……
并在1927年纽博格林赛道的开幕赛事上获胜，
向世人展现出了巨大的潜力。
它�
�一部中置直列六缸引擎提供动力，
其巨大的引擎盖尤为吸睛，
也赋予了这辆车极具运动感的比例。
除了由梅赛德斯-奔驰打造的原厂车身外，这辆S型还可以采用
法国和意大利车身制造厂推出的车身。

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
en:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed
my car designer life on the line.
I worked on it from the standpoint of really making
the dream sports car I have in my mind.
And one of the most important things for a sports car
is its fundamental structure.
Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at
today all have exceptionally great proportions.
So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION
was also the s�ructure.
A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose,
and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.
In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm
from the structure we had originally designed,
the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.
In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...
But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels,
and�thought "This will work!"
That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret
to making someone go "Hmm".
The other secret is the reflection of light.
If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll
notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.
Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.
And it's a very rare industrial product
that runs around on its own.
That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running
around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.
And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be
something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.
And for that you need a "sense of life."
So when thinking about what is the sense of life,
that will put cars at one with nature,
we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections
6nd their beauty on the car's body.
And those are the type of shapes
that are instilled in the RX-VISION.
zh:
说到RX-VISION，那可是我赌上专业设计师的身份，
倾注全部心血的作品。
我想通过它，把我脑海中理想跑车的样子变成现实。
设计跑车，最关键的就是定好基本结构。
你看那些经典车型，哪个不是比例优美？
所以我设计RX-VISION时，第一步就是确定它的结构。
我先是采用了教科书般经典的前置引擎后�#�驱动
设计——就是那种前脸很长，重心偏后的布局。
然后，在定稿前的最后一刻，我又把前鼻加长了150mm。

具体来说，就是加在了从前门到前轮中心那一段。
这么一改，车身比例看起来有点不太协调……但是这样
做能让后轮抓地力更强。
当时我就想：“嘿，没准这主意不错！”
就这样，一个小小的设计巧思成了这辆车的独特之处。
RX-VISION还有另一个让人惊喜的地方——光影效果。
只要绕着车子转一圈，你就会觉得它像个有生命的东西。
对于车迷来说，汽车就跟家人朋友一样亲密。
跟一般的工业产品不同，汽车是为了奔跑而生的。
它们有点像在野外奔驰的动物，或是在赛场上飞奔的运
动员。
当我生出这个念头时，我就W��道我不仅要让RX-VISION
美，还要让它“活”起来。
为了达到这个效果，我得给它注入“生命感”。
在思考怎么才能让它看起来更自然时……
我开始实验光线在车身上的反射效果。
就这样，RX-VISION活灵活现地呈现在了大家面前！

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
en:
In the Japanese Super Endurance Series,
I myself race in the MAZDA3 race car.
Lots of effort went into the MAZDA3 as a production model
of course, but it was also drawn with the racing scene in mind.
In this racing modified version as well, I tried to maintain
the original shape of the MAZDA3 as much as possible.
The modification including the livery is something that doesn't
disrupt the beauty and silhouette of the car.
Another point of focus was how good it looks when running.
Like how the rear tread sticks out like
a proper Super Endurance race car.
When you're overtaken by this car, I think you'll really notice
how good it looks from the back...
...so on the track, I'd appreciate if you would let me pass!
zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！
马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。
所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。
不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。
当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。
怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。
效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！
所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰到我，可得乖乖让道。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
en:
I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars
in my career as a car designer.
The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.
In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses
a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.
And the design of the MAZDA3 is an achievement of that form
created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.
It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car
that will mark its name in history.
zh:
马自达3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。
它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。
我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。
而马自达3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。
我个人很喜欢马自达3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
resolved_car_en: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
resolved_car_zh: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
en:
In a way this Atenza is my debut work. There were a lot of
obstacles, and it brings back a lot of memories.
I was appointed the general manager of the design division
in 2009, to be the leader of Mazda design,
but I was told about my new position just 2 weeks before, so
I became general manager without any time to be ready.
And the first production car that I worked on,
was this Atenza.
Given�this major role and responsibility,
this was a state of emergency for me,
but it was just as much a chance as it was a crisis.
It was a time in which the design theme for the next generation of
Mazda's were being considered from almost scratch,
and I thought to make design the major
pillar of Mazda from here and now.
And actually, the development of this car had already progressed
quite a bit under the previous design manager already,
but after th�nking that we need to create the philosophy of Mazda
for the next age, and make design itself one of the pillars,
I made the decision to completely change the design
that was already in motion.
To do this it was necessary to redesign things that normally
should not be touched in terms of the development schedules.
As a result, the final design schedule for the production car
was delayed about 10 months...
And I was really scolded badly by the managing d�rector
of development at the time. A LOT.
At the time I was working on the "SHINARI" concept car
that would be the vision model for the next era,
and I translated the design theme of SHINARI to the production car
because it was a car made alongside the SHINARI.
It's a car that I personally care for a lot, I was
even still driving it until very recently.
Its been over 10 years now, but I think
its a design that doesn't feel old.
The more you work onwstandard cars, the more you understand
the power of design.
And saloons are difficult to design, because
they are the base for all cars.
I think timeless cars of an orthodox category is where
the ability of designers are truly tested.
zh:
阿特兹可以说是我的设计生涯的开端，说起来，这个项
目真是苦乐自知，回忆满满啊。
2009年，我突然被任命为马自达设计部门的部长。
事情非常突然，我只有两周时间来适应这个新职位。
我接手后参与的第一款量产车就是阿特兹。
说实话，那会儿真是责任重大，差点儿没把我压垮。
不过，我硬是x��这个危机扭转成了成功的机遇。
当时，马自达正在为下一代车型寻找新的设计主题。
我的想法是把“设计哲学”作为马自达未来发展的支柱。
老实说，前任部长在阿特兹上已经下了不少功夫。
但为了实现我的新一代设计理念……
我决定把这个已经在顺畅推进的项目推倒重来。
也就是说，一些通常在生产后期不会再改动的部分，我
们也^��重新设计。
结果就是这款量产车设计进度整整推迟了10个月左右。
这下可把上司们气得不轻——他们当时大发雷霆。
与此同时，我还在筹备一款叫“靱”的概念赛车，它将成为
马自达下一代的前瞻性参考车型。
有意思的是，因为“靱”和阿特兹的开发是同期进行，
它们俩最后用上了同一个设计主题。
说真的，阿特兹U��我来说意义非凡。事实上，直到前不
久我还在开这车呢。
虽然这款车已经面世十多年了，但它的设计仍然经得住
时间的考验。
你知道吗？你在标准车型上花的功夫越多，就越能体会
到设计的魔力。
尤其是轿车，看起来再普通不过，设计起来反而最难。
所以，要评估一位设计师的水平，关键在于他能否为正
统车型设计出经久不衰的作品。

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
en:
This was a car that was produced with the concept:
"if Mazda was to compete in the top category of the Le Mans,
what would be a great design."
The LM55 name stands for "Car Number 55 of Le Mans,"
and is taken from the legendary racing car of Mazda.
I remember that we did a full aerodynamic simulation, and really
went through a thorough development process for this car.
We had engineers knowledgeable about racing �ars
also become involved in the development.
There is a full scale model as well, and its on display
in the Mazda Museum.
And actually, my name is on the car as the driver.
It is from the wish that if this car appears, and it runs
on the Le Mans, that I want to be the driver.
The Le Mans hyper car class regulations allow
a fair amount of design freedom...
and if we make a car like this and compete,
that would be a huge opport�nity!
zh:
这辆车回答了这样一个问题：“马自达要怎样设计，
才能在勒芒顶级组别的赛事中一争高下？”
LM55这个名字中，“LM”是“勒芒”的缩写，
“55”则是“55号赛车”，是向马自达的一位传奇赛车手致敬。
设计这辆车的时候，我记得我们进行了多项测试，
还包括全面的空气动力学模拟。
而且还特意请来了对赛车有深入�解的工程师支援……
我们甚至还做了个1:1的实物模型，现在就摆在
马自达博物馆里呢。
哦对了，你可能会发现车手名单里有我的名字。为什么？
因为要是有朝一日它真的能征战勒芒，我想亲自开上它！
勒芒超级跑车组别的规则给了设计师很大的发挥空间……
所以，要是我们真能造出这样一辆车去参赛，嘿，说不
定真能捧回^��军奖杯呢！

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
resolved_car_en: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
resolved_car_zh: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
en:
In my mid 20's I was assigned to a position in the US,
and the FD was a car from that time.
It was when Matano-san was in the US studio, and the clay model
for this car was being made in the design studio.
It isn't a car that I worked on myself, but I remember
thinking that the shape of this car is really great.
The greatness of this car is in the relationship
between the tires and the body.
The body is thin vertica�ly, and the tires have a sense of presence,
and it is a honed 3 dimensional shape with no excess anywhere.
That's why this car still doesn't look old.
Its beautiful.
The original idea came from a designer named Wu-Huang Chin.
He draws surfaces like this just with a marker. He's
a design genius who is really good at drawing.
I think you could say that the FD and NA Roadster of this era
are at the pinnacle of the Mazda design �istory.
Their ability to work 3 dimensional shapes at the time
was truly world class
and this is a product from the time when the foundations of
Mazda design was formed.
zh:
说起这款FD，那可得追溯到我20多岁的时候了，那会儿
我还在美国工作呢。
那时俣野努先生也在美国工作室任职，这辆车的黏土模
型就是在那儿做的。
虽然不是我个人参与设计的，但我记得当时就觉得这辆
车的造型很独到。
这车最棒的地方就是轮胎和车身的比例关系。
车身压低变薄，让轮胎显得特别醒目，整体看上{��给人
一种精雕细琢的感觉，一点儿多余的东西都没有。
正是这种设计，让它成为了经典。美，真的太美了。
这车最初的创意图来自一位叫秦无荒的设计师。
这位老兄可是个设计天才，画功了得。你敢信吗？
他就用一支马克笔就把这车给设计出来了。
要我说，这个年代的FD和NA Roadster绝对是马自达
历史上最杰出的两个设�。
当时马自达处理三维形状的能力确实是世界一流的。
正好也赶上了马自达的设计理念刚开始成型的时候。

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
en:
This is a car for which I was the Chief designer.
I also owned this RX-8 for quite a while.
Actually my children were born in the year
that the RX-8 was announced.
They were twin boys, but in our house it was already decided
from the very beginning that our family car would be an RX-8.
The RX-8 was perfect for raising twins.
One reason is that the RX-8 is a 4 door, but you can't
open the rear �oors without opening the front doors.
So even when they were at a rambunctious age, I could drive
without worrying about them accidentally opening the doors
To make a silhouette that looks like a sports car with 4 doors
and with proper space for 4 people,
is actually very difficult.
There's not many cars in the world that have accomplished this.
It would be great to design something again
with this package and engine one day.
There was a Mazda Fan Festa event the other day,
at a circuit in Okayama.
There were a lot of RX-8 owners there. I really appreciate the
fact that they are taking great care of these cars even today.
zh:
说起这款RX-8，我可是它的首席设计师。不仅如此，
我自己也有一辆RX-8，开了相当长一段时间。
实际上，我家的双胞胎恰好就出生在RX-8发布的那一年。
我生的是一对男孩，但在他们出生之前，我就打定主意
要把RX-8作为家里的家用车。
RX-8简直就是为带双胞胎量身定做的。
虽然它是一辆四门车的，但有z��特别之处：前门得先打
开，后门才能开。
这可就省心了，我再也不用担心那两个调皮蛋在我开车
时不小心把门拉开了。
说实话，要设计一辆既有跑车范儿，还能舒舒服服坐四
个人的四门车……
不是件容易事。
能做到这一点的车真不多。
有朝一日要是我能再设计一款这种配置和引擎的车型
就好了。
前几天，我�'�冈山参加了个马自达车迷聚会……
我看到好多人都是开着RX-8来的。这么多年过去了，这
款车还是很有人气，真令人开心。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
en:
If you ask me, this car is less of a design study than it is
a study in aerodynamics.
The roofline runs straight across the body to the rear,
where it abruptly cuts off in a coda tronca.
This tells me that it may have been developed as a prototype
for engineering purposes.
zh:
依我看，这辆车更像是一项“空气动力学研究”
而非“设计研究”。
车顶线条贯穿整车一直延伸到后部，
突然以“断尾”的形式戛然而止。
我有个大胆推测，它可能是以工程研究为目的
而开发的原型车。/

speaker: Sarah
en:

What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.
The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.

这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家乌尼巴尔·卡姆，

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
resolved_car_en: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR '06
resolved_car_zh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX    MR GSR '06
en:
The Evo’s history is marked by constant improvements
and functional expansions.
This MR version was the final model of the third-gen Evo IX,
and is said to be one of the best Evos ever.The third-generation car was based on the Lancer Cedia,
which, in turn, was a serious and practical family sedan.
Compared to the second-generation model, it was larger overall.
The nose took on a rounded s�ape, while blister fenders were adopted.
Not quite the battle machine it used to be...
...the large iconic fog lights, reminiscent of rally cars,
were done away with.
It was a sign that the Evo was expanding its sphere of competition
to include endurance races and the like.
At the same time, the car's upscale nature grew.
Multi-purpose cars like the Evo tend to adapt
to their surroundings.
In this sense, they evolve like living things.
And �hat is just one of the many reasons that
fans continue to love the Evo.
zh:
在翼豪陆神的发展史上，充斥着持续不断的改进和功能拓展。
这款MR版本是第三代翼豪陆神IX的终极车型，
也被公认为最卓越的翼豪陆神之一。
第三代翼豪陆神的开发基于蓝瑟西迪亚，
一款普通而实用的家庭轿车。
相较于第二代，它的车身整体更大，车头被重新设计得
更加圆润，同时加入了引�$注目的凸起轮拱。
它不再保持曾经的战斗机器风格……
标志性的硕大雾灯，以及那些让人联想到
拉力赛车的元素，也不复存在……
这暗示着翼豪陆神正在将其竞争领域从耐力赛扩大到
更多不同领域。
与此同时，车辆的高端进阶属性也更为凸显。
像翼豪陆神这样的多功能车型往往能够灵活
适应不同的环境。
从这个意义上说，它们就像�生物一样在不断演变进化。
这正是车迷们一直对翼豪陆神怀有深厚感情的众多原因之一。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.
A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...
...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.
This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."
It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.
I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.
A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。
作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……
在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，
从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……
以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。
我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆克莱斯勒300 SRT。
宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。

speaker: Chris
en:
This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.
In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.
The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...
...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.
Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.
In its effort to meet NASCAR ho�ologation,
the Superbird was sold for but one year...
...and few were ever produced.
Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.
Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
an� race cars greatly resembled each other.
zh:
这一辆是美国改装赛车比赛中的传奇。
在改装赛车比赛中，量产型的车辆通常是以原始的出厂配置的状态直接参与竞速。
这辆Superbird的大号后翼和长车鼻都是竞速利器……
能够帮助它赢得美国的顶级改装赛车赛事——纳斯卡赛车。
事实上，这些车身部件都是专门服务于量产型车辆的特殊竞速部件。
为了满足纳斯卡赛车的赛事资格认证条件，
Superbird仅对外销售一年……
总产量也不多。
在那之后，改装赛车比赛开始涌入越来越多种类的赛车。
的确，这款车来自于那个公路车和赛车
相似度极高的时代。

speaker: Stella
en:
Do you know the history of AMG?
It started out as a company that built racing engines.
At the helm were two engineers.
They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.
These two worked in the race-engine forge
of Daimler-Benz.
When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...
...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into
business together.
They founded their engineering company out of
Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.
Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,
they christened their company "AMG."
That was in back in 1967!
zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？
它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……
由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……
和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。
二人曾经在戴姆勒-奔驰的赛车引擎铸造厂工作。
当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……
奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。
于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国�>�罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。
他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中
各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。
那是在1967年！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.
Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...
...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.
See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?
This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.
That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。
虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……
但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。
你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。
这种设计与MGA和AC艾斯，以及弗雷泽·纳什
和赛百灵非常类似。
换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。/

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
This was a very unique car in the sense that Toyota’s
designers had to create an original design style for it.
It feels expertly sculpted.
In order to fit a 6-cylinder engine, the Supra’s nose
had to be extended, both physically and visually.
As a result, it looks like a powerful grand tourer.
zh:
这是一款非常独特的车型，丰田的设计师们
注入了完全原创的设计风格。
它的车身给人以精雕细琢的感觉。
为了塞入一台6缸引擎，这辆Supra的车头不得不
横向加宽，也呈现出更豪迈的视觉风格。
最终的造型也更接近一辆性能强大的豪华旅行车。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
en:
Now, this is one aggressive Beetle!
It's a car that proves the motorsports potential
of the good ol’ bug.
Take note of its extremely low stance, wide
motorsport fenders...
...and the exhaust pipe jutting out from its front
arch!
Its large five-spoke wheels are typical of Volkswagen’s
expert design team.
And, its body is simply brimming with confidence.
Indeed, it exudes the luxury that only a top-tier
design studio can deliver.
And the bright graphics contribute nicely to the overall
look of the car.
zh:
哇，这可真是一辆外观凶悍的甲壳虫啊！
它的存在证明了平日的小可爱
也具有赛场竞速的巨大潜力！
请注意它极低的车身姿态，宽大的
赛车级挡泥板……
以及顺着前轮拱突出的排气管！
它采用了大号五轮辐轮毂，这也是
大众专业设计团队的专属。
它的车身也从头到尾彰显着一股自信。
这份自信源自它所呈现出的奢华品质
——只有顶级的设计工作室能够实现。
车身上各种鲜艳显眼的几何图案更是为
整体外观锦上添花！

speaker: Stella
en:
I know this Civic very well!
It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.
The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.
You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.
What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?
The engine swaps, of course!
Fo� example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.
But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.
It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its ro�r is simply unforgettable!
zh:
我对这种类型的思域非常熟悉！
准确来说，这是一辆1990年代生产，被称为“运动思域”
的第五代“EG”思域。
从其昵称中的“运动”二字就能看出它的速度有多快，
此外它的引擎设计和声浪也无出其右。
你经常会看到这款车被调校成各种不同的形态。
你知道关于运动思域的调校，我最爱哪一方面吗�
当然是更换改装引擎啦！
比如说，大排量的本田K-引擎可以给你澎湃的声浪、
风驰电掣的速度和充沛的动力。
不过我的最爱还是Type R B-引擎。
虽然动力不如K-引擎，但它的咆哮声绝对令人
终生难忘！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This is one of my favorite Skylines—the R31, and a Group A
homologation GTS-R!
Who could forget its performance at the Japanese Touring Car
Championship, Japan’s top touring car series in the 1980s?
It's no doubt best known for its performance
in the 1989 JTC season.
That year saw three Skyline GTS-Rs competing on the track.
Masahiro Hasemi and Anders Olofsson’s
No. 50 car won three of six races!
What a way to clinch the series title!
And the way it stood up to those mighty European cars...it was a sight to behold!
zh:
这是我最爱的一辆Skyline——R31，而且这辆GTS-R
还获得了A组别认证！
它在1980年代日本顶级房车赛事——日本房车锦标赛上
的优异表现实在让人过目难忘！
它最亮眼的一次表现无疑是在1989年日本房车锦标赛系列赛上。
就在这一年，三辆Skyline GTS-R在比赛中同台竞技……
其中长谷见昌弘和安德斯·奥洛夫松驾驶的50号赛车
赢下了六场比赛中的半数！
这是多么震撼人心的夺冠过程啊！
更不必说它勇敢挑战那些强大欧洲赛车的英姿——
真是太酷了！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
en:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also in overall design…
...which some attribute to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s main engineer.
Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.
With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...
...a sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...
...it's a basic example of the "Jaray-style."
zh:
很多人认为保时捷不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到大众的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……
并将之归功于艾尔文·柯曼达的天才头脑，
这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。
但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。
在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……
后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……
这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。_

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
The Baby Lambo was added to broaden the market reach
of Lamborghini as a brand.
Unlike its super-car counterparts, the "Babies"...
...are known for their sharper surfaces, tighter dimensions,
and overall efficiency.
The Gallardo is a great example, exhibiting no excess
from any angle.
zh:
宝贝兰博”系列的推出旨在拓宽兰博基尼品牌
的市场。
与其超级跑车的兄弟相比，这些“小型”车型……
以更锐利的车身线条、更紧凑的车身尺寸
和整体上的高效设计而著称。
Gallard就是一个很好的例子，从任何角度看都能展现
出简洁而精致的设计，没有任何多余的元素。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.
The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker
in both its roof line and overall proportions.
Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look
with each evolution.
With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath
the 911.
Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and
beefy footwork...
...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can
take on much bigger competition.\
zh:
迄今为止，Cayman已经历了数次更新换代。
中置引擎的布局强化了车顶线条和整体比例的流线感。
事实上，Cayman的每次进化都让其更加凌厉。
升级到GT4版本后，它不再被定位在911之下。
凭借其强大的气场、富有侵略性的外观
和稳健的操控性能……
它已经从一款休闲性能车升级为能够与更高级别对手
竞争的真正赛道利器。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
The Type R has the perfect balance of cosmetic and
mechanical tuning.
Its design is simply iconic.
Equally well-balanced in its proportions, it has a great
stance that speaks to its agility on the track.
The car that set the standard for FWD racers,
it still looks great.
What’s more, it captured the spirit of JDM tuners better
than any other model that came after it.-
zh:
本田Type R在外观设计和机械性能调校方面
达到了完美的平衡。
它的设计堪称经典。
其车身比例同样协调，完美的车身姿态充分
展现了它在赛道上的灵活性。
这款车型为前驱性能车树立了标杆，
时至今日依然魅力不减。
更重要的是，它比后续其他车型都更好地
诠释了日本国内改装车（JDM）文化的精髓。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
en:
This is the high-performance version of the F430, developed
with the help of Michael Schumacher.
Stylistically, it is distinguished by a sharp front, large
air intakes, and enhanced brake cooling ducts.
However, the biggest difference is in the rear.
Here we have a large engine grille...
...and a big diffuser framed by a band with two large, round
exhausts on either side of the license plate.
To emphasize its sportiness, the side mirrors have been done
in carbon fiber...
And a two-tone livery is available as an option.
zh:
这是在迈克尔·舒马赫的协助下开发的F430高性能版本。
在外观设计上，它以更锐利的前脸线条、更大的进气口
和优化后的刹车冷却导风口与其他版本区分开来。
然而，最显著的区别在于车尾设计。
这里我们可以看到一个大尺寸的引擎舱散热格栅……
以及一个大型的底部扩散器，由一条装饰带��围，
两个大型圆形排气管则位于车牌的两侧。
为了突出其赛车基因，后视镜采用了碳纤维材质……
此外，还提供了双色条纹涂装作为可选项�k

speaker: Freeman Thomas
resolved_car_en: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
resolved_car_zh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
en:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine.
A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.
The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.
The sober theme is continued on the inside.
The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.
Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for
"Reutter Carosserie?"
This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.
The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!
A small bit of triv�a!!.
zh:
拥有长串名字的翼豪陆神VIII MR GSR车型是一款非常特别
的座驾。它是一辆具有拉力赛血统的运动型轿车。
翼豪陆神的外观设计简洁而内敛，但实用的大型尾翼
为其增添了亮点。
这种简洁风格在内饰中得以延续。
主要的区别在于厚实的方向盘和
高包裹性的Recaro赛车座椅。
你知道吗？“Recaro”这个名字��实是
“Reutter Carosserie”的缩写。
在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。
后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaro”的名义专门生产座椅！
这是个有趣的小知识！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Subaru won the World Rally Championship's Manufacturers' Title
three years in a row.
It was from 1995 to 1997, and I still remember the thrill
of witnessing that incredible achievement.
Equally exciting was when the company introduced the Impreza WRC
in 1997!
The "WRC" in its name stood for "World Rally Car,"
and it was a new version...
...that allowed a wider range of modifications
permitted by Group A regulatio�s.
Previously a 4-door sedan, the Impreza
was reborn as a sporty 2-door coupe.
But it wasn't all about style. It performed like a sports car!
In the 1997 season, the Subaru rally team...
...Won eight of 14 races, including the opening rounds
in Monte Carlo, Sweden and Kenya.
This incredible performance led to the team taking home
its third consecutive WRC title.
The Impreza WRC continued to ev�lve
until the year 2000.
It was a car that defined its era and hailed as an
important part of WRC history.
zh:
斯巴鲁——世界拉力锦标赛三冠王！
我永远不会忘记1995年到1997年那段激动人心的时光。
同样令我振奋不已的还有1997年翼豹世界拉力赛车的到来！
世界拉力赛车是“世界拉力赛车”的缩写，也是当年引入的新规格……
相比A组规则，世界拉力赛车组可以进行更广泛的改装。
翼豹原本是一款�门轿车，经过回炉重造，成为
一款漂亮的双门车型。
但它不仅长得好看——它真的能跑得很快！
在1997赛季，斯巴鲁拉力车队
在全年的14场比赛中赢得了8场，包括
在蒙特卡洛的开幕战、以及瑞典和肯尼亚站。
惊人的表现也让斯巴鲁连续第三次赢得
世界拉力锦标赛冠军。
翼豹世界拉力赛车持续改装进化，直至2000年。
这款车定义了它所处的时代，至今仍被视为
世界拉力锦标赛历史的重要组成部分。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
resolved_car_en: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
resolved_car_zh: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
en:
The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement
in the history of automotive design.
Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world
of rally racing.
And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car
technology ever since.
Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of
resin and Kevlar.
And its steeply raked windshield provides better visibility
than many of its peers.
With wide fenders, a short wheelbase, and somewhat awkward
proportions, it may not have been the prettiest machine.
But as a purpose-built competition car,
it delivered outstanding results.
zh:
奥迪quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。
它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……
并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。
其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……
挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。
它的挡泥板宽大，轴距短，显得比例很不协调。
然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。

speaker: Tom Matano
en:
This is the first Civic that wore the Type “R” designation.
This model started the tradition that continues to this day.
When compared to the latest Type “R” model,
it was much purer and simpler.
It shows that times have changed during the past 20 years,
like an evolution of a sneaker design.
zh:
这是第一款得到“Type R”命名的思域。
也开启了延续至今的传统。
与最新的Type R车型相比，它更加纯粹和简洁。
它展示了过去20年间的车型变化。就像
运动鞋设计的演变一样。!

speaker: Fabio Filippini
resolved_car_en: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
resolved_car_zh: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
en:
This car has a dynamic and elegant design.
Called the Atenza, it incorporates the 4-door sedan-coupe layout,
and the style inspired by Mazda Design's "Kodo" philosophy.
In my eyes this design reinterprets the classic sensuality
of Italian sports cars from the 1960s...
...with a typically Japanese sensitivity of surfaces and details.
Soft and fluid shapes with evolving �urfaces are enhanced
by specially developed metallic colors.
It is not by chance that in Mazda’s communication campaigns,
the cars are often shown in red...
...thus reviving a somewhat "Latin" sporting imagery,
made up of emotions and movement.
zh:
阿特兹兼具动感和优雅的设计。
它重新诠释了20世纪60年代意大利跑车的经典性感……
又同时具备日本车典型的对于表面和细节的敏感。
这款车采用四门轿跑车的布局，
并融入了马自达设计部提出的“魂动”设计理念。
柔和的流畅线条与不断演变的表面
被专门开发的金属色车x��进一步增强。
在马自达的不同广告宣传中，经常以红车示人。>
这并非偶然，红色唤起了某种充满情绪和动感的极致激情意象。@

speaker: Freeman Thomas
resolved_car_en: Honda Civic Type R Limited Edition (FK8) '20
resolved_car_zh: Honda Civic Type R Limited Edition (FK8) '20
en:
The Type R is an aggressively styled 4-door
hatchback coupe.
This segment was popularized by the original VW Golf GTI.
What sets this one apart is like an action movie with lots
of special effects!
First you notice the big rear wing...
...then the aggressive front flares.
The front is emphasized by huge side nostrils
and a NACA duct on the hood!
The great stance is set up by the tires set out to the
edges and special suspension.
You'll also spot the big red Brembo brake calipers
behind the glossy black wheels.
zh:
Type R是一款风格激进的四门掀背轿跑车。
这款车的特别之处
在于它就像一部充满特效的动作电影！
你会首先被巨大的尾翼吸引，
然后是战斗力十足的前轮宽体。
巨大的侧裙和引擎盖上的NACA导管映衬前脸！
外突的轮胎和特殊的悬挂让其拥有出色的车身姿态。
你还会注意到闪亮黑色轮毂后的大红色
布雷博刹车卡钳。它一点也不适合那些想低调的人！_

speaker: Chris
en:
The Unimog—a versatile, multi-purpose truck with a storied legacy
has been a legend among enthusiasts for decades.
Its remarkable history traces all the way back to 1945.
It was originally designed as an agricultural workhorse.
And, it first entered production in 1948.
The 411 you see here belongs to the second-generation
series from 1956.
In addition to boasting a more powerful engine than the 401, it
was equipped with a wide array of specialized attachments.
It was the most well-rounded of the early Unimogs. Its endearing
design has captured the hearts of countless tractor enthusiasts.
zh:
作为多功能卡车界的“活化石”，Unimog
数十年来一直是车迷心中的机械传奇。
事实上，它的传奇历史甚至可以追溯到1945年！
最初被设计为农用机械的它……
于1948年正式量产。
眼前这台411属于1956年诞生的第二代车型。
相较401型，不仅引擎功率大幅提升，更配有
整套专业级拓展套件。
作为早期Unimog家族最全能的成员，其独特设计
征服了无数拖拉机爱好者。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
This is a fifth-generation Corvette, called the C5
from 2001.
It was a truly unforgettable chapter in the Corvette's legacy.
It was when a C5-based GT racer known as the "C5-R"...
...achieved a stunning overall victory at the 24 Hours
of Daytona.
Just a few months later, it secured a class
win at Le Mans...
...followed by yet another triumph in 2002.
Beloved by many, the C5-R is still considered
among the fastest GT cars in the world!
zh:
这是一辆第五代科尔维特——
尽管是一辆2001款的C5。
对于科尔维特而言，这是载入史册的年份。
基于C5打造的超级跑车“C5-R”
不仅在戴通纳24小时耐力赛斩获全场总冠军，
数月后更在勒芒赛场摘得本组别桂冠，
并在2002年成功卫冕！
这台深受车迷爱戴的C5-R，至今仍是
全球最快的超级跑车之一。

speaker: Stella
en:
One of my all-time favorite cars is an 1980s icon—
the fourth-generation Civic.
With its powerful engine, this Civic Si
was the pride of the hatchback pack.
Civics of this era ranged from smart and chic sedans
to uniquely designed 5-door wagons like the Shuttle.
And each was beautiful
in its own way!
zh:
我的毕生挚爱之一诞生于80年代
——那就是第四代思域。
这台搭载强劲引擎的思域Si掀背版，堪称
家族的门面担当。
这一时期的思域车系从优雅时髦的四门轿车，
到造型独特的穿梭机五门瓦罐车，应有尽有。
每款车型都绽放着独特的美！%

speaker: Chris
en:
Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.
They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.
In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.
Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.
At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.
This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Natu�ally, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.
The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.
Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.�
But none more than the legendary Z-tune!
zh:
NISMO是日产自家厂队的名称，
以打造出结合诸多
赛车技术的量产车而闻名。
2004年，为纪念成立20周年，NISMO推出了
这款R34 GT-R Z-tune。
在所有NISMO作品中，这款车堪称巅峰之作。
在它发布之时，R34天际线GT-R
已经停产退役……
这意味着Z-tune必须以旧款车型为基础来进行打造。
自然，只有那些被N�SMO评定为极品的车辆才会被选用。
引擎和车身随后被拆解，
并运用赛车技术进行重新改造。
如今，R34 GT-R被全世界奉为
收藏珍品。
而其中最珍贵的莫过于Z-tune�h

speaker: Chris
resolved_car_en: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
resolved_car_zh: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
en:
Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force
in the World Rally Championship.
This Group A rally version of the Delta stands
as a testament to Lancia’s many triumphs.
From 1987 to 1992, the marque secured six
consecutive manufacturers’ championships.
It was a legendary achievement—one that remains unmatched
in the history of the world’s premier rally series.
This Group A Delta rally car stands as an undeniable testament
to Lancia’s dominance in the sport.
Even the production car version, built for Group B
homologation...
...is the envy of car collectors everywhere!~
zh:
意大利蓝旗亚作为第一个赢得
世界拉力锦标赛年度冠军的车厂被人们铭记。
这款Delta Group A拉力赛版本正是其众多杰作中的瑰宝。
从1987年到1992年，蓝旗亚豪取六连车厂冠军头衔……
这项传奇成就在世界顶级拉力赛事中至今无人能复刻。
这台Delta Group A拉力赛车无疑是蓝旗亚成功的见证。
即便只是作为为了满足B组别认证而打造的
量产版车型……
也令全球汽车藏家艳羡不已！

speaker: Stella
en:
Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.
Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow
a three-digit pattern.
The history behind this convention actually dates back
to 1921 with the 201.
Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names,
but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?
This "2008" is a compact SUV.
As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble,
just as it should be!
zh:
标致的车可以从它们名字中的数字区分开来。
例如“205”或“306”，似乎所有车名都遵循着三位数命名格式。
这一传统其实可追溯到1929年的“201”！
如今，它旗下以四位数命名的车型并不少见，
但你或许不知道这些是专门留给SUV的。
这台“2008”就是一款紧凑型SUV。
与其他标致车型相似，这台车活力十足，灵活敏捷，
一切都恰到好处！

speaker: Stella
en:
When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes
to mind is this BX.
Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?
Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian
design house Bertone!
From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version,
it was also a car rich in variation.
Launched in 1982, it proved to be a lasting success,
staying in production for over a decade.
All told, around 2.3 million units were produced
across the entire lineup!
zh:
一听到雪铁龙，我首先想到的就是这款BX。
有谁会不记得它那笔直的线条和方方正正的造型呢？
而拥有如此独特外观的汽车，毫无疑问
只会出自意大利设计公司博通之手！
从Break旅行车到跑车，这款车的衍生车型十分丰富。
1982年问世的BX堪称车坛常青树，生产周期
横跨十余载……
全系产量约达230万台！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
The year 1967 marked a milestone in Japanese motorsports history.
The country hosted its very first 24-hour endurance race
at the newly opened Fuji Speedway.
Long-distance endurance races like Le Mans had been
a European tradition since the 1920s.
But with their arrival in Japan, a new chapter
in motorsport history began.
And the winner of that historic inaugural
Fuji 24 Hours?
It was none other than the Toyota works team,
racing this 2000GT!
It was driven by the legendary duo of Shihomi Hosoya
and co-driver Yoshio Otsubo.|
zh:
这是于1967年举办的盛会……
日本在新开放的富士赛道上举办了该国
有史以来第一场24小时耐力赛。
该比赛的性质与欧洲自20世纪20年代以来举办的勒芒等
长距离耐力赛相似。
也是此类比赛首次踏上日本的国土，
标志着赛车运动史上的新篇章。
至于这场历史性、开创性的富士24小时耐力赛的冠军……
还用说吗？自然是驾驶着这辆2000GT的丰田厂队！
驾驶这辆车的车手是传奇的双人组，
细谷四方洋和领航员大坪善男。

speaker: Jeremy
en:
Believe me when I tell you that this N-ONE
is a genuine racer!
It has participated in one-make series across Japan.
Honda launched these events in 2014.
That means the N-ONE boasts over a decade of
racing heritage.
Cars competing in these no-holds-barred races had to be outfitted
with roll cages and a host of specialized racing components.
Just watching them take to the track in their colorful
liveries is pure joy!
zh:
相信我，这辆N-ONE是天生的极品赛车！
这款车曾经征战日本各地的单一车种比赛。
本田从2014年开始举办这些赛事，这就意味着……
N-ONE参与赛车运动的历史已有十年之久！
参加此类无护栏赛事的赛车
必须配备防滚架和其他指定赛车配件。
光是看着这些身披五颜六色涂装的赛车进入赛场
就足够让人心潮澎湃！

speaker: Chris
en:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.
This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it
was really intended to be a two-door coupe.
A truly unique car, if I may say so.
It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément,
chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.
Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run
of �wo short years.
A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character,
inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.
No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world.
It’s another shi�ing achievement in Renault’s long history.
zh:
雷诺以其打造的多功能乘用车而闻名，特别是Espace。
虽然这款Avantime看起来像多功能乘用车，但实际上
它是按照双门轿跑车的标准打造的。
实话实说，这确实是一款独一无二的车。
它的设计师正是帕特里克·勒·奎芒，
他在1980年代至2000年代期间担任雷诺的首席设计师。
v��车于2001年发布，生产周期却异常短暂，
仅仅持续了两年时间。
这实在令人惋惜，因为这是一款由内到外都充满个性
的汽车。说真的，我觉得再也找不到如此特立独行的车型了。
难怪它至今仍吸引着世界各地的车迷。
这又是雷诺悠久历史中的一项辉煌成就。

speaker: Stella
en:
Renault boasts a rich and storied legacy that
stretches back to the 19th century.
Introduced in 1961, this Renault 4—referred to as “the Quatrelle”
by the French—holds a cherished place in that heritage.
After all, it was the first Renault to
feature front-wheel drive.
For a company that had built its reputation on
front-engine, rear-wheel-drive machines...
...this marked a significant �eparture with a sizable interior
and greater ease of operation.
Thankfully, the Quatrelle was a big success!
This bestseller remained in production for more than 30 years
and amassed g�obal sales of more than 8 million units!
zh:
雷诺拥有悠久且丰富的历史，
可以追溯到上上个世纪。
这款于1961年推出的雷诺4，被法国人亲切地称之为
“四翼”，在这段历史中占据着举足轻重的地位。
要知道，它是第一款采用前轮驱动技术的雷诺汽车。
对于雷诺这样一家以
前置发动机、后轮驱动布局车型而闻名的公司而言……
这确实是一个重�:�转变，但这种变更带来了更大的空间
和更出色的操控性能。
值得庆幸的是，四翼取得了巨大的成功！
作为一款畅销车型，它的生产周期超过了30年，
全球销量突破了800万辆！

speaker: Stella
en:
Did you know that the Kangoo was originally designed
as a commercial vehicle?
With its generous cargo space, this is a machine that, for many,
became a trusted co-worker.
But not all Kangoos were built for hard labor.
Some serve as passenger cars, offering a welcome blend of style
and comfort, and they’re every bit as popular.
Renault, after all, has a long tradition of crafting
iconic utility vehicles.
Among them was a commercial version of the Renault 4
from the 1960s.
Another was the Express, derived from
the second-generation Renault 5.
zh:
你知道吗？Kangoo最初其实是
按商用车来设计的。
凭借宽敞的载物空间，对很多人来说，
它简直堪称得力的工作伙伴！
不过，并非所有Kangoo都是为了干活而生的。
也有一部分乘用车版本具备时尚外观
和舒适性能，人气也非常高。
多年来，雷诺推出了不少大名鼎鼎
的“工作用车”车型。
其中就包括1960年代雷诺4的商用版本。
还有一款是Express，它是基于第二代雷诺5打造的！

speaker: Chris
en:
This is the successor to the legendary original Skyline GT-R,
or "Hakosuka," as it was affectionately known in Japan.
This car earned its nickname from an ad campaign featuring a
charming young couple known as “Ken” and “Mary.”
Among Skyline fans, it has forever been remembered by that name
—the “Kenmeri GT-R.”
The Hakosuka rose to prominence in Japanese touring car racing,
earning a fearsome reputation for bein� nearly unstoppable.
Naturally, the Kenmeri was expected to carry the torch passed
down by its proud predecessor. But fate had other plans.
The 1970s ushered in a new era of strict emissions regulations,
cutting short the Kenmeri’s racing legacy before it began.
Because of these regulations, building cars with high-performance
engines like the GT-R became impossible.
And so, just four months after the Kenmeri went on sale,�
production ended, leaving behind only 197 units ever built.
Although it never had a chance to compete in any races...
...its tragic fate and small production run have made
it—in the eyes of enthusiasts—a legend all its own.,
zh:
此车是传奇初代天际线GT-R的继承者，
后者在日本被亲切地称为“箱型”……
而本车的昵称则源自一则流行广告，在广告中出现了
一对名为“肯”与“玛丽”的可爱年轻情侣。
因此，在天际线车迷圈中，如今人们都称这款车为
“肯·玛丽GT-R”。
前辈“箱型”在日本房车赛事中声名鹊起，
赢得了不可战胜的美誉。
按理�1�，“肯·玛丽”本应延续其前辈铸就的辉煌……
然而时运不济，1970年代恰逢严格的排放法规
开始实施的时代。
这些法规导致GT-R这类搭载高性能引擎的车型
无法继续生产。
因此，“肯·玛丽”在上市仅四个月后便宣告停产，
最终产量定格在197台。
虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……
但悲情的命运与��有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。

speaker: Stella
en:
This may look like an ordinary R34 GT-R, but I can
recognize its true identity at a glance.
This is the BNR34 N1 base, built by the legendary
Japanese tuning house, Mine’s!
Mine’s is one of the oldest and most respected tuners
of the Skyline GT-R lineage.
Its creations embody the perfect balance of power, handling,
and speed, whether on the street or the circuit!
This is a machine every collector dreams of owning.
Among Mine’s many GT-R masterpieces, the BNR34 N1
base stands out as truly exceptional!
zh:
这看似是一台普通的R34 GT-R，
但我当即就辨认出了它的不凡来历。
它竟然是著名日本改装厂迈恩斯出品的
BNR34 GT-R N1 base！
迈恩斯是历史最悠久、最受推崇的
天际线GT-R改装厂商之一。
无论是街道驰骋还是赛道竞速，
他们的作品都展现出极致的动力、操控与速度！
这无疑是每位收藏家心驰神往的梦想座驾。
而在迈恩斯众多GT-R改装杰作中，
BNR34 GT-R N1 base堪称真正的非凡之作！

speaker: Stella
en:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.
Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated
with its engine.
Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement
and 6 cylinders.
Combine the two and you get “296."
I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention
for several models between 1970 and 1990.
I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!
zh:
296 GTB是法拉利最具标志性的GT3赛车。
其命名取自引擎的核心参数。
具体而言，该车搭载2.9升排量的6缸引擎。
两者结合便构成了“296”的命名！
我听说，在1970至1990年间，法拉利
还以类似的方式命名了其他车型。
具体数量我一时说不上来，但我一定会查个明白！

speaker: Jeremy
en:
In 2022, scarcely a year after its first appearance...
...the ELANTRA N TC rose to the top, claiming the crown
at the very pinnacle of global TCR competition.
Even now, it continues to assert its authority as
a constant force on the world stage.
And who could overlook its astonishing performance
at the Nürburgring 24h in May 2025?
That was the moment the ELANTRA N TC delivered an improbable
1–2 finish in the TCR Class!
Remarkably, it also marked Hyundai’s fifth straight class victory
at this legendary endurance race.
zh:
2022年，即此车面世仅一年之后……
伊兰特N TC就荣获了世界TCR系列赛
最高级别比赛的冠军。
直至今日，此车仍旧在国际舞台上展现着它强大的实力！
谁能忘记它于2025年5月
在纽博格林24小时耐力赛的赛道上驰骋的英姿？
在那场比赛中，伊兰特N TC
可是包揽了TCR组别的冠亚军，堪称奇迹！
此外，这也是现代在这项传奇赛事中
获得该组别的第五次连胜。
